༅tsheṣṭhalozabla(012)mayospozaspyatsho 7lkomazazo /khrirṣa yo maṭhamalo'i 2①2 12(2sgom 8za༅)1༅sa1—223—01495—41 khya lko khya malo—rjem/mtshoza—za chos12772914༅༅loḥ༅cayo019ma༅ṣṭharo 2①2)lko072012byu'i tsho za tshe mazoṣṭha rsā chooza༅zo.o༅ / aloyo7ma༅tshoo spomamarmamaloṣṭha(4choyochosgom6 23sta)༅ zla/ yom༅lagasgo ngalamatshe 850lo1168 172gra ༅ 8zo ༅ 2tshi ma 66cakho ༄ 2002༅12༅zo1logra ma 2①4༅8༅lkolhachogomigra ma 2 ༅1/lo 5①tso byu /༅sa1—223—01495—4la 349tsho yi 15 ①rkelo4loho zayi7ma

rtsom pa po ngo sprod/deb 'di phyogs bsgrigs gnang mkhan sku zhabs bsod tshe lags ni bod rang skyong ljongs phul byung rigs gcig mkhas can dang / rgyal khab rim pa dang po'i 'khrab gzhung rtsom pa po/ bod rigs 'khrab gzhung gsar rtsom mkhas can bcas yin pa dang / khong gi 'khrungs yul lha sa yin 'ing / da lo dgung lo 57phebs yod/spyi lo 1962lo'i zla 8par lha sa slob 'bring thon nas hrang had zlos gar slob grwa chen mor gtam brjod 'khrab ston sgyu rtsal slob sbyong gnang bar phebs/ spyi lo 1967lo'i zla 7par hrang had zlos gar slob grwa chen mo thon nas bod ljongs gtam brjod zlos gar tshogs pa'i 'khrab ston pa gnang /gi lo 1976lor las sgyur gnang nas dngos su 'khrab gzhung gsar rtsom gyi bya bar zhugs/ dus de nas bzung khong gi sgyu rtsal 'gro lam la rtsa ba'i 'pho 'gyur byung ste/ bod kyi rig gnas sgyu rtsal 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi ngal ba dang du blangs nas grub 'bras g.yur du za ba thob/ khong gis gsar rtsom gnangaba'i sgyu rtsal brtsam bya de rigs la rang nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos mnga' zhing / sgyu rtsal gyi rin thang chen po ldan yod pas rgya che'i bod rigs mang tshogs tsho'i dga' bsu dang gdeng 'jog chen po thob pa ma zam thongs phyi nang du'ang skad grags nges can yod/ khyad par spyi lo 1980tshun la khong gi brtsam bya mang po 'ig la rgyal khab dang ljongs rim pa'i 1

bya dga' thob myong zhing / bya dga'i thob tshad thad nas bshad na'ang las rigs gcig pa'i nang nas ang dang po yin zhes brjod chog de bzhin khong gi rig rtsal gsar rtsom gyi brtsam bya de rnams ni rgya che gting zab kyi sgo nas 'tsho ba dngos mtshon thub pa dang / bsam blo'i rang bzhin dang sgyu rtsal rang bzhin shugs che ldan pa sha stag yin pa ma zad/ yig rigs thad nas brjod na'angabod yig gi thog nas brtsams pa yod la rgya yig gi thog nas brtsams pa'angayod/ de yang bgrang bya sum cu lhag tsam ring khong la thob pa'i grub 'bras rnams zhus na/ spyir khag bzhi tsam la dbye chog pa ste/1 gsar rtsom gtam brjodazlos gar 'khrab gzhung gi skor/'khrab tshan drug ldan gyi gtam brjod zlos gar 'khrab gzhung (gser 'jig dang pad skyid〉ces pa der 1981lor rgyal yongs kyi skabs dang po'i grangs nyung mi rigs rtsom rig bya dga' thob pa dang / 'khrab tshan lnga ldan gyi gtam brjod zlos gar che gras (a khu ston pa〉zhes par 1986lor rgyal yongs kyi grangs nyung mi rigs kyi rtsom gzhi'i mthun sgril gyi bya dga' thob/de bzhin gtam brjod zlos gar chung gas (bza' sgo za mkhan〉zhes pa dang /(drin lan log 'jal〉zhes pa/ (chang skyur mo〉zhes pa bcas so sor sa gnas kyi bya dga' thob myong yod pa red/2 gsanartsom gzhasam gtam gyiskor/bod skad kyi dgod bro'i gtam gleng 〈dbul bcos phyug 'gyur〉 (glu gar gyi rgya mtsho〉 (ra ma lug〉 (gnas chen po ta la〉 〈gna' grong gi 'pho 'gyur〉 (rngo lo 'phyar ba〉 〈ja chang gi rtsod gzhi〉sogs dang /'bras bshad (bkra shis rten 'brel〉 (smon tshig〉 〈bkra shis dgyes 2

ston〉 (brjod mi tshar ba'i gtam bzang〉 'khrab gzhas 〈bya sprel gtam rgyud thor bu〉sogs gzhas ma gtam gyi brtsam bya khag la rgyal yongs rang bzhin dang sa gnas rang bzhin gyi bya dga' thob myong yod pa red/2 gzhas mig gsarartsom gyi sgojo/(zhing las 'phrul chas can la bstod glu len〉 〈bkra shis lung pa'i phu la〉 (bkra shis bde legs〉 (mchod chang sbrang rtsi'i nying khu〉 (lha sa'i bu mo〉 (dga' skyid glu gzhas〉 (brtse ba'i pha yul〉 (blo dkar yid kyi me tog〉 byis pa'i glu gzhas (ngas shes kyi yod〉 〈nga tsho spun mched 'dra〉zhes pa sogs ni da lta yongs su dar khyab ha cang che ba'i glu gzhas kyi gzhas tshig sha stag ste/ de dag las rgyal yongs dang sa gnas kyi bya dga' thob myong ba rnams sgra phab spyin shog nang blugs zin/4 gsar rtsom brnyan 'phrin 'khrab tshan skor/lha sa brnyan 'phrin las khungs nas par len byas pa'i 〈lha sa'i bu mo gsum〉zhes pa dang / 〈bsam skyid〉ces pa/ ched sgrig par gzhi che ba (nga yi zhen chags che ba'i pha yul〉(stod smad bar gsum )zhes pa/ ched sgrig par gzhi (pha yul〉(stod smad gnyis )zhes pa/ ched sgrig par gzhi (nyen brta〉zhes pa/ brnyan 'phrin 'khrab tshan (dmar ljang glog gi 'og〉ces pa/ ched sgrig par gzhi 〈lha ldan lha sa〉zhes pa dang / 〈sa mtho'i steng gaspang rgyan me tog〉bcas dang / de bzhin 1985lo'i bod kyi gnam lo gsar tshes kyi par gzhi 〈sa mtho'i glu gar〉zhes pa/ 1984lo'i lo gsar par gzhi 〈dga' skyid ldan pa'i lha sa〉zhes pa/ 1986lo'i lo gsar par gzhi (gangs ljongs glu dbyangs〉zhes pa/ 1988lo'i lo gsar par gzhi 3

gleng gzhi/bod yul kha ba'i ljongs 'di dkar mo nas kyi 'khrungs yul yin/bod yul nas bshad na dkar mo nas ni bod kyi 'bru rigs sna lnga'i nang nas gtso bor gyur pa de yin/ chang ni dkar mo nas kyi nying khu'i bdud rtsi yin/bod btsan po'i rgyal rabs kyi snga rol nas bod yul 'dir chang bsnyal ba'i bzocol dang / chang 'thung rgyag pa'i lugs srol dar yod/ de yang bod kyi lo rgyus yig cha mi nyung ba zhig dang lhag par du kun hong nas thon pa'i bod kyiglo rgyus yig cha sogs kyi nang bod yig ma dar gong nas chang bsnyal ba'i bzo rtsal dar yod pa dang / bod ces pa'i ming thog mar chags pa'i dus skabs su chang ni btsan po dang / blon po rnams kyis phyi 'brel gyi gna' chings 'jog pa'i mdzad sgo dang / nang gi rten 'brel mdzad sgo che rigs/debazhin rgyal blon lhan 'dzoms kyi mdzad chen skabs su spyod pa'i rtsa che'i 'thung bca' zhig yin pa las dmangs khrod du de tsam dar khyab med/ srong btsan sgam po'i sku dus su rgyal blon lhan 'dzoms kyis mchod chang bzhes pa de rgyunagatan gyi lam srol zhig tu 'gyur/ skabs de dus blon po rnams kyis 'tshan po thugs mnyes ched du gtso bo mchod chang zhim po bsnyal nas 'bul gyi yorda/ de bzhin rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos rgya'i gong ma thang the tsung la rgasir las bzos pa'i ser bya ngang pa'i dbyibs gzugs kyi chang snod phul ba sogs lo rgyus kyi yig cha khag gi nang du gsal/ nga tsho kha ba'i ljongs la chang der ba dang dus mtshungs chang dang 'brel ba'i rig gnas te chang gzhas dang /1

chang sgrung / chang dang 'brel ba'i gtam dpe sogs bod kyi dmangs khrod dudar zhing rim bzhin chang ni bod rigs mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i nang skyid sdug gang la'ang med thabs med pa'i zas rigs kyi grub cha gtso bo zhig tu 'gyur ba ma zad/ chang gzhas sogs chang dang 'brel ba'i rig rtsed kyi byed sgo mang po zhig kyang dmangs khrod du dar khyab shugs che byung ste des bod mi rigs kyi dga' skyid spro ba 'phel ba'i bsam pa'i 'tsho bcud kyi thad la nus pa nges can zhig bton yod/de nas rim bzhin rim bzhin chang dang gzhas gnyis gan ta mgo sbrel lta bur mnyam du 'grogs nas dus da lta bar bod mi tshos chang 'thung la rol skabs glu gzhas len pa ni rang re'i mi rigs kyi khyad chos che shos shig tu gyur pa dang / de bzhin chang dar ba'i dbang gis chang snod spus dag sna tshogs bzoba'i lag shes bzo las 'phel rgyas 'gro bar yang nus pa nges can zhig thon yod/ mdor na nga tsho bod mi rigs kyi lo rgyus yun ring ldan pa'i chang dang 'brel ba'i rig gnas kyi chab rgyun de dag rgyun srol rig gnas kyi khyab khongasagang sa'i nang du ma sim pa gcig kyang med ces brjod na mi 'grig pa med/ kho bo ni sgyu rtsal gsar rtsom gyi las ka byed mkhan zhig yin stabs rang gi las pa'i dgos mkho ltar bod kyi sa gnas mi nyung ba zhig tu bskyod nas bod kyi chang dang 'brel ba'i rig gnas la brtag dpyad dang / zhib 'juga'atshol bsdu bcas kyi las ka'i nang dmangs khrod du gna' bo'i snyan 'jebs ldan pa'i chang gzhas dang / chang sgrung / chang dang 'brel ba'i gtam dpe sogs grangs las 'das pa yod pa'i thog la da dung nang don phun sum tshogs pa'i da lta'i chang gzhas/ chang sgrung / chang dang 'brel ba'i 2

gtam dpe gsar pa mang po zhig spyi tshogs nang dar khyab shugs che 'gro bzhin yod pa mthong thos byung bas kho bo'i sems nang spobs pa dang spro ba rab tu 'phel ba ma zad/ bod mi rigs kyi chang gi rig gnas de dag ni rang re'i mes po tshos shul bzhag gnang ba'i rtsa che'i nor bu zhig yin pa ni/ rang rgyal mi rigs rig gnas ldum ra'i khrod kyi mdzes la bkrag mdangs ldan pa'i me tog cig yin pa sngar bas gsal rtogs thub pa byung ba ma zad/ rang re'i bod kyi dmangs khrod kyi chang gzhas sogs chang dang 'brel ba'i rig gnas de tsho phyogs sgrig bya rgyu'i sems shugs chen po skyes/ da res bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gi thugs rje'i rgyab skyor dang thugs khur 'og kho bos lo mang ring bod ljongs sa gnas khag la bskyod nas 'tshol bsdu legs sgrig byas pa'i chang gzhas khag gcig phyogs sgrig gis rgya che'i gzigs pa po'i spyan lam du bstar ba yin/ 'on kyang gcig nas rang nyid kyi shes tshad kyis mi ldeng ba dang / gnyis nas bod kyi chang dang 'brel ba'i rig gnas de dag nam mkha'i skar tshogs lta bu bgrang gis mi langs pas cha tshang ba zhig bsdu bsgrigs margyu ni shin tu nas dka'/ der brten da res kho bos phyogs sgrig byas pa dedag la skyon sel dge spel la sman pa'i dgongs 'char lhug stsol ci nas kyang yod pa zhu rgyu yin lags/bsod tshes/

dkar chagamachod chang sbrang rtsi'i nying khu/ (1)gser srang brgya las lhag pa/ (1)rdzab ya phyag bzhes gnang dang/ (2)mchod chang gtsang bzhes gnang dang / (2)khyed kyi thugs sems dkar ba/ (2)mgron po lags kyis mchod dang / (2)dga' ba'i zhabs bro brgyab yod/ (3 )snyan pa'i glu yang len gyis/ (3)bkra shis phun sum tshogs song / (3)'dzoms pa'i smon lam rgyob shog (3)dkar po'i dung la gzigs dang / (4)g.yu bya 'dra ba mi 'dug (4)snyun gzhi god chag ma gtong / (4)bzhugs gral 'od kyis khengs song (5)ri mo bkra shis rtags brgyad/ (5)dngul gyi mchod zhal btsugs yod/ (5)bsod nams sgrol mas shes yong / (5)chang g.yog yin na dga' ba/ (6)sbrang chang lha mdzes zhu chog (6)/de 1 /de

dang po de nas 'chugs song / (6)langs nas thon chang zhu chog (6)ma mchod yid la mi 'dug (7)mchod chang mngar mo gsol gsol/ (7)lha yi yon chab min nam/ (7)nga gnyis do dgong 'dzoms 'dzoms/ (8)jo lags sras chung spang rgyan me tog 'dra/ (8)sem sim sem la bzhes dang / (8)nga tsho gcig la sgril shog (9)nyams bzang lags/ (9)a ma bag gro/ (9)gnas khang bde skyid khang gsar/ (9)bkra la shis pa shog dang / (10)lha sa'i skyid chu sngon mo/ (10)bzhengs pa'i lha las mdzes pa (10)gsung snyan skyon rogs gnang dang / (11)gser gyi cog tse'i sgang la/ (11)khams gsum dbang gis 'dus song / (11)mnyes dag mchod rogs gnang dang / (11)zhal dkar gang gis bzi song (12)bkra shis rten 'brel yod do/ (12)lhan rgyas gtsang bzhes gnang dang / (12)— 2 —

khang bzang 'di ru bab song (12)'gyur ba yong sa ma red/ (13)nu zho las kyang zhim pa/ (13)rgun 'brum las kyang zhim pa/ (13)lhan rgyas bsam don 'grub yong / (14)chang bdud rtsi glu yi sna 'dren red/ (14)gang bshad dran yas mi 'dug (14)dgong gcig chang gis myos nas/ (14)chang rag sho sbag byang ma/ (15)rdza ma'i phyogs la shor song / (15)mngon shes gsungs rogs gnang dang / (15)chang ma'i nang la phebs kyis/ (15)zhal dkar gang re bzhes dang / (16)bkra shis g.yas skor rgyag gis/ (16)chang zhig btungs nas yong yod/ (16)chang 'di zhim mngar 'dzoms pa/ (17)gnas tshang a mas bslabs byung / (17)'bras chang bsil ma'i longs spyod/ (17)yon tan mi 'dug ma gsungs/ (17)dga' ba'i mi yang 'dzoms song (18)dkar mo 'bru yi mchod chang / (18)bdud rtsis g.yas skor rgyag gis/ (18)/de 3 /de

gsung glu snyan po 'bul chog (18)bdag gis gtsang bzhes zhus yod/ (19)ma 'thung gong nas bzi song (19)dug sel bdag gis zhu chog (19)grogs po phebs yong bsams nas/ (20)dkar mo 'bru yi rtsig pa/ (20)spro po bzo mkhan nga red/ (20)chang ma ye shes mtsho rgyal/ (20)dgongs pa zhus nas log 'gro/ (21)pha mas skyongs rogs gnang dang / (21)nam tshod zin rogs gnang dang / (21)dar cog rgyang bkrag che ba/ (21)glu dang gar gyi mchod pa/ (22)chang dang ja khra rog rog (22)mi bzang gser gyi rdo rje/ (23)zha dang zhen pa log song / (23)'thung rgyu chang las mi 'dug (23)dga' nas 'bral dgos ma gtong / (24)chang la dga' nas gtsang bzhes/ (24)bdud rtsi'i mchod chang bkang yod/ (24)sgo dag 'jur rta nyos yod/ (25)bzhugs gral 'di ru 'dzoms shog (25)— 4 —

bro gzhas mnyam du rgyag chog (25)nga tsho 'di 'dra'i skyid pa/ (25)mi dgos glu zhig shes song / (26)skyid pa'i ja chang spel ma/ (26)zhabs bro rma bya 'gre log (26)mchod chang a rag bdud rtsi/ (27)gser gyi khrung rkyan bzhag yod/ (27)mdzes ma mchi ma ma gtong / (27)lcang gling pho bya sngon po/ (27)lag rdos bsu rogs gnang dang / (28)la mo 'dra 'dra brgyab yod/ (28)gzhas kyi sgo mo phye sa/ (28)chang de 'thung bzhin 'thung bzhin/ (28)sku gzugs brag las mkhregs pa/ (29)bkra la shis pa'i rtse mo (29)rgya cog rkang bzhi btsugs yod/ (29)dga' ba'i dgod sgras khengs song / (30)a khu 'brog pa skyid pa/ (30)gral gzhug 'od kyis khengs song / (30)sngon mo'i chu ltar rgyas shog (31)yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel song (31)mi chen g.yang bzhag brag gro/ (31)— 5 —

mjal snying gzhan las 'dod pa/ (32)'gyes rgyu med na dga' ba/ (32)nga tsho pha ma spun mched/ (32)ma 'gro su yis zer ba/ (32)da cha mjal 'phrad byung song / (33)gzhan la 'gro sa mi 'dug (33)mi 'gyur gtan la bzhugs dang / (33)rin chen gser gyi rgyud red/ (33)nga tsho grogs po grogs mched/ (34)phyogs bzhi'i grogs po 'dzoms song / (34)nor bus zhabs 'dren zhus yong / (34)drin can pha mas gtso byas/ (35)gro mo rin chen sgang la/ (35)ri 'di g.yang chags ri la/ (35)yang yang yid la dran byung / (35)lo yag rtsa ba tshugs song / (36)dbus kyi ri rgyal lhun po/ (36)bu mo nga ras zhu chog (36)mchod chang mngar bsil ldan pa/ (36)chang rtsi nyan pa yod do/ (37)glu blangs nas 'dug sa gang na yod/ (37)dkar mo nas kyi bang mdzod/ (37)— 6 —

'bru rigs ri ltar spungs yod/ (38)lde mig g.yar rogs gnang dang / (38)lan chags o lo yod red/ (38)sku gzugs thang ba'i rten 'brel/ (38)da res bkra shis nyin mo/ (39)spang bya gnang rogs gnang dang / (39)phud gtor lan gsum gnang dang / (39)khyed rang chu zhig khrid dang / (7)o lo'i glu gar tshig gsum/ (40)kha btags mang nas gang yong / (40)sgra snyan gsung skad grags byung / (40)rma bya phebs kyi yod do/ (41)dokar yol nang la gzigs dang / (41)chung 'dris 'khrid na ngo tsha/ (41)mgyogs su 'dzoms pa'i ched yin/ (42)dar dang gos chen/ (42)lo chang nying khu/ (42)thakhridam gyi mu tig char pa/ (43)shā/rosag kha lo zhim pa/ (43)losa'i skad red zhus yod/ (43)chang dam 'bi gang dang nga brjes byung / (43)sam bu khyed kyis bkag song / (44)— 7 —

mjal 'dod thugs la 'dug ste/ (44)mi chen gser gyi sdong po/ (44)sems pa'i kho thag chod pa/ (44)hub 'thung rgyag par thal song (45)phu thung rdze ba ma gnang / (45)chang gis blo khog bslabs byung / (45)lo legs rten 'brel ched du/ (46)mi dran dgu dran dran byung / (46)nam gzhug 'khyol ba gnang dang / (46)tshig la go ba skyon dang / (46)a zhim rgun 'brum yod red/ (47)mi tshe sang 'gro gnangs 'gro/ (47)chang gis ja chu mi nyan/ (47)lba glu snyan po gtang chog (47)dgu bcu bsnyal nas bzhag yod/ (48)dpon bzang brag stod mthon po/ (48)a ma chang ma'i nang la/ (48)rag skyogs ser kha dwangs pa/ (49)thigs chang med pa gnang dang / (49)yas bzed nyi mas bzhur song / (49)de la yon chab 'bul mkhan/ (49)bu mo chang rtsis brgyab song / (50)/de 8 /de

chang la chu zhig skyon dang / (50)bzhugs gral brgya yi dang po/ (50)gnas mo lha bya gong mo/ (50)bzas na mngar kha 'dzoms pa/ (51)pug ril nang nas zhus dang / (51)dman la mdzes po chang ma dbyangs can yod red/ (51)thugs cag lhod tsam gnang dang / (52)pho brang ja chang 'dzoms pa/ (52)lo chang bsnyal nas bzhag yod/ (52)nas ni 'phyongs rgyas nas red/ (52)spang ba mi gnang gang yin/ (53)chang khang them pa yar 'dzegs/ (53)snye ma'i zho kha 'grigs song / (53)nang mi lhan rgyas mchod dang / (53)phan pa'i sman la 'gro yong / (54)ra bzi skyur 'gong mi shod/ (54)gnas mo'i sgo rtsar 'grims yod/ (54)bzi g.yog nga ras zhu chog (55)yar klung a khu 'brog pa/ (55)glu yi mchod pa 'bul chog (55)bdud rtsi chang gi rgya mtsho/ (55)'thung snying 'dod du 'dod du/ (56)/de 9 /de

chang dang ja khras bsus yod/ (56)gser mdangs ldan pa'i mchod chang / (56)zla sgron re re dran byung / (56)ra bzi glu gzhas lhang lhang / (57)bka' drin chen po gsol chog (57)gnas chung btsos pa'i chang las (57)gsung gzhas re re gnang dang / (58)zhag gcig zhag gnyis lus song / (58)kun dga' g.yu yi pho brang / (58)mchod chang bzhes par phebs shig (58)rdza ma mgo la gon zhig (59)sgos gzhis phyogs la log 'gro/ (59)sems pa'i sdug bsngal bsangs song (59)dgra la mi rtag 'chi ba/ (59)dri ma phar zhim tshur zhim/ (60)zhabs bro'i bang mdzod 'dra yod/ (60)'thung la shag shag yin 'gro/ (60)mun pa gsal du thongs dang / (61)lhan rgyas snyan du gsol lo/ (61)spun mched las kyang brtse ba/ (61)nag po brtsegs pa'i nying khu tshe yi gshed/ (61)spyo chu nyes pa'i gzhi dang gtan bral byos/ (62)— 10 —

dga' skyid chang gzhas gtong ba'i pha yul dran/ (62)mgo la na tsha gtang yong / (62)gtam bzang khyer nas slebs byung / (62)gzhis rtse'i myang chu sngon mo/ (63)dkyil 'dzugs gnang rogs gnang dang / (63)tshe la bar chad ma gtong / (63)yar shog yar phebs gsung gis/ (64)nga tsho thugs sems dkar ba/ (64)bzhes rag skyid nyal skyon gyis/ (64)yab chen shes bya'i sdong po/ (yonayar rgyas 'gro ba'i mchod chang / (65)sim sim sim la mchod dang / (65)yab yum gnyis po gnas bzod bde ba/ (66)gnas khang longs spyod khang gsar/ (67) rten 'brel mchod chang bzhes dang / (67)kha ja chang gi bsu ma/ (68)sa cha gang gi chang yin/ (68) lhan rgyas sku khams bzang song (69)zhim po las kyi bro yong / (70)gzhon pa nga tsho'i gnas bzod/ (70)'grigs pa rnams la 'grigs chang zhus/ (71)gzhon pa nga las skyid pa mi 'dug (72)/de 11 /de

dar bshad/ (172)khrung zhu'i bshad pa/ (173)khrung rgyug gi bshad pa/ (174)rdza'o yi bshad pa/ (175)bu'i bshad pa/ (176)bag bshad/ (178)yab chen gyi bshad pa/ (179)yum chen gyi bshad pa/ (180)a ne la bshad pa/ (181)lha dpon la bshad pa/ (181)bar mi la bshad pa/ (182)gnyer pa la bshad pa/ (183)khrung dpon la bshad pa/ (183)ma byan la bshad pa/ (183)khrung zhu ma la bshad pa/ (184)phyugs rdzi la bshad pa/ (184)mjug sgril bkra shis smon lam/ (184)gnyen bshad/ (187)gtsug g.yu'i bshad pa/ (188)mda' dar gyi bshad pa/ (188)kha btags kyi bshad pa/ (189)bu mo gdan nas 'dren skabs kyi bshad pa/ (189)/de 18 /de

bag g.yog ma'i bshad pa/ (218)mna' ma skyel mkhan gyi bshad pa/ (218)bag mi'am snying dga' ba'i bshad pa/ (219)mtho po dkar po'am dkar rdo'i mchod 'bul bshad pa/ (220)nag rdo'am mtho po nag po'i bshad pa/ (221)dkar mo 'bru yi skyes pa'i skyes khungs kyi bshad pa/ (221)

mchod chang sbrang rtsi'i nying khu/mchod chang sbrang rtsi'i nying khu/steng phyogs lha la'ang mi 'dugazhal gang gnang ba tsam gyis/nga sems re ba grub song /dga' dga' spro spro gnang dang /skyid pa'i rtsa ba tshugs song /mchod chang dngul phor 'di la/smon tshig lan gsum bsgron yod/zhal gang gnang ba tsam gyis/re ba'i 'bras bu smin song /dga' dga' spro spro gnang dang /skyid pa'i rtsa ba tshugs song /gser srang brgya las lhag pa/nga tsho lhan du 'dzoms song /mchod chang gtsang bzhes gnang dang /mchod chang gnang ba'i dga' spro/gser srang brgya las lhag pa/

rdzab ya phyag bzhes gnang dang/grogs po rnams tsho phebs dang /rdzab ya phyag bzhes gnang dang /mchod zhal rdzab ya'i nang du/bdud rtsis g.yas bskor rgyag gis/mchod chang gtsang bzhes gnang dang /mchod chang gtsang bzhes gnang dang /gsung gzhas re re gnang dang/dga' dga' spro spro 'di 'dra/steng phyogs lha la'ang mi 'dugakhyedakyi thugs sems dkar ba/phu la gangs ri dkar ba/mdo la mchod rten dkar ba/dkar po 'dra 'dra'i dkyil nas/khyed kyi thugs sems dkar ba/mgron po lags kyis mchod dang /mchod chang nga ras bkyag chogamagron po lags kyis mchod dang /sim sim sem la bzhes dang /2

mngar mo'i chang la bzhes dang /dga' ba'i zhabs bro brgyab yod/chang de dang po btungs pas/lus sems skyid du phyin song /pha ma spun mched 'dzoms dus/dga' ba'i zhabs bro brgyab yod/snyan pa'isnyu yang len gyis/'tsho ba yag dang mi yagazhal ras yi la gzigs dang /dga' ba'i 'dzum mdangs rgyas bzhin/snyan pa'i glu yang len gyis/bkra shis phun sum chogs song /ka bzhi gdung brgyad nang la/phyogs bzhi'i mgron po 'dzoms song /de ring 'dzoms pa'i mgron por/bkra shis phun sum tshogs song /'dzoms pa'i smon lamargyob shogang tsho grogs po rnam pa/3

rma bya gcig gi sgro red/gser gyi bum pa'i kha la/'dzoms pa'i smon lam rgyob shogadakar po'i dung la gzigs dngakadrang srong gas dang ma rgas/drang srong dbu la gzigs dang /nag po'i skyung kha 'dra ba/dkar po'i dung la gzigs dang /g.yu bya 'dra bami 'dugabya de chung la mdzes pa/gong dkar g.yu bya sngon mo/bya chen mang po 'tshog dus/g.yu bya 'dra ba mi 'dugasnyun gzhi god chagam gtonganang tsho 'di ru 'dzoms 'dzoms/gtan du 'dzom rgyu byung na/gtan du 'dzoms pa'i mi la/snyun gzhi god chag ma gtong /4

bzhugs gral 'od kyisakhings songakathag ring rgyang nas phebs pa'i/mgron po sran ma'i me togakhyed rang phebs pa yag byung /bzhugs gral 'od kyis khengs song /ri mo bkra shisatogs brgyad/dkar yol dkar sangs shig la/ri mo bkra shis rtags brgyad/de 'dra'i dkar yol 'byor yang /ri mo 'byor sa ma red/dngul gyi mchod zhal btsugs yod/gser gyi cog tse'i sgang la/dngul gyi mchod zhal btsugs yod/bsod nams can la ma gtogs/dang dod can la mi 'dugabasod nams sgrol mas shesayong /chang de ma thungs byas pas/bsod nams sgrol mas mi nyan/'jig rten bya ba 'chugs na/5

bsod nams sgrol mas shes yong /chang g.yog yin na dga' ba/chang de zhim pa'i dang po/'phyongs rgyas a ma dbyangs can/bu mo a ma dbyangs can/chang g.yog yin na dga' ba/sbrang chang lha mjes zhu chogamachod chang sbrang las zhim pa/gnas mo lha las mtshar ba/gnas mo khyed kyi mtshan la/sbrang chang lha mdzes zhu chogadang po de nas 'chugs songakachang la chu zhig brgyab pas/sbang ma kha la gyeng song /chung 'dris nga gnyis las de/dang po de nas 'chugs song /langs nas thon chang zhu chogashing bzang sbyar pa'i 'og la/

bsil ma'i chang zhig bsnyal yod/da lta lang po min 'dugalangs nas thon chang zhu chogam mchod yid la mi 'dugam mchod yid la mi 'dugazas la sku phog mi 'dugamachod na bsam pa ma gtogs/ma mchod yid la mi 'dugamachod chang mngar mo gsol gsol/mchod chang mngar mo gsol gsol/mngar mo'i lbu ba rog rogamachod na bsam bsam ma gtogs/ma mchod yid la mi 'dugalha yi yon chab min nam/bzhugs gral g.yas gral g.yon gral/lha yi bzhugs gral min nam/chang de g.yu mtsho 'khyil 'dra/lha yi yon chab min nam/7

bzhugs gral g.yas gral g.yon gral/lha yi bzhugs gral yin pas/lha la yon chab 'bul mkhan/rdza kho ma pham g.yu mtsho/nga gnyis do dgong 'dzoms 'dzoms/nga gnyis do dgong 'dzoms 'dzoms/gtan du 'dzom rgyu byung na/tho rengs skar gral zhig zhigazhig rgyu med na dga' ba/jo lags sras chung spang rgyan me tog 'dra/nya mo'i ri de spang gshongs bde mo 'dra/jo lags sras chung spang rgyan me tog 'dra/bu mo bsod med rgya mtsho'i phu la 'gro/rgya mtsho sa thag ring la sa rong tsub/sim sim sim la bzhes dang /gral 'go yar la khyogs dang /gser skyogs cha gcig khyogs dang /gser skyogs ser kha dwangs pas/sem sim sem la bzhes dang /

nga tsho gcig la sgril shogang tsho gcig la sgril shogang tsho gnyis la sgril shogang tsho kha btags dkar po'i/rgyu dang spun la sgril shoganyams bzang lags/bzhugs gral skyid la mchod chang bda' ba/de 'dra'i a ma chang ma lags kyi nyams bzang la/dgon pa skyid la grwa gzhon 'dzoms pa/de 'dra'i bla ma bzang ba lags kyi nyams bzang la/a ma bag gro/lcang lo khang gsar sdod pa'i pha gzhis yin te/chang la zhim po'i snga chang dgong chang yod red/snga chang snga la drags song 'gyod pa ma gnang /yid la 'gro ba'i a ma bag gro yod red/gnasakhang bde skyidakhang gsar/gnas khang bde skyid khang gsar/mtsho mo'i steng na bzhugs yod/

chang la dga' ba'i o lo/bzhugs gral glu sgra shang shang /bkra la shis pa shog dang /bkra la shis pa shog dang /g.yang ni g.yang la chags pas/bkra ni bkra la shis pas/don ni don la 'grub pa/lha sa'i skyid chu sngon mo/lha sa'i skyid chu sngon mo/chang la chu zhig brgyab pas/hub gsum btungs pa tsam gyis/lus po yongs la sim song /bzhengs pa'i lha lasamadzes pa/lha sa'i skyid chu sngon mo/btsos pa'i chang las zhim pa/chung 'dris byams pa'i zhal ras/bzhengs pa'i lha las mdzes pa/10

gsung snyan skyonarogs gnang dang /spa ma ba lu'i dkyil gyi/byi'u chung skad gsang sgrol ma/da lo lo chu yag pa'i/gsung snyan skyon rogs gnang dang /gser gyi cog tse'i sgang la/gser gyi cog tse'i sgang la/dngul gyi ne tso babs song /ne tso babs pas yag song /bzhugs gral 'od kyis khengs song /khams gsum dbang gis 'dus song /stag gdan gzig gdan sgang la/gser gyi mi gcig bzhugs bzhagazhal nas gsung dgos mi 'dugakhams gsum dbang gis 'dus song /mnyes dag mchod rogs gnang dang /gser gyi cog tse'i steng la/g.yu yi zhal dkar btsugs bzhagaganyen bshes blo grogs rnams kyis/11

mo 'brug g.yon nas ldir byung /bsod nams bsags pa'i sbrang char/khang bzang 'di ru bab song /'gyur bayong samarid/bkra la shis pa'i glu red/g.yang la chags pa'i glu red/bkra shis g.yang chags gnyis la/'gyur ba yong sa ma red/nu zho las༅nga zhim pa/mchod chang mngar mngar bsil bsil/mngar mo lbu chung rog rogachung dus a mas ster ba'i/nu zho las kyang zhim pa/rgyan 'brum las༅nga zhim pa/mchod chang zhim pa'i sgang la/rin chen rtsam pa brgyab yod/dwags po bshad sgrub gling gi/rgun 'brum las kyang zhim pa/13

lhanacus bsam don 'grub yong /rgya yul gting nas thon pa'i/dkar yol si ling sngo khra/mchod chang zhal dkar nyan pas/lhan rgyas bsam don 'grub yong /chang bdud: glu yi sna 'drenared/sku rgyal bod la glu zhig dar/glu ma dar gong༄ chang zhig dar/chang bdud rtsi glu yi sna 'dren red/gang bshadarwanabasayi 'dugamadang nub chang gis bzi nas/gang bshad dran yas mi 'dugad rang gnas mos gsung dus/ngo gdong ston thabs bral bzhagadagong gcig chang gis myos nas/dus dang rnam pa kun tu/gron chung bsri tshags byas yod/dgong gcig chang gis myos nas/ther gtor dgu gtor btang bzhag14

chang rag sho sbag byang ma/ma gzhi bu mo'i byams pa/gzhon la mtshar ba dgos yod/chang rag sho sbag byang ma/byung dang ma byung gang yong /rdza ma'i phyogs la shor song /bzhugs gral chang sa che la/o lo skyur dad tsha ba/o lo'i sems pa drang po/rdza ma'i phyogs la shor song /mngon shes gsungs rogs gnang dang /gser gyi cog tse'i steng du/g.yu yi ne tso babs bzhagaja chang 'dod rgu 'dzoms pa'i/mngon shes gsung rogs gnang dang /chang ma'i nang la phebs kyis/dus tshod skal pas ma 'khyongs/ri dwags klung la babs bzhag15

bla mas chos gos bsnams nas/chang ma'i nang la phebs kyis/zhal dkar gangari bzhes dang /dkar mo nas las btsos pa'i/mchod chang sbrang rtsi'i bro ba/stag shar gzhon pa rnams kyis/zhal dkar gang re bzhes dang /bkra shis g.yasaskorachug gis/dbus gzhung lung pa skyid pa/lcang gsar ldem ldem byed kyis/mchod chang gser skyogs nang du/bkra shi4g.yas skor rgyag gis/chang zhig btungs nasayongasad/chang zhig btungs nas yong yod/ra zhig bzi nas yong yod/ra bzi skyur 'gong med pa'i/dam bca' bzhag nas yong yod/16

chang 'di zhimamangar 'dzoms pa/chang 'di zhim mngar 'dzoms pa/gnas tshang a ma'i chang red/gzhas dang 'bas bro mkhas pa/chang g.yog bu mo mdzes ma/gnas tshangaya mas bslabs byung /chang 'thung mi shes skabs la/gnas tshang a mas bslabs byung /thag ring 'grul pa'i 'gro tshod/a ma rang nas gnang rogs/'bras chang bsil ma'i longs spyod/'bras 'di rgya nag 'bras red/rgya nag pe cing 'bras red/'bras chang bsil ma'i longs spyod/pe cing phyogs nas gnang byung /yon tan mi 'dugam gsungs/chang zhig btungs pa'i mi la/yon tan mi 'dug ma gsungs/gom pa phyi bgrod nang bgrod/17

yon tan min na gang yin/dga' ba'i milang 'joms song /dga' ba'i mi yang 'dzoms song /btsos pa'i chang yang zhim song /dga' po mi zhen chang zhen/gnang bar chog pa yod do/dkaralo 'bru thamachodacangakagaser gyi tshags rkyan nang du/dkar mo 'bru yi mchod chang /bzhes mkhan stag shar gzhon pa/btegs mkhan dman chung bu mo/bdudashtsas g.yasaskoracug gis/zhal dkar phyag bzhes gnang dang /'brug khra phyag bzhes gnang dang /zhal dkar 'brug khra'i nang du/bdud rtsis g.yas skor rgyag gis/gsung glu snyan po 'bul chogamachod chang bzhes pa gnang dang /18

zhal dkar nga ras 'degs chogazhal dkar btegs pa'i rjes su/gsung glu snyan po 'bul chogabadag gis gtsang bzhes zhugayod/chang la dga' nas gtsang bzhes/zhus pa rang da min te/chung 'dris mdza' sems bsams nas/bdag gis gtsang bzhes zhus yod/ma 'thung gonganas bzi songakado dgong chang ma'i nang la/ma brgyab gom pa thal song /chang ma'i mchod chang bdud rtsi/ma 'thung gong nas bzi song /dug sel bdag gis zhu chogamachod chang gtsang bzhes gnang dang /zas la sku phog med do/gal srid thugs dogs yod na/dug sel bdagagis zhu chog19

grogs po phebs yong bsamasanas/grogs po phebs yong bsams nas/chang la yas bzed brgyab yod/dngos su phebs pa'i dus su/yas sgron tshang ba lnga ldan/dkaramo 'bruyi:ga pa/chang khang sgo them yan chad/dkar mo 'bru yi rtsig pa/stag shar gzhon pa'i khrung chang /gnang na chog pa yod do/bca bzomakhan ngarid/chang zhig 'thung na nga red/chang glu len na nga red/do nub bzhugs gral sgor mo/spro po bzo mkhan nga red/changs ye shesamachochul/chang ma ye shes mtsho rgyal/bdud rtsi sman gyi phabs rgyun/chang la bro ba med kyang /20

skyom skyom lan gsum gnang dang /dgongs pa zhusanas log 'gro/do dgong nyi ma'i sgang la/dgongs pa zhus nas log 'gro/sang zhogs gangs la nyi shar/mjal la chog pa zhu chogaphams skyongasarogs gnang dngakabadag la 'khor ni 'khor song /bdag la mgron po 'khor song /bdag la 'khor ba'i mgron po/pha mas skyongs rogs gnang dang /nam chod zinarogs gnang dang /rgya gar gting gi bya pho/nam tshod zin rogs gnang dang /pha ma bzang po'i bu yis/bstan pa zin rogs gnang dang /dar cogargyang bkrag che ba/gser po gser gyi khri la/21

gser gyi dar cog btsugs yod/dar cog rgyang bkrag che ba/btsugs mkhan gnas bzod bde ba/sngon po g.yu yi ri la/g.yu yi dar cog btsugs yod/dar cog rgyang bkrag che ba/btsugs mkhan gnas bzod bde ba/dkar po dngul gyi ri la/dngul gyi dar cog btsugs yod/dar cog rgyang bkrag che ba/btsugs mkhan gnas bzod bde ba/glu dang gar gyimachod pa/'u ras lung pa'i phu la/bla ma o rgyan pad ma/glu dang gar gyi mchod pa/lung chung 'di nas phul lo/chang dngajakharog rogakhyed tsho bzhugs mkhan yin zer/22

rab gsal sham bu thib thib/nga tsho 'byon mkhan yin zer/chang dang ja khra rog rogami bzang gser gyirdorje/gral gyi dbus na bzhugs pa'i/mi bzang gser gyirdo rje/gsang chab 'khrus ni mi dgos/bzhugs gral 'od kyis khengs song /zha dang zhen pa log song /dgos pa'i chos shig ma shes/mi dgos glu zhig shes song /'jig rten bya ba'i phyogs la/zha dang zhen pa log song /'thungasgyu chang lasayi 'dugazhim ni a rag zhim song /'thung rgyu chang las mi 'duga'ajam ni gos chen 'jam song /gyon rgyu ras las mi 'dug23

dga'anas 'bral dgos ma gtongakang tsho dga' nas yong yod/gserabyarapung gdang shig shigadaga' nas 'bral dgos ma gtong /nam mkha'i bla ma dkon mchogachang la dga'anas gtsang bzhes/chang la dga' nas gtsang bzhes/zhus pa ye nas min te/chung 'dris mdza' sems bsams nas/bdag gis gtsang bzhes zhus yod/bdudashtsakhrimachod chang bkangayod/g.yu yi bum pa'i nang du/bdud rtsi'i mchod chang bkang yod/chung 'dris mdza' sems bsams nas/bdag gis gtsang bzhes zhus yod/g.yu yi bum pa'i nang du/bdud rtsi'i mchod chang bkang yod/chung 'dris byams pa phebs dus/bsu chang zhu byed yin no/24

sgo rag 'jurarta nyos yod/snyan po'i gzhas shig bsams nas/ sgra snyan lus la khyer yod/zhabs bro rgyag dgos bsams nas /sgo rag 'jur rta nyos yod/bzhugs gral 'di ru 'dzoms shogadangul gyi cog tse'i steng du/gser gyi ne tso babs bzhagaja chang 'dod rgu 'dzoms sa'i/bzhugs gral 'di ru 'dzoms shogabro gzhas mnyam ducug chogachang sa dar po yod na/mi sna gdan thog 'dzom yong /lo legs phyugs zog 'phel na/bro gzhas mnyam du rgyag chogang tsho 'di 'dra'i byud pa/nga tsho 'di 'dra'i skyid pa/steng phyogs lha la'ang mi 'dug25

lha rgyal dbang po brgya byin/'u ras mtshams la mnyes song /mi dgos glu zhig shes songanadagos pa'i chos ni ma shes/mi dgos glu zhig shes song /gshin rje chos kyi rgyal pos/glu la nyan par mdzad song /skyid pa'iracangaspelam/brag ri zil pa phrum phrum/ma dang mkha' 'gro'i bzhugs sa/skyid po ja chang spel ma/ma dang mkha' 'gro'i bzhugs sa/zhabs bro rma bya 'gre legabazhes mkhan stag shar gzhon pa/bkyag mkhan dman chung bu mo/chang gzhas khu byug gsung skad/zhabs bro rma bya 'gre log26

mchod changa.arag bdud rtsi/ja khra gser gshog dngul gshogalung thag stong skud gsum sgril/ja khra'i nang du bzhugs pa'i/mchod chang a rag bdud rtsi/gser gyichungaskrun bzhagapod/sa gzhi pad ma'i steng du/rkang bzhi sgrog tse btsugs yod/rkang bzhi sgrog tse'i steng du/gser gyi khrung rkyan bzhag yod/mdzesamamachim ma gtongaka'abras chung zam pa'i steng la/mdzes mas skyel chang byas byung /mdzes ma mchi ma ma gtong /bu yis dgra lha nyams yong /lcang gling pho bya sngon po/lcang gling pho bya sngon po/gsung snyan bsgyur ba ma gnang /gsung snyan 'di ru sgyur sgyur/27

gang du bsgyur rgyu yin no/lagardos bsurags gnang dang /g.yas pa thang zhig chad na/g.yon mas bsu rogs gnang dang /g.yas g.yon gnyis ka chad na/lag rdos bsu rogs gnang dang /lapo 'dra 'dra brgyabayod/shwa ba rwa co ring kyang /nam mkha'i skar ma mi snyobs/ri bong sug lag thung kyang /la mo 'dra 'dra brgyab yod/gzhagakyi sgomo phye sa/ya gi'i gangs stod mthon po/gzhasakyi sgo mo phye sa/ma gi'i dwangs seng dkar mo/lde mig g.yar po zhu sa/chang de 'thung bzhin 'thung bzhin/chang de 'thung bzhin 'thung bzhin/28

sems pa dwangs ru dwangs ru/bdag la o rgyan pad mas/bdud rtsi gnang ba min 'gro/sku gzugs brag lasamakhregs pa/bkra la shis pa'i skyid po/brag ri yar la bcol yod/sku gzugs brag las mkhregs pa'i/bkra shis smon lam btab yod/bkra la shis pa'irtsemo/bkra la shis pa'i rtse mo/gangs ri yar la byas yod/dbu skra dung las dkar ba'i/bkra shis smon lam btab yod/rgya cogarkang bzhi btsugs yod/da lo lo legs byung bas/bang ba gsar rgyag byas yod/sa gzhi pad ma'i steng du/rgya cog rkang bzhi btsugs yod/29

rgya cog rkang bzhi'i steng na/gser tshags dngul rkyan bzhag yod/de yi nang du bkang ba'i/zhim mngar mchod chang bdud rtsi/dga' ba'i dgod sgrasakhengs song /nga tsho sems pa mthun nas/rang yul 'dzugs skrun 'bad song /sa phyogs gang sa gang du/dga' ba'i dgod sgras khengs song /akhu 'grog pa skyid pa/g.yas ri rtswa sna 'dzoms pa/g.yon ri chu sna 'dzoms pa/rtswa chu 'dzoms pa'i bar la/a khu 'brog pa skyid pa/gral gzhug 'odakyisakhengs song /gral 'go yar la bzhugs pa'i/mi bzang gser gyi sdong po/gral 'go mnan pas yag byung /gral gzhug 'od kyis khengs song /30

sngon mo'i chultarachus shogazhing la son bzang btab yod/sa bon rtsa ba tshugs song /rtsa ba tshugs pa'i sa bon/sngon mo'i chu ltar rgyas shogayar ngo'iza ltar 'phel songakaspang ljongs phyugs kyis khengs song /zhing nang gser rlabs 'phyur song /zhing 'brog mi dmangs 'tsho ba/yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel song /mi chen g.yang bzhag bag gro/bzhugs gdan sum rtsegs steng gi/mi chen g.yang bzhag bag gro/mi chen phyi la phebs na/phyi yi lcags ri gnang dang / mi chen nang du bzhugs na/nang gi nor bu gnang dang /31

mjal snying gzhan las 'dod pa/snga song snga mo'i mi red/srid pa chags pa'i rdo red/rdo la dreg pa 'khor yang /mjal snying gzhan las 'dod pa/'gyesasgyumed na dga' ba/nga tsho 'di ru 'dzoms 'dzoms/gtan du 'dzoms rgyu byung na/'dzoms nas dga' dga' skyid skyid/'gyes rgyu med na dga' ba/nga cho pha ma spunamached/nga tsho pha ma spun mched/ba lu dkar po'i me togaphyi la rgyang bkrag che ba/nang du dri mchog zhim pa/ma 'gro su yisazer ba/khyed rang ma mo gnang dang /nga yis lu gu zhu chogalu gu ma mo'i mjug la/32

ma 'gro su yis zer ba/da cha mjal 'azad byung songakasngon chad zhal yang mi tshor/da cha mjal 'phrad byung song /mjal 'phrad byung ba'i mi la/sbun gzhi god chag ma gtong /gzhan la 'gro sami 'dugaganas khang longs spyod khang gsar/mtsho mo'i steng du bzhengs yod/mtsho kha 'di ru ma gtogs/gzhan la 'gro sa mi 'dugami 'gyur gtan la bzhugs dang /pa ṭa ri mo yag pa/tshon gyi gtong phyogs yin 'gro/rdo rje pha lam bzhin du/mi 'gyur gtan la bzhugs dang /rin chen gser gyisgyud red/a yod nang gi da yod/33

sgo nga'i dkyil gyi ser ril/rigs rus mtho dman dril na/rin chen gser gyi rgyud red/nga cho grogs po grogasamached/nga tsho grogs po grogs mched/lha shing shug pa 'dra ba/dbyar kha sngo yang mi sngo/dgun kha skya yang mi skya/phyogs bzhi'igrogs po 'dzoms songakaka bzhi ra ba'i nang du/phyogs bzhi'i grogs po 'dzoms song /zhim po'i chang yang mchod song /snyan po'i glu yang len song /nor bus zhabs 'dren zhus yongakanam zhag 'khor ba'i rgyun du/bu chung nor bu sangs rgyas/chang zhig btungs pa'i rjes su/nor bus zhabs 'dren zhus yong /yo

drin can pha mas gtsophyas/gam pa la mos gtso byas/ri las ri rgyud mang ba/drin can pha mas gtso byas/gnyen las gnyen rgyud ring ba/groporin chenasgang la/gro mo rin chen sgang la/'gro mkhan migacig byung na/chen po'i lag rtags med de/sems pa'i yig chung yod do/ri 'di g.yang chagasari la/ri 'di g.yang chags ri la/rtswa la sman rtswa skyes bzhagasems can spu gra legs pa/g.yang chags ri la 'khor byung /yangalangayid la dran byungakargya gar gnas ri mtho la/tsan dan nags gseb skyid pa/'on kyang chos 'khor lha sa/35

yang yang yid la dran byung /loragatso ba zugs song /nga tsho'i lung pa'i phu nas/gser gyi chu zhig thon byung /gser chu gang 'gro'i sa la/lo yag rtsa ba tshugs song /dbusakyi3rgulathon po/dbus kyi ri rgyal lhun po/ma 'gyur gtan la bzhugs dang /nyi ma zla ba'i 'khor phyogs/dbus kyi ri la 'khor song /bu mo ngaras zhu chogartsa ba tshugs pa'i sdong po/khyed kyis gnang gi yod na/tsha grang snyom pa'i bsil yab/bu mo nga ralozhu chogamachod chang mngar bsilaldan pa/mchod chang mngar bsil ldan pa/36

rag skyogs gser mdangs ldan pa/mchod mkhan stag shar gzhon pa/bkyag mkhan dman chung bu mo/chang rtsiston papod do/chang de btungs pa tshang ma/rus pa'i gting la sims song /shi nas rus pa skam pos/chang rtsi nyan pa yod do/glu blangs nas 'dug sa gang na yod/glu len na 'jig rten khams nas len/tshe phyi ma'i yul la glu len med/'di med tshul rgyu mtshan bshad gyur na/chang thigs pa tsam zhig med sa na/glu blangs nas 'dug sa gang na yod/dkar mo nasakyi bang mdzod/ston zla brgyad pa shar byung /btab pa'i lo tog smin song /dkar mo nas kyi bang mdzod/shar phyogs ri las mtho ba/37

'brurigasari ltaraspungasapod/zhing lasalo legs byung ste/'bru rigs ri ltar spungs yod/bang mdzod nas kyis khengs nas/'tsho ba phyug la bskyal song /ldemig g.yararogs gnang dang /glu gar gzhas kyi sgo mo/phye ru dgos kyi yod na/nga la rgyal sgo shar gyi/lde mig g.yar rogs gnang dang/lanazugasayo loyodared/ja layong rgyu ja ro/chang la yong rgyu sbang ma/nga rang gnyis la yong rgyu/lan chags o lo yod red/sku gzugs thang ba'irten 'brel/'bru 'di lo legs 'bru red/chu 'di rang yul gangs chu/38

de nas gsum sgron gnang dang /sku gzugs thang ba'i rten 'brel/da res bkra shisanyan mo/da res bkra shis nyin mor/mchod chang gtsang bzhes gnang dang /sang nyin las gsar sgrub pa'i/rten 'brel byed kyi yin no/spang bya gnangarogs gnang dang /de ring bkyag pa'i mchod chang /'dzem med ngang nas bzhes dang /nam zhag rgyun du mchod chang /spang bya gnang rogs gnang dang /phud gtor lan gsum gnang dang /dkar yol dkar sangs nang du/lo legs mchod chang blugs yod/'tsho ba bzang po'i phyogs la/phud gtor lan gsum gnang dang /39

khyed rang chu zhig khrid dngakakhyed rang chu zhig khrid dang /nga ras son zhig 'debs chogabasam pa mthun pa'i 'bras bus/zhim pa'i chang zhig btsos chogayo lo'i glu gar chig gsum/chang 'di 'thung ba'i mi la/yon tan mi 'dug ma gsungs/o lo'i glu gar tshigagasum/yon tan min na gang yin/kha btagasamanganas gangasang /kha btags mang nas gang yong /dkar gtsang gcig gis chog gagrogs po mang nas gang yong /blo thub gcig gis chog gasgra snyan gsung skad grags byung /sgra snyan gsung skad grags byung /'khrab mkhan gra sgrig tshar song /'khrab stangs rma bya las mdzes/40

thugs sems spro po 'dug gas/rma bya phebasakyiyod do/dbyar kha char pa'i dkyil la/rma bya phebs kyi ma red/dgun kha rlung gi dkyil la/rma bya phebs kyi ma red/ja chang 'di ru 'dzoms dus/rma bya phebs kyi yod do/dkar yolanang la gzigs dang /dkar yol dkar po'i nang la/chang gi nying khu blugs yod/bsam pa e dka ba ——— dkar yol nang 'chung 'dris 'khridan ngo tsha/chung 'dris 'khrid na ngo tsha/chung 'dris bskyur na sha tsha/chung 'dris phor pa yin na/am phrag nang la bcug 'gro/4na

mgyogs su 'dzoms pa'i chedayin/ring ba'i ske rags rjes shogami tshe ring ba'i ched yin/thung ba'i lham sgrog rjes shogamagyogs su 'dzoms pa'i ched yin/dar dang gos chen/dar dang gos chen zer ba/skad grags che na ma gtogs/dkar 'jam lus la dro ba/g.yang dkar wagu'i tsha ru/lo changanyang༅/nga'i lo changakham pa'i nying khu 'di/steng gong ma lha yi bdud rtsi yin/pha a khus btungs na dbu 'phang mtho/lce dar ma'i rgyud nas gtam sgo 'byed/nga'i zla chang bsil ma'i nying khu 'di/'chi med lha yi tshe chang yin/spun na zlas btungs na dpa' rtsal rgyas/glu kha mtshar ngag sgo 'di yis 'byed/42

gnam gyi༄nyagaḥr pa/gser gyi sa zhing sgang la/g.yu yi ljang pa 'khrungs bzhagaganam nas mu tig char pa/bab pa tsam gyis yag byung /la phugakha lo zhim pa/brag ri g.yang gzar can gyi/chu lo skyur mo mi za/de las zhing chung steng gi/la phug khalo zhim pa/loma'iskad red zhusayod/byams pas shing lo'i gseb nas/nga la gsang brda btang byung /pha mas su red gsungs dus/lo ma'i skad red zhus yod/chang dam 'bee gang dang nga brjes byung /nga'i pha mas nga la bsam ngan byas/chang dam 'bi gang dang nga brjes byung /chang ci 'dra zhim yang btungs tshar song /43

rang mi tshe gcig gi sdug sprad byung /lam bukhyedakyis bkag song /sgra snyan gling bu zer ba'i/snyan cha dod rang drags nas/bu mo chos la 'gro ba'i/lam bu khyed kyis bkag song /mjal 'dod thugs la 'dug ste/ma gzhi pha bzang bu khyod/mjal 'dod thugs la 'dug ste/chu srin dgra yi kha nas/thar ba'i dbang cha mi 'dugami chen gser gyi sdong po/gral 'go yar ru bzhugs pa'i/mi chen gser gyi sdong po/zhal nas tshig gsum gsungs pas/khams gsum zil gyis non song /sems pa'ikho thagacad pa/dkar yol dkar sangs gcig la/44

don med ser kha rgyug song /'o na hrug ste chag na/sems pa'i kho thag chod pa/hub 'thungargyag par thal song /la mo'i rgyab kyi chu de/dug chu yin pa ma shes/sha phrug snang ba 'khrul te/hub 'thung rgyag par thal song /phu thungarje bam gnangakamachod chang dang po mchod dus/glu dbyangs 'ur sgras khengs song /chang gzhug ma bsgril gong la/phu thung rdze ba ma gnang /chang gis blokhog bslabs byung /sems pa sla rang drags te/ chang gis blo khog bslabs byung /chung 'dris rnying pa yong dus/byed gte gling la bskyal byung /45

lo legasarten 'brel ched du/snye ma snye rdog gcig la/na4rdog gsum brgya drug cu/lo legs rten 'brel ched du/mchodacang gtsang bzhes gnang dang /mi dran dgu dran dran byung)dgong gcig chang gis bzi nas/mi 'jon khas len byas pas/sang nyin tho rengs tsam la/mi dran dgu dran dran byung /nam gzhug 'khyol ba gnang dang /skar ma smin drug 'dra ba'i/rub rub rang tsho mi 'dugabyang skar spun bdun 'dra ba'i/nam gzhug 'khyol ba gnang dang / la go ba skyon dang /gzhas de nga tsho'i gzhas red/lha sa'i bu mo'i gzhas red/gzhas la snyan cha med kyang /

tshig la go ba skyon dang /a zhimargun 'byamayodaged/khyed cag gang nas yin pa/nga cag gzhis kha rtse pa/gzhis kha rtse pa'i chang la/a zhim rgun 'brum yod red/mi che sang 'gro gnangs 'gro/chang la dga' nas gtsang bzhes/zhus pa rtsa nas min te/mi tshe sang 'gro gnangs 'gro/'gro yong bsams nas zhus yod/chang gisaja chumitan/ma gtang glu mos gang yong /glu mos za yas mi yong /mi 'thung chang gis gang yong /chang gis ja chu mi nyan/lnga glu snyan po gtang chogaglu zhig gtang dgos bsams nas/47

lba bas 'gags nas ma byung /lba ba 'gags pa yag byung /lba glu snyan po gtang chogadagu bcu ba nas bzhagayod/chang zhig btungs yod btungs yod/brgyad cu tham pa btungs yod/da dung phub ma'i 'og la/dgu bcu bsnyal nas bzhag yod/dpon bzangazag stodamathon po/dpon bzang brag stod mthon po/zhabasasbyi thang dkar rgod po/thang dkar rgod po'i blo gtad/brag stod mthon por bcol yod/am chang ma'inang la/a ma chang ma'i nang la/nor bu mi 'dug ma zer/ja khra gser gyi a long /nor bu min na gang red/

rag skyogs serakha dwangs pa/mchod chang mngar bsil ldan pa/rag skyogaloser kha dwangs pa/mchod mkhan stag sharagazhon pa/zhu mkhan dman chung bu mo/thigs changamed pa gnang dang /mchod chang zhal la mchod par/mchod lugs sne kha bco brgyad/gsum sgron mnyes dag gnang dang /thigs chang med pa gnang dang /yas bzed nyims bzhur song /khyed rang phebs yong bsams nas/chang la yas bzed brgyab yod/khyed rang phebs mkhan mi 'dugayas bzed nyi mas bzhur song /de la yon chab 'bul mkhan/ting de rgya ting bod ting /mchod gshom pad ma rā gde la yon chab 'bul mkhan/49

nga tsho ma gtogs su yin/bumo changashtsas brgyab songanayom chang la dga' nas/bu mo chang rtsis brgyabasong /a ma bsam blo thongs dang /bu mo chang las dga' 'gro/changang chuzhag skyon dang /gnasawa chang zhim bag gro/chang la chu zhigaskyon dang /mgron po sran ma'i me togaphyag tu phebs paganang dang /bzhugs grag brgyas dang po/kaci ras kyi dang po/rgya tshos tshos87dang po/ nga tsho'i 'go 'dren dpon po/bzhugs gral brgya yi dang po/gnas mo lha bya gongs/gnas khang gangs ri dkar po/50

gnas mo lha bya gong mo/'phur na gshog rtsal che ba/bzhugs na gsungagazhas snyan pa/bzasanamangarakha 'joms pa/nga tsho mched grogs lhan rgyas/bye ma ka ra'i shog chag ma bzas dri ma zhim pa/bzas na mngar kha 'dzoms pa/bugarilananganas zhus dngakamachod chang ga tshod 'dug gam/pug ril skyom skyom gnang dang /rang zhen mi zhen med par/pug ril nang nas zhus dang /dman lamadzes po chang ma dbyangs can yodaged/yul la skyid po gcig dang skyid po gnyis/yul la skyid po rtse thang gzhung la yod red/dman la mdzes po gcig dang mdzes po gnyis/dman la mdzes po chang ma dbyangs can yod red/51

thugs cag lhod tsam gnang dang /sa thag rgyang nas phebs pa'i/mgron po stag shar gzhon pa/phyag tu phebs pa yag byung /thugs cag lhod tsam gnang dang /pho zangajo chang 'dzoms pa/dbyar kha spang gshongs skyid pa/spang gshongasawā sna 'dzoms pa/dgun kha pho brang skyid pa/pho brang ja chang 'dzoms pa/lo chang bsnyalanas bzhagacabo/chang de dang po mchod dang /gnyis pa brgyab nas bzhag yod/nas phub sog ma'i 'og la/lo chang bsnyal nas bzhag yod/nas ni 'phyongasagrosanasared/mchod chang nam rgyun mchod nas/de ring mchod min ma gsungs/nas ni 'phyongs rgyas nas red/52

chu ni skal bzang yur chu/spang bami gnang gang yin/bdag gi zhus pa'i mchod chang /mi mchod gsung rgyu yod na/khyed rang nam zhag rgyun du/spang ba mi gnang gang yin/changakhang them pa lar 'thegs/chang khang them pa yar 'dzegs/dkar mo nas kyi rtsig pa/rtsig pa mtho ru ma gtogs/dma' ru 'gro sa ma red/snyema'i zhokha 'grigs song /zhing kha rgya zhing phra mo/snye ma'i zho kha 'grigs song /khrung dmag nyin mtshan ltag 'phrod/brgyab so chog ga yod do/nangs lhanargusamachod dngakad lo lo legs yag byung /53

'bru yis bang mdzod khengs song /lo legs yag pa'i mchod chang /nang mi lhan rgyas mchod dang /phan pa'i zan la 'grosang)mchod chang bzhes tsam byas na/phan pa'i sman la 'gro yong /tshod med ltogs 'thung brgyab na/gnod pa'i dug la 'gro yong /ra bziskyur 'gongami shod/gzhon pa'i bzhugs gralaphyogs la/'tshangs shig shig yong yod/ra bzi skyur 'gong mi shod/dam bca' bzhag nas yong yod/gnasamo'i sgocor 'grimasaphad/chang zhig 'thung dgos bsams nas/gnas mo'i sgo rtsar 'grims yod/chu zhig 'thung dgos byung na/rang yul zam pa'i 'og yod/54

bzi g.yog ngaras zhu chogang la chang zhig blugs dang /gnas mo rang yang mchod dang /gnas mo chang gis bzi na/bzi g.yog nga ras zhu chogayaraglungayakhya 'byog pa/chang gis bag tsam bzi song /yar klung a khu 'brog pa/ra bzi skyur 'gong med pa'i/dbu mna' bzhes nas phebs rogs/gluyimachod pa 'bul chogaganas shig bskor ba ma gtogs/mchod pa 'bul rgyu ma byung /bu mo na so gzhon pas/glu yi mchod pa 'bul chogabadud rtsi chang gicu mtsho/sgo mo phyi sgo yan chad/dkar mo 'bru yi bang mdzod/sgo mo nang sgo man chad/55

bdud rtsi chang gi rgya mtsho/'thung snying 'dod du 'dod du/chang de gcig btungs gnyis btungs/'thung snying 'dod du 'dod du/nga la bdud rtsi'i chang gi/skal ba mi 'gro bsam gyis/chang dngangakhas bsusayod/mgron po phar la thegs dus/'gros chen rta phos bskyel yod/mgron po tshur la phebs dus/chang dang ja khras bsus yod/gser mdangs ldan pa'imachod chang /gser mdangs ldan pa'i mchod chang /gsum sgron mnyes dag gnang dang /phan tshun 'gal ba med par/dga' dga' spro spro gnang dang /bla sgron reri dranabyung /zla ba sgrol mas bskur ba'i/56

pug ril nang gi mchod chang /mchod chang 'thung thengs re la/zla sgron re re dran byung /ra bzi glu gzhas lhangalhangakastag shar gzhon pas g.yas skyor/dman chung bu mos g.yon skyor/ra bzi glu gzhas lhang lhang /rang yul phyogs la log 'gro/bka'athran chen po gsol choga'agrul pa skom nas shi song /mchod chang mgyogs po snoms shogadus sang mjal rgyu byung na/bka' drin chen po gsol chogaganas chung btsogama'i chang las/gnas chung btsos ma'i chang las/gam pa'i bar chu zhim pa/bar chu zhim po los yong /chu sna lnga brgya'i chu red/57

gsung gzhagajage gnang dang /bzhugs gral mi re ngo res/gsung gzhas re re gnang dang /chang la bong bu chu 'thung /bskyon pa gnang nas gang yong /zhag gcig zhag gnyis lus song /'gro dgos 'gro dgos bsams nas/rta la rta'i sga brgyab yod/dga' ba'i mi zhig 'dzoms nas/zhagakonacig zhag gnyis lus song /kun5dga' g.yutsasde kamakhar chu gseragyi ri la/kun dga' g.yu yi pho brang /gzhon gzhon khrung dmag rgyag sa/skyid pa'ikhungs btsan lha khang /mchod chang bzhesapar phebs shigathagaring rgyang nas phebs pa'i/mi bzang gser gyi pho nya/khang bzang skyid po'i nang la/58

mchod chang bzhes par phebs shigardzam mgo la gon zhigachang de sla po ma red/nga ni sla pos bzi byung /khyed la mchod rtsal yod na/rdza ma mgo la gon zhigasgos gzhis phyogs la log 'gro/nga tsho'i dpon po lha red/dpon po'i chibs pa 'ja' red/'ja' la rta'i sga brgyab nas/sgos gzhis phyog4la log 'gro/sems pa'isdug bsngal bsangs song /dkar mo nas las btsos pa'i/zhim po'i mchod chang mngar mo/hob ste bltas pa tsam gyis/sems pa'i sdug bsngal bsangs song /dgra lasatag 'chi ba/nga tsho grogs po grogs mo/59

skyid po de 'dra yod na/dgra la mi rtag 'chi ba/med na de 'dra'i dga' la/dris phar zhim tshur zhim/khyed ni ba lu'i me togang ni su lu'i me togab lu su lu gnyis po/dri ma phar zhim tshur zhim/zhabasadza'i bangamadzod 'dra yod/gzhas dang zhabs bro'i phyogs la/rgyag rgyu med pa ma red/lung pa chang sa che bas/zhabs bro'i bang mdzod 'dra yod/'thung la shag shagayin 'gro/chang zhig mi 'thung zer ba/kha yi mdzes bzo yin 'gro/rgya mtsho kha la rag na/'thung la shag shag yin 'gro/

mun pa gsal du thongs dnganabazhu mar gru bzhi'i nang gi/sdong ras ka ci dkar po/dga' ba'i mi zhig 'dzoms dus/mun pa gsal du thongs dang /lhanacus snyan du gsol lo/phyug po'i a mas btang ba'i/chang gzhas mgrin gsang mthon po/rang sems skyid nas btang bas/lhan rgyas snyan du gsol lo/srunacached las༅nga brtse ba/phyi bkod klu yi pho brang /nang chas rin chen gser dngul/khang bzang nang du bzhugs mkhan/spun mched las kyang brtse ba/nag po brtsegs pa'i nyingakhu che yi gshed/don med ca co'i stong gtam chu ltar 'jo/dngos su brgya nas gcig las mi bden pa'i/brgya zur ngag gi nyes pa spang bar bya/61

nag po brtsegs pa'i nying khu tshe yi gshed/smyo chunyas pa'i gzhi dang gtan bral byos/btungs na mi ngoms de bas skom byed cing /lang du shor na srab mda' 'then dka' bas/gyod dang kha mchu'i rtsa ba chang rag ces/phyo chu nyes pa'i gzhi dang gtan bral byos/dga'askyid chang gzhas gtong ba'i phapul dran/dga' dga' skyid skyid dus kyi dga' ston tshe/mchor mchor rgyanagos bklubs pa'i pha yul mi/sgor sgor gzhas kyi gral la legs 'khod nas/dga' skyid chang gzhas gtong ba'i pha yul dran/mgo lanatsha gtangapongakaston ka shar ba'i du4la/rgyas za rgyas 'thung byas na/pad kha ser po shar dus/mgo la na tsha gtang yong /gtam bzangakhyeranasaslebs byungakapha ma bzang po'i o lo/62

dge rgan bzang po'i dge phrugs phyogs gang du phebs kyang /gtam bzang khyer nas slebs byung /tshosartse'ilhang casngonamo/chu mo shel las dwangs pa/gzhis rtse'i myang chu sngon mo/rag skyogs yu ba thung yang /len snying gzhan las 'dod pa/dkyil 'dzugs gnangarogs gnang dang /rtsa ba byu ru'i sdong po/lo ma g.yu yi me toga'abras bu mu tig bzhin du/dkyil 'dzugs gnang rogs gnang dang /tshe la bar chadam gtongakanyi ma sa chus 'phrod song /sprin gyis bar chad ma gtong /mi tshe skyid 'go tshugs song /tshe la bar chad ma gtong /63

yar shog yar phebs gsung gis/phyi de na bza' spu phruganang de byang chub sems pa/sa phyogs gang du phebs kyang /yar shog yar phebs gsung gis/nga tsho thugs sems dkar ba/phu ru gangs ri dkar ba/mda' ru mchod rten dkar ba/dkar po de 'dra'i dkyil du/nga tsho thugs sems dkar ba/bzhesarag skyid nyal skyon gyis/zhal dkar phyag tu bzhes dang /'brug khra phyag tu bzhes dang /zhal dkar 'brug khra'i nang nas/bzhes rag skyid nyal skyon gyis/yab chen shes bya'i sdong po/khang pa khang bkrag che la/dar cog tshon sna 'dzoms pa/de yi nang du bzhugs pa'i/64

yab chen shes bya'i sdong po/yarargus 'gro ba'i mchod chang /phyag sor g.yas pas bkyag na/g.yon ma hob 'khyog che ba/phyag sor g.yon mas bkyag na/g.yon ma phu thung thung bzhagalus sems gnyis kyis bkyag pa'i/mchod chang gtsang bzhes gnang dang /'tsho ba yar rgyas ma gtogs/mar rgyas 'gro sa ma red/yar rgyas 'gro ba'i mchod chang /mgron pos gtsang bzhes gnang dang /sim sem sim lamachod dang /gral 'go ya gir zhus dang /gser skyogs cha gcig zhus dang /gser skyogs gser kha dwangs pa/ldem ldem ldem la 'khyogs dang /gser skyogs gser kha dwangs pa/sem sim sem la mchod dang /gral dkyil 'di la zhus dang /65

g.yu skyogs cha gcig zhus dang /g.yu skyogs g.yu kha dwangs pa/ldem ldem ldem la 'khyogs dang /g.yu skyogs g.yu kha dwangs pa/sim sim sim la mchod dang /bzhugs gral ma gir zhus dang /rag skyogs cha gcig zhus dang /rag skyogs rag kha dwangs pa/ldem ldem ldem la 'khyogs dang /rag skyogs rag kha dwangs pa/sim sim sim la mchod dang /yab༅ma gnyis po gnas bzod bde ba/lho sprin zhig 'thibs byung /sbrang char gyi yag pa/lo yag ljang pa gnas bzod bde ba/gnas khang gi skyid pa/sras sros kyi yag pa/yab yum gnyis pobanas bzod bde ba/mchod chang gi bda' ba/ja khra yi yag pa/a ma chang ma gnas bzod bde ba/66

gnasakhang longs spyodakhang gsar/gnas khang longs spyod khang gsar/mtsho mo'i steng du bzhengs yod/mtsho kha mtho ru ma gtogs/dma' ru 'gro sa ma red/mtsho kha mtho ba'i steng du/gangs chu'i thigs pa brgyab byung /gangs chu'i thigs pa ma red/bdud rtsi'i thigs pa red 'dugarten 'brelamachod chang bzhes dang /phyi de dkar po 'bru yi/rtsig pa brtsigs nas bzhag yod/nang de ja chang spel ma'i/zhal dkar brgyangs nas bzhag yod/ja chang spel ma'i longs spyod/yar klungs gtsang chu 'dra song /lo legs bstud mar byung ba'i/rten 'brel mchod chang bzhes dang /67

khajo chang gi bsum/dgung sngon mo 'dra ba'i gnas khang zhiga'abrug pho skyong 'dra ba'i mgron po zhigachar zil ma 'dra ba'i bsu ma zhigayang yang bsu ba'i smon lam 'debs/rdza khra yag 'dra ba'i gnas khang zhiga'abrong bre ser 'dra ba'i mgron po zhigartswa rtsi tog 'dra ba'i bsu ma zhigayang yang bsu ba'i smon lam 'debs/mkhar g.yung drung 'dra ba'i gnas khang zhigaspun na zla 'dra ba'i mgron po zhigakha ja chang 'dra ba'i bsu ma zhigayang yang bsu ba'i smon lam 'debs/sa cha gang gi changayin/dri ba/chang dkar po dkar po dung mdog gos cha gang gi chang zhig red/chang ser po ser po gsar mdog gos cha gang gi chang zhig red/

chang sngon po sngon po g.yu mdog gos cha gang gi chang zhig red/dris lan/chang dkar po dkar po dung mdog gostod rgya gar yul gyi 'bras chang red/chang ser po ser po gser mdog gosmad rgya nag yul gyi gro chang red/chang sngon po sngon po g.yu mdog gotsha ba rong gi nas chang red/lhanacusaskukhams bzang song /nga tsho de ring 'dzom4song /lhan rgyas sku khams bzang song /khang gsar ka bzhi gdung brgyad/dga' spro'i gzhas kyi khengs song /'dzoms pa'i 'dzoms chang mchod dang /bzang ba'i bzang chang mchod dang /dga' skyid dpal la rol ba'i/skyid pa'i skyid chang mchod dang /69

nga tsho 'dir bzhugs lhan rgyas/sku gzugs brag las mkhregs pa/khyed rang gtsang bzhes gnang dang /bkra shis g.yang chags yod do/zhim po lasakyi bro yong /glu la a la la mo 'di tsho/ga le ga ler len shogasnyan po las kyi go yong /zhabs bro tshe ring 'brug rgyal 'di tsho/ga le ga ler rgyob shoga'agrig po las kyi mthong yong /mchod chang a rag bdud rtsi 'di tsho/ga le ga ler bzhes shigazhim po las kyi bro yong /gzhon pa nga cho'i gnas bzod/'u cag gzhas la mnyes zer na/ 'u cag zhabs phyi zhu choga'u cag phyogs la ma mnyes na/'u cag dgongs pa zhu chogagaser gyi mda' mo gtong zer na/70

mda' mo zhig gtang chogagayu yi gzhu mo bkug zer na/gzhu mo zhig bkug chogamada' mo zhig btang yod/gzhu mo zhig bkug yod/mda' mo las kyang bde ba/gzhu mo las kyang gug pa/gzhon pa nga tsho'i gnas bzod/'grigs pa rnams la 'grigs chang zhus/yar dgung sangs mthon po/phar shig tshur shig gnang shogadagung sangs rin chen nyi ma/grongagacig grong gnyis grong la nyan pa'i rgyan cha/gcig gnyis gsum byas nas 'grigs/sngon mo'i chang las zhim pa ma zer/bu mo'i glu las snyan pa ma zer/nyan pa rnams la nyan chang zhus/gzhon pa'i gzhas las 'grigs pa med/ 'grigs pa rnams la 'grigs chang zhus/ 'grigs chang khrung phor kho na zhus/ngang pa byang la 'gro gis zer/71

ngang phrug g.yas skor rgyag gis zer/gzhon pa nga las skyid pa mi 'duga.a cag he/sdod sa 'di las dga' ba mi 'dugasdod sa 'di las skyid pa mi 'dugagazhon pa nga las dga' ba mi 'dugagazhon pa nga las skyid pa mi 'dugamachod chang 'di las spro ba mi 'dugamachod chang 'di las zhim pa mi 'dugabatang bzhag tshe ring /gsum rgyag yod la/changade zhim po dgosan/chang de zhim po dgos na/snyom pa rnam gsum yod dgos/thab de tshos lod snyom dgos/phabs de mang nyung snyom dgos/snyol dus drod grang snyom dgos/de gsum 'dzoms pa byung na/chang la bro ba slebs yong /72

chang de zhim po dgos na/'dzoms pa rnam gsum yod dgos/chang rgyu nas rdog khra ril/chang rtsi zhim mngar ldan pa/'debs chu bdud rtsi'i snying po/de gsum 'dzoms pa'i chang la/zhim mngar bro ba slebs yong /rgyan cha/shar phyogs kyi rgyan cha/shar gyi skar ma smin drugashar phyogs kyi rgyan cha/lho phyogs kyi rgyan cha/lho yi skar ma pa sangs/lho phyogs kyi rgyan cha/nub phyogs kyi rgyan cha/nub kyi skar ma nor bdaganub phyogs kyi rgyan cha/byang phyogs kyi rgyan cha/byang gi skar ma spun bdun/byang phyogs kyi rgyan cha/dgung sngon gyi rgyan cha/73

nyi ma zla ba skar ma/dgung sngon gyi rgyan cha/dgung 'og gi rgyan cha/rtswa dang rtsi shing me togadagung 'og gi rgyan cha/stag shar gyi rgyan cha/ me lcags rgya lcags srog bcad/stag shar gyi rgyan cha/dman chungagi rgyan cha/g.yu dang byu ru spos shel/dman chung gi rgyan cha/'dzoms shoga'adzoms shog 'dzoms shogagangs ri mthon po'i dkyil la 'dzoms shogaseng ge dkar mo g.yu ral lan mo shig zer 'dzoms shoga'adzoms shog 'dzoms shogardza stod mthon po'i dkyil la 'dzoms shoga'abrong chung rog mo rwa rub ngoms shing zhig dang 'dzoms shoga'adzoms shog 'dzoms shog74

sde chen khra mo'i dkyil la 'dzoms shogapho gzhon mo gzhon do ra khra mo'i dkyil la 'dzoms shogagasung dang g.yas skor/gsung dang g.yas skor la/khyed tsho'i rgya gar shar la ci 'dra yod/nga tsho'i rgya gar shar la rma bya yod/khyed tsho'i rma bya'i lus la ci 'dra yod/nga tsho'i rma bya'i lus la sgro mdongs yod/gsung dang g.yas skor la/khyed tsho'i lho rong gzhung la ci 'dra yod/nga tsho'i lho rong gzhung la ne tso yod/khyed tsho'i ne tso'i lus la ci 'dra yod/nga tsho'i ne tso'i lus la mngon shes yod/gsung dang g.yas skor la/khyed tsho'i lcang gling shar la ci 'dra yod/nga tsho'i lcang gling shar la byi'u chung yod/khyed tsho'i byi'u chung lus la ci 'dra yo da/nga tsho'i byi'u chung lus la gsung skad yod/75

gsung dang g.yas skor la/nga tsho'i byi'u chung gsung skad ngoms shing 'gro/rang yul skyid pa'i phyogs la log nas 'gro/nga cho 'dzoms pa'irten 'brel/khyed rnam pa gangs stod mthon po/nged rnam pa seng ge dkar mo/dus de ring 'dzoms pa'i rten 'brel/skor ba g.yas skor rgyob shogardog sgra g.yon skor sgrigs shog/khyed rnam pa rdza stod mthon po/nged rnam pa 'brong chung rog mo/dus de ring 'dzoms pa'i rten 'brel/skor ba g.yas skor rgyob shogardog sgra g.yon skor sgrigs shogakhyed rnam pa brag stod mthon po/nged rnam pa bya rgyal rgod po/dus de ring 'dzoms pa'i rten 'brel/skor ba g.yas skor rgyob shogardog sgra g.yon skor sgrigs shog76

gnas 'di gangs dkararta se/gnas 'di gangs dkar ti se chags song zer na/mtsho ni ma pham g.yu mtsho mi khengs pa mi 'dugamatsho 'di ma pham g.yu mtsho khengs song zer na/lo yag ljang pa'i rtsa ba mi tshugs pa mi 'dugalo yag ljang pa'i rtsa ba tshugs song zer na/dkar mo'i nas kyi bang mdzod mi khengs pa mi 'dugadakar mo'i nas kyi bang mdzod khengs song zer na/a ma chang ma'i chang sa mi dar ba mi 'dugachu mo bzhi/chu 'di seng ge gtsang po la dwags gzhung la rgyugs song /la dwags mnga' ris kham bu de la brten nas byung song / chu 'di glang chen kha bab rtsa mda' gzhung la rgyugs song /rtsa mda' 'bru sna 'dzoms pa de la brten nas byung song /chu 'di rma bya gtsang po pu rang gzhung la rgyugs song /pu rang chang sa dar po de la brten nas byung song /chu 'di rta mchog kha bab skyid rong gzhung la rgyugs song /skyid rong nags tshal stug po de la brten nas byung song /77

me tog lnga ldan/me tog gcig tsam zhigadakar po'i gangs la 'bul/nga tsho 'dir bzhugs shigazhal ras gangs las dkar/grong pa sde tshogs shigazhal dung gangs las dkar/me tog gnyis tsam zhigamathon po'i brag la 'bul/nga tsho 'dir bzhugs shigasku 'tsho brag las mkhregs/grong pa sde tshogs shigasku 'tsho brag las mkhregs/me tog gsum tsam zhigastug po'i nags la 'bul/nga tsho 'dir bzhugs shigami dpung nags las stugagrong pa sde tshogs shigami dpung nags las stug78

me tog bzhi tsam zhigasngon mo'i chu la 'bul/nga tsho 'dir bzhugs shigami rgyud chu las ring /grong pa sde tshogs shigami rgyud chu las ring /me tog lnga tsam zhiga'og phyogs klu la 'bul/nga tsho 'dir bzhugs shigargyu nor klu las 'dzoms/grong pa sde tshogs shigargyu nor klu las 'dzoms/bzang po gsum gyi zhal 'dzoms/sa gzhi ma gir gzigs dang /bzang po gsum gyi zhal 'dzoms/ gcig tu dkar mo nas 'bru/gnyis su khyung dkar mdzo bo/gsum du gnya' shing thong gshol/ bzang po gsum gyi zhal 'dzoms/79

bzhugs gral ya gir gzigs dang /bzang po gsum gyi zhal 'dzoms/gcig tu yab chen a pha/gnyis su yum chen a ma/gsum du bu dang mna' ma/bzang po gsum gyi zhal 'dzoms/nam mkha' yar la gzigs dang /gcig tu dro 'jam nyi ma/gnyis su skal bzang zla ba/gsum du smal po smin drugabazang po gsum gyi zhal 'dzoms/gral stodalar la zhus dngakagral stod yar la zhus dang /gser skyogs cha gcig zhus dang /gral stod 'go 'dren dpon pos/gser skyogs cha la mnyes song /gral dkyil 'di la zhus dang /dngul skyogs cha gcig zhus dang /gral dkyil stag shar gzhon pa/

dngul skyogs cha la mnyes song /gral smad mar la zhus dang /rag skyogs cha gcig zhus dang /gral smad snyoms chung bu mo/rag skyogs cha la mnyes song /skal bzang bden pa lags/skal bzang bden pa lags/yab kyi mtshan la ga re zhu/kun bzang bde chen zhu/skal bzang bden pa lags/yum gyi mtshan la ga re zhu/snang gsal gsal sgron zhu/skal bzang bden pa lags/yab yum gnyis la 'khrungs pa'i/bu chung tho rengs skar chen/skal bzang bden pa lags/de la zhabs 'degs zhu mkhan/81

mdzes ma smal po'i gzhug skyes/dkar ba byasan dkar bas/dkar ba byas na dkar bas/kha btags dkar kha gtsang bas/do dgong bzhugs gral sgor mo/dkar ba'i ngang la bzhugs dang /'dzoms pa byas na 'dzoms pas/mda' dar tshon sna 'dzoms pas/do dgong bzhugs gral sgor mo/'dzoms pa'i ngang la bzhugs dang /legs pa byas na legs pas/gos chen ri mo legs pas/do dgong bzhugs gral sgor mo/legs pa'i ngang la bzhugs dang /sa gzhi pad ma'i steng na/sa gzhi pad ma'i steng na/rgya cog rkang bzhi btsugs yod/rgya cog rkang bzhi'i steng na/82

gser gyi rdza phor bzhag yod/gser gyi rdza phor steng na/khrung skyogs lha bya gong mo/bzhes mkhan stag shar gzhon pa/ngang pa mtsho la rog rogazhus mkhan dman chung bu mo/rma bya'i sgro mdongs shig shigagasag gsag gsag la zhus dang /sku gzugs yar la 'jags pa/chang la skyid pa'i glu/mgron po phyogs lasteng phyogs lha nas phebs pa'i/mgron po sran ma'i me togaphyag tu phebs pa yag byung /thugs gzhi lhod tsam gnang dang /go 'phang mthon po'i phyogs la/phyi de na bza' rgya mo/nang de byang chub sems dpa'/sa phyogs ga par phebs kyang /yar shog yar phebs yin pa/83

grogs po phyogs lang la grogs po dgos yod/grogs po blo thub dgos yod/grogs po blo thub byung na/gser bzang brgya las lhag pa/yab yum labrag de rdo rje brag la/rgod pos rgod tshang bsags yod/rgod po sku tshe ring shogargod phrug gnas bzod bde ba/chung roṭa soṭa rang las dma' ba'i gras lang tsho chung chung rogs rogs/bya mo dkar mo'i sgo nga /sgo ngar gas chag ma gtong /rang yul phyogs la log 'gro/ngo mi shes pa'i mi lasngar song zhal yang ma tshor/da cha mjal 'phrad 'dod pa/

mjal 'phrad 'dod pa'i mi la/snyun gzhi god chag ma gtong /yun ring gshibs pa'i mi lasngar song snga mo'i mi byas/srid pa chags pa'i rdo byas/rdo la dreg pa chags kyang /mjal 'dod gzhan las 'dod pa/blor yod bu morabrag la 'dzegs rgyu yin pas/brag lam ston rogs gnang dang /blo gtad bcol rgyu yin pas/byams skyong gnang rogs gnang dang /lo chung mdzes marabya de chung la mdzes pa/gong dkar g.yu bya sngon mo/bya byi'u mang po'i dkyil du/g.yu bya 'dra ba mi 'dugamagron po zhal 'gyes khar85

phebs mkhan mda' mo yin zer/mda' la ya yor ma gtong /bzhugs mkhan gzhu mo yin zer/gzhu la gas chag ma gtong /'di nas bltas pas nyi ma'i shar phyogs na/'di nas bltas pas nyi ma'i shar phyogs na/lha yi sras mo rigs bzang mkha' 'gro bzhugs/phyag la g.yon du bkra shis rtags brgyad bsnams/phyag la g.yas su tshe dbang bum pa bsnams/bkra shis rtags brgyad bkra la shis pa shogatshe dbang bum pa sku tshe ring ba shogamakha' 'gro de ru ma bzhugs yar la phebs/gnas khang yar la phywa dang g.yang so zhugs/chang bdud rtsi pha dang akhur 'dren/rdza mgo ri mgo gangs kyis bzung /gangs kha ba bzhur nas chang la 'gyur/chang bdud rtsi pha dang a khur 'dren/rdza sked ri sked nags kyi rdzong /shing lo ma rgyas nas ja la 'gyur/

ja yu dmar spun dang na zlar 'dren/rdza 'dabs ri 'dabs nas kyi rdzong /nas drug mang sbrang dkar rtsam pas logazas zhim po ma dang sro mor 'dren/na zla chogs sa/stod gan ni seng ge 'gyings sa red/seng g.yu ral 'dzoms pa'i glu zhig len/bar 'di ni na zla tshogs sa red/spun na zla skyid pa'i glu zhig len/zhol 'di ni ma sru tshogs sa red/zas ja chang 'dzoms pa'i glu zhig len/gzhi gcig la 'dus pa smon lam red/spang gcig la 'dus pa'i rta brgya tsho/spang gcig la 'dus pa smon lam red/rtswa ram dkar zos nas skyid cig yod/rdza gcig la 'dus pa'i 'brong brgya tsho/87

rdza gcig la 'dus pa smon lam red/rtswa spra thog zos nas skyid cig yod/khrom gcig la tshogs pa'i na zla tsho/sde gcig la 'dzoms pa smon lam red/chang bdud rtsi btungs nas skyid cig yod/glu pamagron la 'bod pa/dgung sngon mo tshang gi ston mo yin/'brug pho skyong 'dra ba'i mgron po la/char zil ma lta bus bsu ba byed/rdza khra yag tshang gi ston mo yin/'brong ru dmar 'dra ba'i mgron po la/spang me tog lta bus bsu ba byed/pha a khu tshang gi ston mo yin/glu pa 'bod nas mgron la bsgugs/chang bdud rtsi zil mas bsu ba byed/smadacu nag 'bras chang bsilam/gser ser po'i rang mdangs shar 'dra ba/

stod dbus gtsang yul gyi gro chang red/pha a khus chang kha dal mos byos/g.yu sngon po'i rang mdangs shar 'dra ba/bod tsho drug gling gi nas chang red/phyi mgron pos chang kha dal mos byos/dung dkar po'i rang mdangs shar 'dra ba/smad rgya nag yul gyi 'bras chang red/spun na zlas chang kha dal mos byos/zasamangar gsum 'dzoms pa'i glu zhig len/gral 'go bskor re glu zhig len/kha ja chang 'dzoms pa'i skyid glu len/mgo la thod can gyis glu lan rdzogs/gral sked bskor re glu zhig len/lus dpa' rtsal 'dzoms pa'i skyid glu len/mgo wa gor can gyis glu lan rdzogs/gral rnga bskor re glu zhig len/zas mngar gsum 'dzoms pa'i skyid glu len/89

rgyab dung ra can gyis glu lan rdzogs/'chi med lha yi che chang yin/nga'i lo chang kham pa'i nying khu 'di/steng gong ma lha yi bdud rtsi yin/pha a khus btungs na dbu 'phang mtho/lce dar ma'i rgyud nas gtam sgo 'byed/nga'i zla chang bsil ma'i nying khu 'di/'chi med lha yi tshe chang yin/spun na zlas btungs na dpa' rtsal rgyas/glukha mtshar ngag sgo 'di yis 'byed/rtagatu dga' byud glu len bkra shis shogaphun sum tshogs pa'i rin chen khang bzang nang /bkra shis gos bzang las grub 'bol gdan la/yum chen a ma mi 'gyur brtan par bzhugs/'bras chang bsil mngar bdud rtsi'i 'thung snod 'di/shar phyogs rgyal khab chen po'i bang mdzod nas/thon pa'i bkra shis dkar sangs yu ring yin/'di nang byur bur bkang ba'i bdud rtsi'i bcud/bde legs 'thung ba'i mchog 'di dgyes bzhes nas/

rtag tu dga' skyid glu len bkra shis shogachang gzhan dang mi 'drartsa chen yin/lag g.yas kyi zhal dkar yu ring 'di/shar rgya nag bkra shis khri skor nas thon/tshong dpon nor bu bzang po la/byung yang gling dkar stod nas byung /zhal dkar nang gi bdud rtsi 'di/rgya gar yul gyi bur chang yin/rgya nag yul gyi rgun 'brum chang /lho 'bras mo ljongs kyi 'bras chang yin/ bod dkar mo 'bru yi lo chang yin/chang gzhan dang mi 'dra rtsa chen yin/don sku mgron khyed tsho'i zhal du gsol/skar chogs smin drugamajal byung /bzhugs gral g.yas su phyin pas/chang tshod lnga brgya mjal byung /ma mjal khong dang mjal byung /mchod chang bdud rtsi mjal byung /mi mjal bsam pa mjal byung /91

seng lcam 'brug mo mjal byung /nam mkha' ya ru phyin pas/skar tshogs smin drug mjal byung /gnasakhangakhams gsum dbang 'dus/g.yas na stag gdan gting yod/g.yon na gzig gdan gting yod/stag gdan gzig gdan sgang la/bzhugs mkhan khams gsum dbang 'dus/ja chang 'dod rgu'iyongs spyod/khang bzang 'di la bab song /khams gsum dbang gi grogs pos/dgra bo zil gyis mnan song /skal ba bzang songakaskal bzang skal ba bzang song /bstan pa 'dzin rogs gnang dang /gser gyi gsol cog sgang la/dngul gyi nee tso babs song /skyid pa'i ja chang spel ma'i/mngon shes shod rogs gnang dang /92

bkra shis shoga'agro mkhan mi la bkra shis shogasdod mkhan mi la g.yang chags shogabakra shis g.yang chags gnyis la 'gyur ba med/gal srid 'gyur ba byung na dgra la 'gyur/khyod sdod mkhan mi de ri dang 'dra/ri bo 'gyur ba med pa brtan par shogang 'gro mkhan mi de chu dang 'dra/chu mo 'gog rkyen med par shar rer 'gro/mid pa shel gyimachodarten/gang ni g.yas la langs song /do ni g.yon la langs song /snga na snga ba'i snga chang yod/phyi na phyi ba'i phyi chang yod/mid pa shel gyi mchod rten/krog ze krog ze gnang dang /chang gang mchod gang la mnyes po gnang /yang do mchod do la mnyes po gnang /chang mi 'thung glu yang mi len/93

de 'dra srol la mi 'dugaza ri zi ri ma gnang /pā lags kyis bka' bkyon gnang yong /a ma lags kyis phyag 'jug gnang yong /gser gyija ma/a cag he/dkar mo shar gyi tshe ring /gsum skyogs yod la/rdza ma rdza ma gser gyi rdza ma/thim bu thim bu dngul gyi thim bu/'thung chog 'thung chog bdag gis 'thung chogamachod chang a rag bdud rtsi de tsho/mchod mkhan tsho la re re/mi mchod pa la do do/ra bzi skyur 'gong shod mkhan de tshor/thigs pa re re 'khyogs shiga.a cag he/btang bzhag tshe ring /gsum rgyag yod do/

mchod chang a rag bdud rtsi/glu la a la la mo 'di tsho/ga le ga ler len shogasnyan po las kyis thos yong /zhabs bro tshe ring 'brug rgyal 'di 'tsho/ga le ga ler rgyob shogasgrigs su las kyis mthong yong /mchod chang a rag bdud rtsi 'di tsho/ga le ga ler bzhes dang /zhim po las kyis bro yong /yocun bum bzangakasgyu rin chen sna lnga las grub pa'i/ 'khyil bzhugs o rgyan gyi bum bzang 'di/phyi bltas ri bo nang bltas rgya mtsho 'dra/mar dkar ser gyi yar ga lnga dang ldan/gting na lo chang gar ma yod/bar na 'bras chang bsil ma yod/kha na a rag bdud rtsi yod/'di na bzhugs gral rnams tsho dga' ba la/a la la ho/skyid pa la/95

gral stodalar la gzigs dang /gral stod yar la gzigs dang /zhal dkar sngo khra shig shigasngo khra lan mo ri mo las yag gagral dkyil 'di la gzigs dang /mchod zhal rdzab ya shig shigardzab ya lan mo ri mo las yag gagral mjug mar la gzigs dang /chang dang ja khra shig shigaja khra lan mo a long las yag gagaser gyi bya zhig babasasad/yal ga dang po'i sgang la/gser gyi bya zhig babs yod/gser bya legs po cha gcig babs bzhagagaser gyi bya de'i zhal nas /gser gyi rgya gling gyur shogargya gling gser khra shig shig

yal ga gnyis pa'i sgang la/g.yu yi bya zhig babs yod/g.yu bya legs po cha gcig babs bzhagagayu yi bya de'i zhal nas/g.yu yi rgya gling gyur shogargya gling g.yu khra shig shigayal ga gsum pa'i steng la/dung gi bya zhig babs bzhagadung khra legs po cha gcig babs bzhagadung gi bya yi zhal nas/dung gi rgya gling gyur shogargya gling dung khra shig shigaskyes phorab po 'bring pho tha gsum/skyes pho rab pho 'bring pho tha gsum/skyes pho rab chang zhig 'thung zer na/sku zil pa phrum mer gnyid du yur/skyes pho rab pho 'bring pho tha gsum/skyes pho 'bring chang zhig 'thung ba'i dus/chang kha yis mi 'thung blo yis 'thung /glu gar sems bskor gtong nas sdod/97

skyes pho rab pho 'bring pho tha gsum/pho tha ma chang zhig 'thung ba'i dus/chang kha yis mi 'thung snying gis 'thung /snying nag rtsa nag rgyas nas sdod/gri nag mdung nag 'jus nas sdod/tsir re 'ur re 'khon nas sdod/khyed gnyis gsungs dang ngayis nyan/nga gnyen po yong ba'i yong tshul la/rta ri nas phab mkhan g.yog pos phab/rta mgo nas bzung mkhan g.yog pos bzung /rta sga sga chas pha dang bu yis brgyab/bro kha lam rgyags ma dang sru mos bsdogs/gtam dang kha lce rang gis shes kyi yod/ri rtse gsum la gser zhwa gyon pa'i dus/nga gnyen po rta la gzhon nas yong /rin chen phreng ba bgrang bgrang dang /thang chen gshog rgya rdeb rdeb byas/chu chen rta rnga bcad ltar yong /nga de nas yar la yong ba'i dus/na mar sman rtswa 'dra ba'i sgo nga dang /ri glang chen 'dra ba'i 'gying zur nas/98

rgya lam dar bting bzhin gyi yangs steng thogami bo rin chen rnams kyis bsu ma byung /'do ba khyu mchog dag gis bsu ma byung /bdud rtsi'i chang dang ja khras bsu ma byung /mi bo rin chen rnams la dar dkar bsgron/bdud rtsi'i ja chang mchod ka byas nas yong /'do ba rlung gshog 'di la che bstod byas/nga de nas yar la yong ba'i dus/brgya drel smug chung dag gis bsu ma byung /cang shes 'do ba khyu yi kha rgyan gda'/nga de nas yar la yong ba'i dus/khyung dkar mdzo khyu dag gis bsu ma byung /grangs med nag chung nor gyi kha rgyan gda'/nga de nas yar la yong ba'i dus/grangs med g.yang dkar lug khyus bsu ma byung /spu bzang tshe tshe ra yi kha rgyan gda'/nga de nas yar la yong ba'i dus/sa pad ma 'dab brgyad kyi yangs steng dang /gnam 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad kyi mar gsham na/mkhar g.yang chags gru bzhi'i nang tshud nas/chang 'dren bu mo spun gnyis phebs nas byung /khyed gnyis phebs pa'i don dag gang yin nam/99

phebs nas bsu rgyu gang yod dam/khyed gnyis gsungs dang nga yis nyan/bsu chang gi gzhas/nyi ma gang nas phebs pa/shar gyi phyogs nas phebs pa/'dzam bu gling gi sa gzhi/sro ba tsam gyis yag byung /zla ba gang nas phebs pa/mtshan mo'i gzhung nas phebs pa/'dzam bu gling gi mun pa/gsal ba gnang bas yag byung /g.yu 'brug gang nas phebs pa/bar snang dbyings nas phebs byung /'dzam gling char chu 'dren par/phebs pa tsam gyis skyid byung /smin drug gang nas phebs pa/dgung sngon lho nas phebs byung /'dzam gling nam stod ston par/phebs pa tsam gyis dga' byung /smal po gang nas phebs pa/dgung sngon shar nas phebs byung /100

'dzam gling nam dkyil ston par/phebs pa tsam gyis skyid byung /skar chen gang nas phebs pa/dgung sngon shar nas phebs byung /'dzam gling tho rengs ston par/phebs pa tsam gyis dga' byung /seng ge gang nas phebs pa/tsa ri'i gangs nas phebs byung /'dzam gling g.yu ral ngom par/phebs pa tsam gyis dga' byung /rma bya gang nas phebs pa/nags kyi dkyil nas phebs byung /'dzam gling sgro mdongs ngom par/phebs pa tsam gyis skyid byung /khu byug gang nas phebs pa/lho mon phyogs nas phebs byung /'dzam gling gsung snyan sgrog par/phebs pa tsam gyis dga' byung thang dkar gang nas phebs pa/brag stod mtho nas phebs byung /'dzam gling gshog rtsal ngom par/phebs pa tsam gyis dga' byung /101

mi pho gang nas phebs pa/gling dkar stod nas phebs byung /bzhugs gral gral 'go len par/phebs pa tsam gyis skyid byung /bzhugs gral kha zheng che la/ja chang longs spyod 'dzoms pa/mi pho'i bsam don grub song /bzhugs gral bskor nas log 'gro/rma byas logashkadachug gis/gzim chung shel khra'i nang nas/rma byas log skad rgyag gis/chu dang 'o ma 'dres kyang /ma 'dres mdog mdog gnang gis/snying gtam de ring shod dang /chung 'dris sang nyin 'gro na/snying gtam de ring shod dang /'gro kha la mo'i snying gtam/mid pa 'gag rogs yin 'gro/102

rgyun chad med pa gnang dang /sngon chad ri bo bzhin du/btsugs pa 'dra gcig gnang byung /da cha chu bo bzhin du/rgyun chad med pa gnang dang /phus lha bya gongs/phu gsum phu ru bzhugs pa'i/phu yi lha bya gong mo/'phur na gshog rtsal che ba/bzhugs na gsung skad snyan pa/g.yuyi sgrol ma gsung byon/gral 'go gser la bcol yod/gser sku phyag na rdo rje/gral sked g.yu la bcol yod/g.yu yi sgrol ma gsung byon/gser gyi ri la bcolayod/dpon po gser gyi ri la/zhabs phyi thang dkar rgod po/thang dkar rgod po'i blo gtad/103

gser gyi ri la bcol yod/g.yang dkar ma mo'i sgos gzhis/byang thang lhas ra gru bzhi/g.yang dkar ma mo'i sgos gzhis/lhas ra nyi ma dro la/g.yang mo bal gshis 'jam pa/bgres songakhong la phul dang /phyug po'i a ma bag gros/btsos pa'i yid gsal bdud rtsi/zhal dkar yar la btegs te/bgres song khong la phul dang /dkar mo nas kyi rtsig pa/shar mgo pad ma rā gdakar mo nas kyi rtsig pa/skyid pa'i ja chang spel ma/g.yu mtsho 'khyil nas bsdad yod/sems can spu gra legs pa/ri de g.yang chags ri la/104

rtswa la sman rtswa skyes yod/sems can spu gra legs pa/g.yang chags ri la phebs shogabu mo byi'u chung ma red/bde legs lcang gzhongs ma red/bu mo byi'u chung ma red/gsung bshad rgya gling kyur kyur/tshe sngon las la bkod song /ma brisari mo legs pa/ma bris ri mo legs pa/sems can stag gi ri mo/bris te 'gyur ldog med pa/lha khang gsar pa'i logs ris/chung chung chung la mdzes pa/dbyar gyi bya pho me togadabyar gyi sgro mdog bcad song /dgun gyi bang mdzod rgyongs shogache la bar chad ma gtong /dga' ldan dbang bskur ri la/105

gru'u tse mtshal kha'i dbu lcogachar pa lo gsum bab kyang /tshos gzhi 'gyur ba mi 'dugs cha nyi mas dros song /sprin gyis bar chad ma gtong /mi tshe skyid 'go tshugs song /tshe la bar chad ma gtong /bumo gser gyirang byon/sku stod gangs ri dkar po/sku smad ma pham g.yu mtsho/gangs mtsho gnyis las 'khrungs pa'i/bu mo gser gyi rang byon/blo gtad bcol nyan dod song /yar gyi gangs ri'i rtse la/la btsas gsol nyan dod song /gnyen tshan khyed tsho'i phyogs la/blo gtad bcol nyan dod song /'gyur ba yong sa ma red/zhim po btsos pa'i chang yin/106

dga' po byas pa'i gnyen yin/lo zla mang po song yang /'gyur ba yong sa ma red/puru gcig la 'gril shogachang 'di lding ga gcig la/pu ru nyi shu rtsa lnga/dam tshig gtsang ma yod na/pu ru gcig la 'gril shogadabye ba chod༄ mi 'dugachang ni chang rang zhim song /glu ni glu rang snyan song /chang dang glu gzhas gnyis la/dbye ba chod pa mi 'dugaskyid pa'i glu re gnang dngakashar gyi mi yang 'dzoms song /nub kyi mi yang 'dzoms song /'dzoms pa'i bkra shis sgang la/skyid pa'i glu re gnang dang /107

skyid po lasakyis shar yongakas de grib red ma gsungs/nyi ma las kyis shar yong /sdug po sdug po ma gsungs/skyid polas kyis shar yong /glu dang glu sgras khengs songakagayas la g.yas gral bsgrigs yod/g.yon la g.yon gral bsgrigs yod/nga yi khang chung nang du/glu dang glu sgras khengs song /ri bo de la yin no/ri de g.yang chags ri la/rtswa sna chu sna 'dzoms yod/ri dwags skyid nyal rgyag sa/ri bo de la yin no/sems pa'i me tog sharayong /ya gi'i gangs ri'i rtse la/byi'u chung skal bzang sgrol ma/thugs sems skyo skyo ma gnang /108

ba lu'i me tog shar yong /ba lu'i me tog yal kyang /su lu'i me tog shar yong /su lu'i me tog yal kyang /sems pa'i me tog shar yong /bdudañtsa sman gyimachod pa/'u ras lung pa'i phu la/sangs rgyas mi la ras pa/bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa/ka pā la nas phul yod/khrung bzhes bskyon la phebs dang /shar nas dpon bzang phebs byung /dpon bzang dbus nas phebs byung /de ring gzim chung steng la/khrung bzhes bskyon la phebs dang /bzhes khrunga.a rag bdud rtsi/rgya cog rkang bzhi'i steng la/gser gyi lan mo cha gcigagaser gyi lan mo'i nang la/109

bzhes khrung a rag bdud rtsi/ma 'gyur gtan la bzhugs dang /gser gyi zam pa ring po/ma 'gyur gtan la bzhugs dang /gangs dkar steng gi chu sne/ri klung brgal nas slebs yong /don yod zhags pa dgos so/gser gyi ri la 'dzeg dus/g.yu yi skas 'dzeg dgos kyis/yid 'phrog mdzes ma zin dus/don yod zhags pa dgos so/a ma'i bsu chang bzhes dang /ya gi'i gangs stod mthon po/mnga' thang rgyas lod 'dug gam/ya gi'i rdza stod mthon po/mnga' thang rgyas lod 'dug gam/ ya gi'i spang stod mthon po/mnga' thang rgyas lod 'dug gam/110
