ya gi'i gangs stod mthon po/mnga' thang rgyas po yod do/ya gi'i rdza stod mthon po/mnga' thang rgyas po yod do/ya gi'i spang stod mthon po/mnga' thang rgyas po yod do/la mo stag la'i la rtser/ma ma'i bsu chang bzhes dang /kha la nyan pa'i bu chung /mchod zhal rdzab ya bzhes dang /yar ga tshang ba'i lnga ldan/chang gi go ba bzhes dang /sbrang char bsilam 'bab pa'i gtam bzang yod/glang chung sbrul gyis skad re brgyab/'dzam gling sa bcud dros pa'i gtam bzang yod/dbyar zla dang po shar zer na/g.yu 'brug ngar bas skad re brgyab/sbrang char bsil ma 'bab pa'i gtam bzang yod/ston zla dang po shar zer na/a ma chang mas skad re 'don/111

gang 'dod 'bru yis khengs dus gtam bzang 'bul rgyu yod do/gnas bzang po/gnas la bzang po gcig dang bzang po gnyis/gnas la bzang po gangs dkar ti se bzhugs/rten la bzang po gcig dang bzang po gnyis/rten la bzang po bka' 'gyur bstan 'gyur bzhugs/chu sna gang 'gro'i sa la/lo yag rtsa ba tshugs song /rtsa ba 'bu yis ma bzas/skyes pa ljang gzhongs thib thib/rtse mo sad kyis ma 'khur/'bru sna dpung gdang shig shigaganas khang 'di la gang gi thogs pa med/chang ja khra gnyis kyi thogs pa med/gzhon gzhon 'di la gang gi thogs pa med/glu dang zhabs bro gnyis kyi thogs pa med/bgres songakhong la zhugayod/mchod chang 'degs ri'i 'degs tshad/

bgres song khong la zhus yod/bgres song chang gis sbir nas/bzhugs gral 'od kyis khengs song /dga' ba'i gnya' nang chong 'dus/'bras de yam bu'i 'bras red/yam bu rgya yi 'bras red/'bras chang bsil ma tshong sa/dga' ba'i gnya' nang tshong 'dus/rna ba gzhon pa'i glu red/do dgong 'u ras glu red/rna ba gzhon pa'i glu red/rna ba rgas su ma gtogs/gzhon du 'gro sa ma red/rgyamatsho'ikhanas bzhes dang /mchod chang bzhes dang gnang dang /rgya mtsho'i kha nas bzhes dang /rgya mtsho mtho ru ma gtogs/dma' ru 'gro sa mi 'dug113

gzhon gzhonakhrang bzhesacug sa/brag ri zil pa phrum phrum/ma dang mkha' 'gro'i bzhugs sa/dkar yol ngang skya rog rogagazhon gzhon khrung bzhes rgyag sa/khrung bzhes brgyabanas gzhon songakargan pa rnams ni rgas song /bsod nams bsags nas rgasasong /gzhon pa rnams ni gzhon song /khrung bzhes brgyab nas gzhon song /chang zhim po 'thung dus glu zhig dgos/chang zhim po 'thung dus glu zhig dgos/glu med na bong bu chu 'thung red/rang gcig pur 'gro dus glu zhig dgos/glu med na rkyang rgan chad po 'dra/gral mang po 'dzoms dus glu zhig dgos/glu med na lkug pa gral sgrig red/gnam de la 'dzoms param gsum yod/gnam de la 'dzoms pa rnam gsum yod/114

'dzoms che ba skar ma smin drug red/bkrag che ba tho rengs skar chen red/drin che ba dro 'jam nyi ma red/bkra la shis pa shog cigabakra la shis pa shog cigabakra la shis pa'i rtse mo/dbu 'phang gangs las mtho bas/rten 'brel dang po 'grigs song /bkra la shis pa shog cigabakra la shis pa'iskyes sa/skyes sa brag la byas yod/spun grogs brag lasasra ba/rten 'brel gnyis pa 'grigs song /mi rgyud chu las ring ba/rten 'brel gsum pa 'grigs song /g.yas la shig tsam gnang dang /dpa' bo brgya yi bzhugs sa/g.yon la shig tsam gnang dang /dpa' mo brgya yi bzhugs sa/g.yas shig g.yon shig gnang dang /dpa' dang dpa' mo'i bzhugs sa/115

bzhugs gral du 'bul ba'i chang gzhas/mi dpon rang sar bzhugs na/bzhugs gral 'od kyis khengs song /dri za'i yul nas phebs pa'i/mgron po sran ma'i me togaphyag tu phebs pas yag byung /thugs sems lhod por bzhugs dang /lag chung g.yas la 'khyer ba'i/bzhes khrung a rag bdud rtsi/de nas hub gsum mchod na/ngan song myang dgos med do/g.yas la kha btags btags yod/dkar kha gtsang ba'i khyad yin/g.yon la sman rtsi btags yod/mchod kha 'drong ba'i khyad yin/kha btags sman rtsi gnyis po/dga' bde'i dpal la rol shogagazhon pa'i lag tu 'khyer ba'i/ rin chen dngul gyi khrung g.yang /khrung g.yang de yi nang la/gser gyi ri mo bris yod/116

dbu 'phang gser las mtho ba/mchod du chog pa yod do/gzhon pa'i lag tu 'khyer ba'i/rin chen gser gyi zhal dkar/zhal dkar de yi nang du/dung gi ri mo bris yod/thugs sems dung las dkar ba/mchod du chog pa yod do/g.yas la lcang dkar btsugs yod/lcang dkar skye kha bzang ba/g.yon la lcang smug btsugs yod/lcang spug mgo gral snyoms pa/lcang dkar lcang spug dkyil la/gser gyi pho brang bzhengs yod/pho brang mtho ru ma gtogs/dma' ru 'gro sa ma red/star kha'i sdong pos g.yas byas/ku shu'i sdong pos g.yon byas/bya chung smra mkhan ne tso/sku tshe skyid la 'khyol song /rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga/rgyal sras 'phags pa 'jam dpal/117

gsol ba snying nas btab pas/thugs rjes rgyang nas gzigs shogadakar yol dkar sangs nang la/dkar ja'i 'o ma blugs yod/nam mkha'i bla ma dkon mchoga'o phud bzhes par phebs dang /chang thengs gsum bzhes dang dbu 'phangamatho/chang 'di la kha dog sna gsum yod/gro chang ser po gser gyi mdogaser 'khyil le nyi ma shar 'dra yod/'bras chang dkar po dung gi mdogadwangs 'khyil le ba de dung gi mdoga'abru chang sngon mo g.yu yi mdogasngo 'khyil le g.yu mtsho 'khyil 'dra yod/de'i steng gi yas sgron spun gsum 'di/'bri dkar dkar bzhos pa'i dkar 'dzoms ma/dkar po rwa co dung las grub/lha chen tshangs pa'i gter zog red/lha mgon skyabs che don de nas byung /'bri khra khra bzhos pa'i khra 'dzoms ma/khra bo rwa co gzi las grub/118

gnyen chen sku lha'i gter zog red/gnyen drag rtsal che don de nas byung /'bri de tsho bzhos pa'i mar phud yin/'bri brgya bzhos pa'i thog mar yin/lo gsum la btsos pa'i lo chang 'di/pha yul stod kyi bu dkar chang /ma yul smad kyi bu smug chang /lo la btsos pa'i lo chang 'di/lo chang lo yag kham pa zer/zla la btsos pa'i zla chang 'di/zla chang zil mngar ldan pa zer/zhag la btsos pa'i zhag chang 'di/zhag chang lo yag me 'bar zer/nyin la btsos pa'i nyin chang 'di/nyin chang bdud rtsi lo yag zer/chang thengs gsum bzhes dang dbu 'phang mtho/'brug mo'i chang gzhas/nga'i lag na bzung ba'i zhal dkar 'di/seng ge dkar mo'i 'o ma la/byang shang pa'i yul nas 'phrul bzo byas/phyi mi 'gyur bkra shis ri mo la/119

nang 'dod rgu'i rgyalasrid lhun gyis grub/bar bkra shis rdzas kyi rang byon yod/nang 'chi med tshe yi bdud rtsi la/lho 'dzam gling rgya gar rgya nag sogs/bod rgyal khag bco brgyad chang sna dang /mdo khams gling gi 'bru sna la/'bru mi gcig 'bru sna bco brgyad 'khrungs/lo gcig bsnyal ba'i lo chang dang /zla gcig btsos pa'i zla chang dang /zhag gcig btsos pa'i zhag chang bcas/kha dog dri ro phun sum tshogs/ser mar 'dod yon sprin phung 'phro/yar mchod mchog gsum rtsa gsum dang /phu bo dung khyung dkar po dang /nu bo klu sbrul 'od chen dang /sreng lcam the le 'od phrum mchod/lha klu gnyan dang dgra lha'i dpung / wer ma zo dor dkar phyogs sde/ge sar dgra lha'i gtso bo dang /pha khu phu nu 'khor bcas mchod/chang 'di gsol la dbu 'phang bstod/dgung seng drug 'gyur glu yis bstod/120

sku mi 'gyur 'phags pa 'jam dbyangs kyis/dgra khams zil gyis mnan la bstod/gsung mi 'gags spyan ras gzigs dbang gis/g.yang nor dbang du bsdus la bstod/thugs mi 'gyur phyag na rdo rje yis/'brel tshod thar lam bkod la bstod/nongs pa gang mchis bzod par gsol/lag la bzung ba'i dkar yol 'di/shar rgya nag bkra shis khri sgo nas/tshong dpon nyi ma bsam grub des/'khyer ba gling dkar stod la khyer/bablu rin dngul srang brgya phrag sprad/phyi na bkra shis rtags brgyad ris/nang na rgyal srid sna bdun ris/yu ba nor bu cha bdun spel/'bras shel phun tshogs 'khyil bar btags/rgya nag rgyal po'i khyad nor red/bcud la gtams pa'i bdud rtsi'i skyems/ rgya gar yul gyi bur dkar chang /rgya nag shar gyi bur nag chang /mdo khams lho yi rgun 'brum chang /121

'bras ljongs nub kyi 'bras dkar chang /chang bzhi mi 'gyur rtsa ba byas/g.yu 'brug sngon mo'i ngar chu gcigaseng ge dkar mo'i 'o ma gnyis/dmar yag stag gi snying khrag gsum/bcud gsum chang gi grogs la btab/'dren shes gling bza' 'brug mo yin/gsol shes gur dkar rgyal po red/chang dang po btungs na ljags la 'phogasmra sgo phye nas mtshar gyis khengs/chang gnyis pa btungs na lus la 'phogartsa sgo phye nas nywa bzhi lhod/chang gsum pa btungs na yid la 'phogasnang ba'i sgo 'byed dbu 'phang mtho/dngulachun dngul phor gyi bshad pa/nga yi lag tu 'khyer ba'i/rin chen dngul gyi khrung phor/khrung phor de yi sgang la/gser gyi ri mo bris yod/ri mo bkra shis rtags brgyad/'dzam gling 'di na dkon pa/122

phyi la ser po gser gyis btums/nang la kham pa dngul gyis btums/'jig rten mi kha'i skyor byed red/'di'i nang du blug pa'i bdud rtsi chang /chang 'di'i 'byung khungs bshad pas na/phun sum tshogs pa'i thab gcig la/bkra shis 'khyil ba'i zangs gcig btsugs/rgyun chad med pa'i chu zhig blugs/dmar 'od 'khyil ba'i me zhig btang /'bru mi gcig 'bru sna lnga la btsos/'di'i nang la chang rtsi dkar po brgyab/khu byug sngon po'i mgrin pa yod/gsung skad snyan po de nas byung / a sane tso'i lce sha yod/kha lce bde don de nas byung /glang rgan spor to'i kha mchu yod/gzi stobs che ba de nas byung /ser po gro yi bag phye yod/bag gro po yong don de nas byung /dmar yag stag gi snying khrag yod/dpa' snying che don de nas byung /bre ser 'brong gi snying sha yod/1231

ba'i nor bu/ nor longs spyod 'phel ba'i g.yang mda'/ bkra shis phun mum tshogs pa de nas byung ngo /༷ g.yubashad/— yi swasti/ bde legs su gyur cig rigs stobs dpal 'byor lhanga' thang lang tsho sogs/ g.yang gi rtsi zhag kun chags bro dkar g.yu/rnyaring mdzes ma'i gtsug tu phul ba 'dis/ bkra shis dge mtshan gong nas gong 'phel shog/ mda' bshad/— yi swasti/ bde legs su gyur cig thabs shes zhags pa utpal zada' gzhu yis/ srid zhi'i dpal yon ma lus 'gugs pa la/ thogs med jimathu grub dbang sdud lha mo yis/ phun tshogs dge mtshan yongs 'gugs shā na las mdzod/tsho oṃ swaste/ mi rabs tshigs mang ldan mtshon lho rong nags skyes smyug ma ོ rsha 'dod rgu'i yon tan sna lnga mtshon pa'i kha dog lnga ldan dar gyis bcings/zhi 'a grogs dam tshig gtsang ma g.ya' bral dngul dkar me long phyang phrul ra si/ dbu 'phang mtho phyir rgod sgros brgyan pa'i phun tshogs mda' dar /ma la 'dzugs/ chos kun rten cing 'brel 'byung nyid phyir na/ da lta rna da pa'i mda' dar smon tshig rnams/ legs par dngos su grub pa'i ji de:da la/ rtag par spyod pa'i dga' ston gong 'phel shogabye 125

'bebasabashad/oṃ suste/ thog mar bag ma chibs las bshol ba'i skabs kyi babs stegs su bya ba tshwa ltar rgyugs pa'i tshwa khal brgya yi rtsig pa yod dam/ 'khrungs sgo legs shing mi rabs 'dzoms pa'i rten 'brel du gro khal brgya yi rtsig pa yod dam/ yab rje dpa' rtsal stag las che ba'i mtshon byed du stag gdan yod dam/ yum chen rigs bzang thig le mngon par bkra ba'i mtshon byed du gzigagadan yod dam/ yab yum gnyis ka sku rus mtho ba'i mtshon byed du stag lpags dang gos yug gis mtshon pa'i dgu tshan yod dam/yisasti/ bde legs su gyur cig bkra shis glu gar dang bcas te/rin chen spungs pa'i rkang stegs rtser/ khyim 'dzin sras mo'i zhabs bkod pas/ 'dod rgu'i dpal la dbang 'byor shogasgo bshad/oṃ susti/ bde legs su gyur cig sgo mo bkra shis rgyan chags 'di/yar them sngon po g.yu yi byas/ mar them ser po gser gyis byas/ ru bzhi baiḍūrya yi4byas/ me long tsan dan dmar pos byas/ dung gi dbye shing lu gu brgyud/ sgo 'bor sgo shan gser gyis byas/ sgo mo gser sgo g.yu sgo'i nang / rnam sras nor gyi bang mdzod yod/ phun tshogs g.yang chags 'dod rgu 'dzoms/ sgo dar nang mdzod dri med 'dis/ de ring bskal bzang nyi ma la/ sgo mo phye bar byas nas bzung / bkra shis sgo brgya rtag tu bye gyur cig126

skas bshad/steng 'og phye ba'i skas 'dzeg 'di/ mtho chen bcu gsum mthon po'i skas/ ru gnyis beeḍūrya yis byas/ 'chang zung rdo rje pha lam yin/ skas gdang rin chen bdun brtsegs yin/ bkra shis skas ka rim 'dzegs la/skas dar rgyal srid sna bdun yod/ka ba'i bshad pa/stengadaga' ldan lha yi pho brang dang / sgo kun nas mtshungs pa'i khang bzang 'dir/ rgyu tsan dan sbrul snying las grub pa'i/ ka rabs kyi bshad pa 'tshal ba la/ phyi gru bzhi lha yi gzhal yas khang / nang srung skyob pho lha'i rten mkhar yin/ 'og mi 'gyur ka stegs nor bu'i rdo/ rgyu sra ba rang grub sgor mo yod/ bre phreng dang nor bus brgyan pa gsum/ gzhu ring dang gzhu thung gzhu khebs mdzes/ gdung dang gdung gdan gdung khebs bkra/padma chos brtsegs nyi zla bcas/ ka rabs bcu gsum tshang ba 'di/ gzhi mi 'gyur brtan pa'i ka ba yin/ sngon srid pa chags pa'i dus skabs nas/du4da lta bar du'ang gnas khang 'dir/ dpal phun sum tshogs pa'i rtsa ba byas/ gzhi lhun grub 'dod rgu g.yang du 'khyil/ dus de ring phun sum tshogs pa'i nyin/ dar dkar po ka ba'i rgyan du phul/ tshe dang longs spyod rbobadu 'phel shog / ji dar bshad/oṃ susti/ bde legs su gyur cig de ring gza' skar mchog tu dge 127

ba'i nyin/ phun sum tshogs pa'i lha rdzas za 'og 'bol/ bkra shis g.yung drung 'khyil ba'i gdan steng na/ mthong na mi mthun med pa'i lang tsho ni/steng phyogs lha mo'i gzugs su shar ba ltar/ gzugs mdzes lta na sdug cing tshul bzang ba/ legs pa'i mdog dang 'jam zhing dri mchog ldan/ yid 'ong 'dod rgu reg bya sogs tshang ba'i/ btsun mo rin chen lta bu gang nyid la/sngon du bkra shis gro so phye mar 'bul/ bde legs rtags mtshan g.yang ṭi'i zhal dkar nang / 'dzam gling rtsi tog snying po'i bdud rtsi dang / steng phyogs brgya byin lha yi bdud rtsi'i bcud/ rgya gar bal bod bza' bca'i btung ba sogs/ phun sum tshogs pas byur bus bkang ste 'bul/ bkra shis rtags brgyad ri mos brgyan pa yi/ rgya dar dkar po nang mdzod dri med 'di/ mgul du phul bas bde legs gong 'phel shogadar bshad/'dzam gling sa gzhi kun la dbang bsgyur ba/ sngon bsags bsod nams stobs las legs bsgrun pa'i/ gzugs sku nyi ma lta bu'i gzi brjid can/ lha sras gzhon nu'i mdzes sdug dpal gyis ni/ gangs ri'i mdangs 'phrog rab dkar seng ge 'dra/ seng ges gangs ri 'grims ltar brtan par bzhugs/ khri stan mi 'gyur 'dzam bu'i gser las grub/ g.yas g.yon seng ges btegs pa'i khri yi steng / za 'og rgyan bzhi dmar ser sngo ljang dkar/ bzhugs 'bol lnga tshan rim par brtsegs pa'i steng / 'dzam gling bod yul khri skor bcu gsum gyis/ 'bru mchog 'dod rgu longs spyod 'khyil ba'i dbus/ ja chang dpal yon 'dzoms pa'i bde skyid kyis/ rtag 128snam

tu rtse gar rol ba'i nyams ldan ni/ steng phyogs lha yi yul na'ang med do zhes/'dir tshogs bzhugs gral rnams kyis yang yang gleng / de ring phun sum tshogs pa'i dus kyi char/ mi nor zas gos thams cad dbang du 'dus/rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun dpal gyis brgyan/ bkra shis rtags brgyad kyis mtshan dar dkar 'di/ lha sras dbang sdud khyed kyi rgyan du 'bul/dar bshad/oṃ suste/ gtsang g.yas ru phun sum tshogs pa'i sar/ dpa' rtsal drug 'dzoms shing ngang rgyud ring / mi gzhan gyis mthong ba'i mod nyid la/pho skyes pa kun gyi dgra lha 'dra/ dman bu mo sems nyid 'phrog pa yi/ yab rgyal po 'di ni ngo mtshar che/ brtan mi 'gyur gser khri mthon po'i steng /rgya gos kyi bkra shis 'bol gdan bting / g.yang chags pa gro yi g.yung drung 'khyil/ yab rgyal po mi 'gyur brtan par bzhugs/ yab rgyal po sku gzugs gangs ri 'dra/ gangs ri la nyi zer phog pa bzhin/ dkar dmar gyi mdangs ldan zla ba 'dra/ zhwa lham sogs na bzas brgyan tsa na/ bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad bum pa la/ dar tshon sna lnga yis brgyan pa 'dra/snyan rgyan dang mgul rgyan rin chen sogs/ seng ge la g.yu ral rgyas pa 'dra/yab rgyal po'i dbu zhwa 'bog ser 'di/ shar gser ri'i rtse la nyi shar 'dra/bkra shis 'dod rgu 'dzoms pa'i dus de ring / bkra shis rtags kyis mtshon 26) lha gos 'di/ bkra shis yab rgyal mgul du phul ba yis/ bkra shis shā bde legs phun sum tshogs par shog129

dar bshad/phun sum tshogs pa'i rin chen g.yu khri'i steng / bkra shis gos bzang las grub pa'i 'bol gdan la/ yum chen a ma mi 'gyur brtan par bzhugs/ 'bras chang zil mngar bdud rtsi'i 'thung snod 'di/ shar phyogs rgyal khab chen po'i bang mdzod nas/ thon pa'i bkra shis dkar sangs yu ring yin/ 'di nang byur bur bkang ba'i bdud rtsi'i bcud/bde legs btung ba'i mchog 'di dgyes bzhes nas/ rtag tu dga' skyid glu len bkra shis shog rab dkar bkra shis rtags mdzes dar dkar 'di/yum chen a ma bde legs rgyan du 'bul/oṃ swasti/ rgya gar bal bod skad bsgyur lo tsā ba/ sgos mkhas mkhas dbang thon mi sam bho ṭa/ sam bho ṭa yi lus ngag dka' spyad kyi/ rgya gar dang li yi gnas mchog nas/ chos zab rgyas mdo rgyud mang po zhig byang kha ba'i yul 'dir spyan drangs ltar/ gtsang dbus 'gyur bde chen zhing gnyis pa/ dpal bkra shis lhun po'i nye 'dab4kyi/ yid bzhin nor bus gang ba'ikhang gsar nang / nor bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po ni gdan 'dren pa lo tsā blon po la/ nor bsam 'phel deng 'dir spyan drangs pa'i/legs gsol gyi bkra shis dar dkar 'bul/chang snod khrung ban la bshadapa/oṃ susti/ gzugs mi zer nor rtswa 'dzugs pa'i 'dzugs/ dbyar rtswa khagang bzang nas zas/ dgun chu sna gang 'dzoms nas 'thung / de ring bzhugs gral sgor mo'i rgyan du 'dzugs pa'i 'dzugs/ rkang pa mi zer 130

bkang ba zer/ bang mdzod nor gyis bkang ba'i bkang ba zer/ mtshang ra mi zer tshang ba zer/ bu nor longs spyod tshang ba'i tshang ba zer rtsib ma mi zer rtsig pa zer/ rtsi bcud brgya zas brtsigs pa'i rtsig pa zer/ bstod po mi zer mthon po zer/ dbu 'phang dgung las mtho ba'i mthon po zer/brang khog mi zer grangs med zer/ 'khor 'bangs grangs med yong ba'i grangs med zer/ lag pa mi zer legs pa zer/ bya ba ci byas legs pa'i legs pa zer/ mjing pa mi zer 'gyings pa zer/ ldang dgra bo'i phyogs la 'gyings pa zer/ g.yang dkar lug tshil bal gyis brgyan pa khyod/ de ring bzhugs gral sgor mo'i rgyan du byon/ de la brgyan pa'i rgyan dar zhig phul lo/chang snodakhyang ban gyi dar bshad/oṃ swasti/ rgyu rin chen sna lnga las grub pa'i/ 'khyil bzhugs rin chen bum bzang 'di/ nang lha yi bdud rtsis yongs bkang nas/ mar dkar ser gyi yar ga'i rgyan gyis mdzes/ lho rma bya'i yul gyi smyug ma yis/g.yas skor dang g.yon skor lan gsum brgyab/ bdud rtsi lha yi rgya mtsho 'khyil ba 'dra/ 'dir bzhugs kyi bzhugs gral sgor mo rnams/ a la la bdud rtsis tshim par mdzod/ shing byang chub ljon shing rtsa ba nas/ yal 'dabs sogs me tog ge sar 'khrungs/ dar tshon lnga yi cod pan sgron/rlung rta sogs dar zhing rgyas pa'i dar zhig phul/131

dar cog gi bshad pa/dar shing zug bzang ldem ldem 'di/ lho rong gting nas spyan drangs pa'i/ rtsa ba gcig la rtse mo lnga/ rtsa ba a ma chang ma'i khrung rgyan nyan pa yod/sked pa stag shar gzhon pa'i mda' smyug nyan pa yod/ rtse mo sku rlung dar ba'i dar shing nyan pa yod/ gangs la nyi shar dar tshon sna lnga'i khar/ rgya dar dkar po lha ras yug 'di sgron/ mkhar chen 'di yi pho lha'i dbus su btsugs/ btsugs dang ma btsugs dgra lha'i dbu 'phang mtho ba la gzigs dang / ki ki bswo bswo lha rgyal lo/g.yang 'gugs byed pa'i bshadang /oṃ su sti/ phun tshogs bkra shis 'khyil ba'i gnas mchog 'dir/'dod pa'i mchog ster phywa dang g.yang gi tshogs/ khab len rdo dang lcags kyi snang tshul bzhin/ dga' ba'i gar dang bcas te thogs med khug gser mngal mgrin sngon 'khor lo'i lag pa can/ grags pa'i mu khyud 'khor los bsgyur ba sogs/ srid 'dir mngon par mtho ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ phywa g.yang dpal 'byor snyan grags ma lus stsol/ legs bris tshogs kyi 'chi med btung ba dang / lha dbang gtsug gi yid bzhin nor bu mchog mi dbang sngon 'gro'i rgyal srid sna bdun gyi/ phywa g.yang dpal 'byor snyan grags ma lus stsol/ rin chen gdugs dang gser nya bum pa bzang /padma dung dkar g.yas 'khyil dpal be'u dang / rgyal mtshan 'khor lo bkra shis rtags brgyad kyis/ phywa g.yang dpal 'byor snyan grags ma lus stsol/rnam 'dren zas gtsang sras pos bkra shis pa'i/ dngos por byin brlabs 132

dge legs 'byung ba'i sgo/ rten 'brel lhun gyis grub pa'i rdzas brgyad kyi/ phywa g.yang dpal 'byor snyan grags ma lus stsol/ tshe ring nad med 'dod pa'i don kun 'grub/ stobs dang mnga' thang 'byor pa phun sum tshogs/bde zhing skyid pa'i dga' ston thams cad kyi/ phywa g.yang dpal 'byor snyan grags ma lus stsol/ bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du byon/ka dar gyi bshad pa/phyildod rin chen sa sna las grub 'khyil chen rdza ma dar 'phyang cod pan can/ nang bcud ro nus dri bzang phun tshogs kha dog nor bu mar gad mdangs/ gsang ba o rgyan mkha' 'gro gnyis pa'i mchod sprin yang rtse rab kyi phud/ rab dkar dar 'di bdud rtsi chang gi lha mor phul lo bkra shis shogamada' bshad/oṃ swasti sarwa dza ya/ tshogs gnyis dpal gyi 'dab ma'i dri bsung dang /dam chos lho phyogs rlung gis dal 'bab cing / kun mkhyen ye shes mtshan dpe'i me tog can/ bcom ldan dpyid kyi thig ler gus phyag 'tshal/ thabs dang shes rab theg pa sna tshogs don/ gtsug lag gser gyi nyi ma'i snang ba yis/ legs sam sint+ra wa ra'i ge sar rdul/ mi chos gtsang mar 'khod pa 'dzi lta ste/mda' bshad/mda' 'di 'khrungs sa lho rong gting nas 'khrungs/ drangs pa khyung 133

dkar mdzo la drangs/ mda' 'di la tshigs gcig tshigs gnyis tshigs gsum tshang / tshigs dang po 'khrungs sa lha nas yin/ lha dbu 'phang mtho ba de nas byung / tshigs gnyis pa 'khrungs sa klu nas yin/ klu longs spyod che ba de nas byung / tshigs gsum pa 'khrungs sa mi nas yin/ mi bsod nams bsags pa de nas byung / ltong ka dang lho smyug rgod sgro dang gsum/rgyamathing dang rgya mtshal rtse lcags dang drug 'breng rgyus pa sna lnga'i a she me long dang dgu/ mda' dar 'di la tshang ba dgu ldan zer/ bkra shis dge mtshan tshang ba'i mda' dar 'di/ rigs bzang bu mo 'di yi mgul la btsugs/ de ring gi nyi ma 'di nas bzung / mtho gnam la 'phur song zer sa med/ dma' sa la 'dzul song zer sa med/ dbang chen rnams kyis 'phrog song zer sa med/ dbang med rnams kyis brkus song zer sa med/ ki ki bswo bswo lha rgyal lo/rta bshad/rta 'di rta ngo ma shes na/ gyi ling gi gnam rta dkar po yin/ lha gcig rgya bza'i chibs chen yin/ steng lha nas gnang ba'i lha rta ngang pa yin/la la 'gro ba'i la rta 'di la zhu/ 'og klu nas gnang ba'i klu rta sngon po yin/chu la 'gro ba'i chu rta 'di la zhu/ bar btsan nas gnang ba'i btsan rta rkyang po yin/ thang la 'gro ba'i thang rta 'di la zhu/ sngon dus lha gcig kong jos chibs/ kha dro g.yang chags kyi rta zhig yin/ da lta rigs bzang bu mos chibs/ kha dro g.yang chags kyi bag rta 'di la zhu/134

mda' bshad/gzhu mo cha dkar g.yang gzhu 'di/ bkug na stong gsum gug pa yin/mda' mo tshad med rgod sgro 'di/ brgyab na rdo rje'i brag kyang gshog mda' 'di shar la mi rgyag ngang tsam byed/ shar dro 'jam nyi ma'i 'byon lam yin/mda' 'di lho la mi rgyag ngang tsam byed/ lho shing chen ta la'i 'byon lam yin/mda' 'di nub la mi rgyag ngang tsam byed/ nub chu chen kham pa'i 'byon lam yin/ mda' 'di byang la mi rgyag ngang tsam byed/ byang shel tshwa dkar po'i 'byon lam yin/ mda' 'di gnam la mi rgyag ngang tsam byed/ gnam rgyu skar 'dzoms pa'i 'byon lam yin/ mda' 'di sa la mi rgyag ngang tsam byed/sa 'bru sna lnga yi 'byon lam yin/ rigs bzang bu mo'i 'byon lam 'di ltar lags/'bebasabashad/de ltar lags na/ bu mo 'bebs pa'i 'bebs gdan zhal dro khal brgya e yod/ lho 'bras mo ljongs kyi 'bras khal brgya e yod/ bod gangs can ljongs kyi 'bru khal brgya e yod/ byang tshwa mtsho kha yi tshwa khal brgya e yod/de steng phying dkar gyi kha g.yar e yod/ de steng gzig gdan gra yi g.yung drung ldan pa e yod/ mtshan bzang po yongs su grags pa'i dar sna lnga yi mtshan grangs e yod/mjal dar 'bul bshad/oṃ susti/ bde legs su gyur cig rten 'brel gyi thog mar sngar srid 135

pa chags rabs phran tsam zhu ba la/ phyi sno da kyi 'jig rten rlung rdo rje rgya gram du chags/ nang bcud kyi sems can 'od gsal lha nas chas sa padma 'dababargyad sdong po yi steng / phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad bkra shis rtags brgyadadang / 'byung ba bzhi brtsegs sde bzhi'i gzhal yas khang / gnam 'khorayo rtsibs brgyad 'di yi 'og zhing gi mchog gyur lho phyogs 'dzam bu gling / 'dzam gling yongs kyi srid pa'i yul gyi dbus/ rgya gar byang chub snying po rdo rje gdan/ de nas byang du dpag tshad 'gar bgrod pas/gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs su bskor/ bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i yul/skyid grong skyid pa'i yul phyogs 'di'i/ rgyab ri seng ge 'gyings pa 'dra/ shwa ba rwa btso ngoms sa yin/ mdun ri rtsi shing nags tshal steng / byi'u chung 'jol mo'i gsung snyan sgrog bar phywa g.ya nga 'dzoms pa'i khang khyim 'di/'dod rgu longs spyod 'phel ba'i gnas / de ltar phun sum tshogs pa'i sras 'dil/ bkra shis bde legs kyi sras mo khab tu ba'es/ sku nye gser gyi ga'u kha sbyor mdzad pa'i/ dga' ston rgya che lhun chags kyi skabs 'dir/gus pa zhabs chung nas rten 'brel tsam zhu ba la/ dpon bzang po'i dbu 'phang dgung las mtho/ chab 'bangs kyi mnga' thang dar zhing rgyas/ phyi mi 'gyur btsan po'i lcags ris bskor/ nang mi 'gyur bang mdzod nor gyis gang / mdzes byed rab gsal mchong sis brgyan/ gzim chung ka ba'i gdung brgyad kyi/ rin chen gyi ka bar ka dar 'bul lags na/ bkra shis phun sum tshogs gyur cig136

ka dar gyi bshad pa/oṃ susti/ bde legs su gyur cig lhun grub 'dod rgu 'khyil ba'i khang bzang 'dzi'i/ ka ba la ka rabs bcu gsum tshang / dang po ka stegs nor bu'i rdo la bcol/ phyogs bzhi mi 'gyur rdo rje lta bur brtan/ ka ba mi 'gyur rin chen gser las grub/ srid 'i'i dpal yon mdzes pa'i nyi zlas brgyan/ lcam gdung gra ma nor bu'i gral ltar mdzes/ sngar yang 'dzoms la da yang dar zhing rgyas/ mi 'gyur yun ring brtan pa'i ka ba la/ dar rtse ka gdong srid la bsgrengs pa 'di/ srid pa'i gangs rir nyi ma shar dang mtshungs/ dar mjug ka ba'i gsham du 'khyil ba 'dis/ phun tshogs 'dod rgu g.yang du lon par shog ki ki bswo bswo lha rgyal lo/gro 'bo'i bshadapa/oṃ susti/ bde legs su gyur cig sa gzhi 'bru sna lnga yis 'dzom sa pa'i steng / ru bzhis btegs pa'i rgya cog gling bzhi dang / de yi steng du 'bo zhig yod pa ni/ rgyu dpag bsam shing las grub pa yin/ sngon mkhas pa bi shas bzo bskrun byas/ phyi la zur bzhi yod pa 'di/ phyi yi dgra batshi thulab yin/ nang la khug bzhi yod pa 'di/ nang gi g.yang ba'i khug pa yin/ de nang yod pa'i rgya gro 'di/ sngon rgya bza' kong jo bod du byon pa'i tshe/ sku skyel gyi dwangs ma bsam las 'das/ bsam tshad 'grub pa 'al dro ba'i dro yin lags/137

gro 'bo'i steng du btsugs pa'i mda' dar gyi dar bshad/de yi steng du byang tshwa kha nor bu'i bang mdzod dang mnyam pa'i tshwa yi khar/'di na yod pa'i mda' mo gzhon nu 'di/ dpa' rtsal g.yang du len pa'i mda' mo yin/ rtsa ba gnam lcags mde'us brgyan pa 'di/ gegs dbang bar chad ma lus zhi ba'i rtags/ mda' smyug 'jam zhing 'drong la tshigs gsum ldan/ bshad sgrub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzugs pa'i rtags/dar tshon sna lnga yis bcings pa 'di/ bu phrug tshon mdangs bzhin du 'dzoms pa'i rtags/ mda' la me long gis brgyan pa 'di/ mngon par shes pa mnga' ba'i rten 'brel yin/ mda' la rtse lnga yod pa 'di/ mnga' thang longs spyod rgyas pa'i rten 'brel yin/ ltong lnga bal gyis bkang ba 'di/dgra lha'i dbu 'phang mtho ba'i rten 'brel yin/ don rgya dar dri med mdangs ldan 'di/ mda' dar 'di yi rgyan du 'bul phywa khu ye/ g.yang khug shoga'adzugs sha lug khog gi dar bshad/oṃ susti/ bde legs su gyur cig 'dzugs zhes mi zer btsugs pa zer/ mi brgyud rtsa ba btsugs pa'i btsugs pa zer/ gzhug gu mi zer mjug ma zer/ sku brgyud chu las ring ba'i mjug ma zer/ longs zhes mi zer lhongs zhes zer/ dpal 'byor lam du lhongs pa'i lhongs zhes zer/sgyid pa ma zer skyid pa zer/ mi nor 'dzoms shing skyid pa'i skyid pa zer/rtsib ma mi zer rtsig pa zer/ rgya ja rtsi bcud brtsigs pa'i rtsig pa zer lag pa mi zer lhag pa zer/ longs spyod gzhan las lhag pa'i lhag pa zer/138

brang khog mi zer 'brangs pa zer/ sems nyid rjes su 'brangs pa'i 'brangs pa zer/ mgo bo mi zer bsgur ba zer/ dgra mgo bo bsgur ba'i bsgur ba zer/ rwa co mi zer mchor ba zer/ nyams gzi brjid mchor ba'i mchor ba zer/ dbyar gyi dus su rtswa kha gang bzang nas zas/ dgun gyi dus su chu sna gang 'dzoms nas btungs/ lhas ra gru bzhi'i nang du ra rdzig rdzig spang gshongs bde mo'i nang du skyid nyal byed/ de ring gnas khang 'di yi 'dzugs su byon pa legs/ ki ki bswo bswo lha rgyal lo/khrung g.yang 'bul ba'i chang snodakyi bshad pa/oṃ swasti/ bde legs su gyur cig rgyu rin chen sna lnga las grub pa'i/'khyil bzhugs o rgyan gyi bum bzang 'di/ phyi bltas ri bo nang bltas rgya mtsho 'dra/ mar dkar ser gyis yar ga lnga dang ldan/ gting na lo chang garam yod/ bar na 'bras chang bsil ma yod/ kha na a rag bdud rtsi yod/ 'di na bzhugs gral rnam tsho dga' ba la/ a la la ho/ skyid pa la/blam sngags 'chang la khrung g.yang 'bul ba'i dar bshad/oṃ swasti/ dge legs su gyur cig srid zhi'i phun tshogs 'chi med lam yangs por/ rin chen rnam gsum nyi zla skar gsum 'dra/ nyan pa'i grags pa mkha' ltar khyab pa yi/ sngags 'chang srid pa'i gangs ri rdo rje'i sku/mchog mthun ngo mtshar snang bas yongs skyob pa'i/ chos dang dge 'dun nga'ajus kyis bde legs stsol/ na mo ki ki bswo bswo lha rgyal lo/1397

yum chen amar khrung g.yang 'bul ba'i dar bshad/oṃ swasti/ bde legs su gyur cig yum chen khyed ni ma pham g.yu mtsho 'dra/ ma pham g.yu mtshor dgos don nor bu 'khrungs/ bsam 'phel nor bu༅ga tu son pa byed/ tshe ring nad med rtag tu bde legs shog na mo ki ki bswo bswo lha rgyal lo/mag parasbang g.yang 'bulasgyu'i bshad pa/oṃ swasti/ bde legs su gyur cig lag g.yas kyi zhal dkar yu ring 'di/ shar rgya nag bkra shis khri skor nas thon/ tshong dpon nor bu bzang po la/ byung yang gling dkar stod nas byung / zhal dkar nang gi bdud rtsi 'di/ rgya gar yul gyi gur chang yin/ rgya nag yul gyi rgun 'brum chang /lho 'bras mo ljongs kyi 'bras chang yin/ bod dkar mo 'bru yi lo chang yin/chang gzhan dang mi 'dra rtsa chen yin/ don lha sras khyed kyi zhal du gsol/ a la la ho/ skyid pa la/mag par 'bulargyu'i dar bshad/lha sras 'di dang ri rgyal lhun po 'dra/ snyan grags chen pos nam mkha' bzhin du khyab/ tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs/ lag na bzung ba'i rgya dar dri med 'di/ mtho dgung sngon dbyings la 'phyar tsa na/nam mkha' dar gyis khengs pa'i rten 'brel yod/ dma' sa gzhi'i steng du 'jog tsa na/ bzhugs gral dar gyis khengs pa'i rten 'brel yod/ deng yon tan rgya mtsho mchog gi mgul du 'bul/ lha zhal gangs las dkar ba 140

shog ki ki bswo bswo lha rgyal lo/bu gzhon parakhrung g.yang 'bul ba'i dar bshad/oṃ swasti/ bde legs su gyur cig sras gangs stod seng ge 'gyings pa 'dra/ 'bangs ri dwags kun gyi rgyal po yin/ seng g.yu ral rgyas nas lus rtsal 'don/ dpa' rtsal drug 'dzoms pa'i lha sras khyed/ dgra mgo 'thul zhing gnyen 'khor skyong / bkra shis bde legs kyi dar 'di khyed la 'bul/ na mo ki ki bso bswo lha rgyal lo/bag ma lakhrung g.yang 'bul ba'i dar bshad/thams cad kun mkhyen btsun mo rin chen gter/ gnyen ldan ljon shing 'dra ba'i sras mo khyed/ kun la tsha grang snyoms pa'i grib bsil mkhan/gnas khang bstan pa 'dzin pa'i bstan 'dzin ma/ bu nor pang du len pa'i pang len ma/ yid 'ong khyed la bkra shis dar 'di 'bul/ na mo ki ki bswo bswo lha rgyal lo/bag ma skyel bsu'i sku tshab par 'bul rgyu'i dar bshad/oṃ suste/ bde legs su gyur cig khyed rgya bod gnyis kyi lo tsā ba/chu phan tshun gnyis kyi zam pa/ sde grong pa gnyis kyi gnas po/ kha lag pa gnyis kyi thur ma/ rgya sgo bsdam pa'i a shing / rgya skad bod du bsgyur mkhan/bod skad rgya ru bsgyur mkhan/ zhal nyi ma las dro ba/ dbu 'phang dgung lasamatho ba/ yod kyang yod de byung yang byung / na mo ki ki bswo bano lha 141

rgyal lo/dar shing gi dar bshad/dar tshon sna lnga yi rgyan mdzes pa'i/ rtsa ba gcig la rtse mo lnga/ rtsa ba 'jig rten 'dzugs pa'i shing / rtse mo gnas khang sku rlung dar ba'i༄ rten/khrung sa'i lha mo 'di la dar gcig 'bul/ na mo ki ki bswo bswo lha rgyal lo/skal dngos ster sgo tho bsher gyi bshad pa/oṃ swaste/ bde legs su gyur cig rta bdun rgyal po dro 'jam nyi ma dang / bsil zer rgyal po dkar gsal zla ba gnyis/ rgyu skar rgyal po tho rengs skar chen gsum/ rten 'brel dbang gis dgung sngon dbyings su mjal/ de la brten nas 'dzam gling mun pa sel/ gling bzhi'i mun pa sel ba'i bkra shis shog za hor mkhan po bho dhi satwa dang o rgyan chen po padma 'byung gnas gnyis/ bod kyi rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gsum/ smon lam dbang gis bod yul dbus su mjal/ bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun grub lha khang bzhengs/ de la brten nas bod yul bde skyid dar/ bod yul bde skyid ldan pa'i bkra shis shog dpa' rtsal sna dgu 'dzoms pa'i lha sras dang /mdzangs gsum grogs nang mthun pa'i sras mo gnyis/ gtso bo'i bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i lha mo gsum/ sngon las dbang gis bzhugs gral 'di ru mjal/ de la brten nas bu nor longs spyod 'phel/ bu nor longs spyod 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog142

chang dngajakha shig shiganam mkha' yar la gzigs dang /lho sprin byang la shig shigang tsho'i tshad ldan bla ma/phebs kyi yod 'gro bsams byung /sa gzhi mar la gzigs dang /rta pho'i 'gro 'gros shig shigang tsho'i 'go 'dren dpon po/phebs kyi yod 'gro bsams byung /phyogs bzhi'i dgra mgo de tsho/'dul gyi yod 'gro bsams byung /bzhugs gral phyogs la gzigs dang /chang dang ja khra shig shigang tsho'i a ma chang ma/phebs kyi yod 'gro bsams byung /chang dang a rag bdud rtsi/bzhes kyi yod 'gro bsams byung /gral stod yar la gzigs dang /zhal dkar sngo khra shig shigasngo khra lan mo ri mo las yag kagral dkyil de la gzigs dang /mchod zhal rdzab ya shig shig143

rdzab ya lan mo ri mo las yag kagral mjug mar la gzigs dang /chang dang ja khra shig shigaja khra lan mo'i a long las yag ka/sharakong lha'i la mo/rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal nas/phyi ma'i yar 'dren gnang ba'i zhal bzhes yod/yar 'dren bzang po gnang ba'i zhal bzhes yod/'go 'dren dpon po'i zhal nas/'go 'dren lung bstan gnang ba'i zhal bzhes yod/phyogs bzhi'i dgra mgo 'dul ba'i zhal bzhes yod/a ma chang ma'i zhal nas/chang dang ja khra gnang ba'i zhal bzhes yod/a rag bdud rtsi gnang ba'i zhal bzhes yod/bkra shis yagagral stod yar la zhus yod/mchod zhal rdzab ya dpung gdang shig shigardzab ya'i lan mo 'gro 'gros shig shigagral dkyil yi la zhus yod/dkar yol sngo khra dpung gdang shig shig14

sngo khra lan mo 'gro 'gros shig shigagral mjug ma la zhus yod/chang dang ja khra dpung gdang shig shiga.a rag bdud rtsi 'gro 'gros shig shigamachod palaramachod/mchod pa yar mchod yar la mchod/yar mchod tsan dan bla mas mchod/tsan dan bla mas ma mchod na/phyi ma'i yar 'dren su yis gnang /mchod pa bar mchod bar la mchod/bar mchod 'go 'dren dpon pos ma chod/'go 'dren dpon pos ma mchod na/'go 'don lam gsum su yis gnang /mchod pa mar mchod mar la mchod/ mar mchod a ma chang mas mchod/a ma chang mas ma mchod na/chang dang ja khra su yis gnang /rten 'brel mdzad sgo/dga' ba'i phyogs nas yong yod/skyid pa'i nyi ma shar song /145

nga yi bla ma bzang po/o rgyan padma bzhugs yod/dga' ba'i phyogs nas yong yod/skyid pa'i nyi ma shar song /nga yi bla ma bzang po/chang zhim bag gro bzhugs yod/ri bo smyug ris shig shigaganas chen zangs mdog dpal ri/gnas lung brag bzo yag pa/bla ma mkha' 'gro'i gdan sa/dngos grub gnang yod gnang yod/nyi ma gzhon nus gnang yod/dang po btungs nas ma bzi/gnyis pa btungs nas ma bzi/nga tsho'i nyi ma gzhon nu'i/zhal dkar gang gis bzi song /nyi ma gzhon nus gnang ba'i/ljags mdud dmar po ljang khu/khrom stod mi dmangs tshogs sar/ngoms su chog pa yod do/nam mkha' kha zheng che ba/sprin pa sprin tshogs mthug pa/146

nyi ma'i bsam don grub nas/gnas bzhi bskor nas log 'gro/mtsho mo kha zheng che ba/rde'u rde'u gral 'grig gnya mo'i bsam don grub nas/mtsho mtha' bskor nas log 'gro/bzhugs gral kha zheng che ba/ja chang 'dod rgu 'dzoms pa/gzhon pas bag chags bzhag ste/khrom thag bcad nas log 'gro/mchod pa yar mchod yar la mchod/yar mchod tsan dan bla mas mchod/tsan dan bla mas mchod zer na/dngos grub gnang ba'i zhal bzhes yod/mchod pa bar mchod bar la mchod/'go 'dren dpon pos mchod zer na/gtam gsum skad grags gnang ba'i zhal bzhes yod/mchod pa mar mchod mar la mchod/mar mchod a ma chang mas mchod/chang mas bdud rtsi gnang ba'i zhal bzhes yod/147

gnyen bshad/lo gsum la btsos pa'i lo chang 'di/pha yul stod kyi bu dkar chang /ma yul smad kyi bu spug chang /lo la btsos pa'i lo chang 'di/lo chang lo yag kham pa zer/zla la btsos pa'i zla chang 'di/zla chang zil mngar ldan pa zer/zhag la btsos pa'i zhag chang 'di/zhag chang lo yag me 'bar zer/nyin la btsos pa'i nyin chang 'di/nyin chang bdud rtsi lo yag zer/chang thengs gsum bzhes dang dbu 'phang mtho/lha bla ma rnams la re re mchod/gong dpon po rnams la re re mchod/pha ma a sru rnams la re re mchod/bzhugs gral chang glu/chang nga yang mi 'thung dgung la zhus/dgung dang du blangs na nga yang 'thung /dgung dang du len mkhan shod zer na/dgung dang du len mkhan nyi zla gnyis/148

chang nga yang mi 'thung brag la zhus/brag phur gzhi bzhes na nga yang 'thung /brag phur gzhi 'dzin mkhan shod zer na/brag phur gzhi 'dzin mkhan bya rgyal yin/chang nga yang mi 'thung chu la zhus/chu lhas ma lhas na nga yang 'thung /chu lhas ma lhas mkhan shod zer na/chu lhas ma lhas mkhan nya chung red/mi khyed kyi glu dang nga yi glu/gcig ngo gcig gis mi shes 'dugabasung ngo chang gi byon lam la/snyan po glu yis yig ngo sprad/'di dus gcig ngo gcig gis shes/bya mo co ma'i mgul shol na/mi brgya ngom pa'i chang zhig yod/chang 'di'i chang dpon su zhig yin/chang 'di'i chang dpon a ma yin/gnyen glu bkra shis sgra dbyangs/khyed gnyis nga yi chang 'dren yin zer na/dbang po lnga la skyon chag med pa dgos/lus rgyan drug la ral rdol med pa dgos/149

nga gnyen pos khyed gnyis la ku re zhus/khyed gnyen po'i chang 'dren yin gyi red/chang 'dren gyi phyag na ja khra der/mi mi sna mi gcig ga tshod yod/chang 'dren gyi phyag na sder ma der/shing shing sna mi gcig ga tshod yod/sder thog 'di na 'bru gcig gda'/'bru 'bru sna mi gcig ga tshod yod/'bru 'di'i sgang la rtsi gcig gda'/rtsi 'gyur ba med pa ga tshod yod/nga gnyis khyed kyi chang 'dren yin/dbang po lnga skyon med chos rgyal gyis sbyar/lus rgyan drug pha ma bzang pos sbyar/nga gnyis kyi lag gi ja khra 'dir/shing shing sna mi gcig bcu gsum yod/pha shing lnga dang ma shing lnga/shing bu gsum brtsis pas bcu gsum yod/ser po gser gyi kha shan 'di/rin chen gser de gong thang mtho/'ju lung nag po lcags las grub/nag po'i lcags de phugs su thub/ mthil shan kham pa dngul las grub/150

dngul kham pa'i rigs de ngo mtshar che/mchu tog smug po mchong las grub/smug po mchong de brjid re chags/nga gnyis lag gi sder ma 'dir/sder stod tsan dan dkar las grub/sder dkyil a dkar ru las grub/sder smad tsan dan dmar las grub/shing shing sna mi gcig gsum tsam yod/shing 'di 'dra 'dzoms pa'i yang steng du/'bru 'bru sna mi gcig gsum tsam yod/rgya dkar stod kyi 'bras dkar dang /rgya nag smad kyi gro ser dang /sgang pa bod kyi 'bru smug yin/'bras gro 'bru gsum byung tshul ni/gnya' bkal ba khyung dkar gyi mdzo la bkal /rmod rgyag sa rgya mo'i thang la brgyab/dpyid zla gsum sa gzhi'i 'og tu bsdad/dbyar zla gsum ljang pa'i rtse la lding /ston zla gsum rgya zor gyi kha nas bsdus/skye sa lho rong gi gzhung la skyes/'dren sa phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad 'dren/de 'bras gro 'bru yi byung tshul yin/151

'bru sna gsum 'dzoms pa'i yang steng du/rtsi 'gyur ba med pa gsum tsam yod/ka ra bu ram mngar gyi rtsi/'bri dmar ser po 'tsho yi rtsi/lo legs shing 'bras bcud kyi rtsi/rtsi 'gyur ba med pa de gsum yin/bzhes dkar yol 'brug ris rnying ma'i nang la/lo la bsnyal ba'i lo chang kham pa yod/zla la bsnyal ba'i bdud rtsi'i a rag yod/zhag la bsnyal ba'i mngar mo'i chang ser yod/'di ni gnyen po khyed kyis bzhes rogs gnang /chang 'dren gyi bu mo spun gnyis ma/chang de'i nang du dug gsum gda'/dug gsum sel ba'i sel tshul shod /dug gsum sel tshul ma bshad na/nga gnyen po dug la 'dzems le yin/ bag ma bsu bshad/oṃ swasti/bde legs su 'phel gyur cigabakra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs/steng gnam la bltas pas skar ma bzang /152

da rang sa la bltas pas nyi ma dro/bar du dus tshod tshes grangs bzang po'i skabs/lha klu btsan rnams kyi bka' grol la/yab yum gnyis kyi bka' yang grol/klu mo nor skal bcas pa ni/rang cag khyim gyi bdag mor phebs/g.yas na pho rgyud brgya yi bsu ma yod/g.yon na mo rgyud brgya yi bsu ma yod/nam mkha' 'ja' 'od gur khang phub/sa gzhir pad ma'i zhal kha phye/bskal bzang dga' ston rtsa ba tshugs/lha chen tshangs pa brgya byin gyis gtso bo byas pa'i/dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha rnams gso/ legs 'bul dar dkar 'di bzhes la/ki ki bswo bswo lha rgyal lo/mda' dar 'dzugs bshad/'o lags so/mda' 'di la tshang ba lnga ldan zer/ mi nga la 'dzoms pa rnam gsum zer/mi nga yi 'dzoms pa rnam gsum ni/rgyab tu rgyu nor longs spyod 'dzoms/153

mdun du pha ma bu phrug 'dzoms/khog tu gtam dang yig rtsis bsod nams dbang thang 'dzoms/'dzoms pa rnam gsum 'di la zhu/'dzoms pa'i 'dzoms dar dri med 'di/tshang ba lnga ldan phyag tu bzhes/mda' 'di skyes pa lho rong gting du skyes/gcod mkhan lho phrug spun gsum yin/thag pa rgya thag khra bos bsdams/'gel sa khyung dkar mdzo la bkal/la lungalam 'phrang rim pa brgyud nas/'dren pa gangs can bod la drangs/mda' bzo mkhas pa'i phyag tu phul/de nas tshang ba lnga ldan byung /bya rgyal rgod po'i rtse sgro dang gcigalug g.yang dkar gyi rgyus skud 'di dang gnyis/mtshal lcog lha'i rtse mtshon 'di dang gsum/rgya stong skud kyis dkris ma 'di dang bzhi/sbyar byed kyi spyin rtsi 'di dang lnga/tshang ba lnga ldan 'di ru zhu/lcags dkar mde'u yod pa 'di/dgra bo ma lus 'dul ba'i rtags/154

lho rong smyug ma tshigs gsum yod pa 'di/rigs gsum mgon po mtshon pa'i rtags/mda' la rtse lnga yod pa 'di/mnga' thang dgung la grags pa'i rtags/stong kha bal gyis gsol ba 'di/pho lha'i dbu 'phang mtho ba'i rtags/rbod sgro gnam la bltas pa 'di/bslu med dkon mchog gsum gyi rtags/dar mtshon sna lnga yod pa 'di/phywa dang g.yang su len pa'i rtags/'gron bu bu can brgyan pa de/bu nor longs spyod tshang ba'i rtags/gzi mchong la sogs rin chen du mas brgyan/dngul dkar me long brgyan pa 'di/gling bzhi 'od kyi khyab pa'i rtags/de 'dra'i rin chen mda' dar 'di/g.yas su btsugs na pho rgyud dar/g.yon du btsugs na mo rgyud dar/rgyab tu btsugs na bstan pa dar/mdun du btsugs na bu rgyud dar/dbus su btsugs na dbu 'phang ri rgyal lhun po lta bur 'gyur/155

de ring lha nyin dkar po la/klu sras khyed la 'dzugs rgyu yin/mtho ba dpon gyis 'phrog song sasu nga ru/ med dma' ba sprang pos lam rdung 'khel byung gsung sa med/rang dang rang mnyam phan tshun 'a /las dbang mthun pa'i mdza' grogs gnyen sgrig yin/dar gos la sogs nor bskal bcas pa ni/gnas khang 'di la gtan gyi mdun mar gnang /de ring lha nyin dkar po phan chad tshun chad nas/yul lung pa ga ge'i lha gral mi gral nang nas phud nga dang /yul lung pa ga ge'i lha gral mi gral nang tshud pa yin/ mda' dar rtse lnga dang g.yu chung gro dkar gyis bsu sa pa yin/mtshan la lcam chung gsol ba yin /'gro don bstan pa rgyas pa dang /bsam don lhun gyis 'grub par shog/na mo ki ki bswo bswo lha rgyal lo/156

bag ma skyel bshad/oṃ subaste bde legs su 'phel gyur cigabakra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs / de ring gnam la bltas pa'i skar ma bzang ༈ sa la nyi ma los kyang dro/bar du gza' tshes dus tshod bzang po'i skabs 'dir/nga tsho'i sras mo babs sa'i babs stegs e yod pha rgyud gangs ri dkar po la/ gangs phran gzhan gyi 'bre' ba med si la/babs stegs su gro khal brgya tham pa e yod ma rgyud bla mtsho sngon mo la/chu phran gzhan gyi 'brel ba med pa la/babs stegs su nas khal brgya tham nga/ e yo nga /rang rgyud lha shing shug pa la/'ing phran ga'an gyi 'brel ba med pa la /babs stegs su tshwa khal brgya tham pa e yod/sa sa'i pa da ma 'i steng gi rgya cog rkang bzhi'i steng na/lho tsan dan nags khang nas drangs pa'i/stag gdan gzig gdan gyi thogabakra shes gro yi g.yung drung bris pa'i steng du/157

nga tsho'i sras mo bab par bya/rdo dkaranag gi bshad pa/'o lags so/bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs/g.yas phyogs su yod pa'i lha rdo dkar po gsol lo/g.yas phyogs su yod pa'i lha rdo dkar po 'di/lha chen tshangs pa brgya byin gyi gtso bo byas pa'i/ dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha rnams gsol/ki ki bswo bswo lha rgyal lo/g.yon phyogs su yod pa'i 'dre rdo nag po 'di/dbyar gyi dus su dkar la rgyugs/dgun gyi dus su skyur la rgyugs/nam zhag rgyun nas rgyun du bzas kyi bcud la rgyugs/mi 4snying rtsa 'bud mkhan/phyugs kyi rwa rtsa dkrugs mkhan/lung pa'i phu mda' dkrug pa'i dkrug rdo/'dre ngan khyod sa phyogs 'di ru ma sdod gzhan du dongs shig158

sgo bshad/'o lags so/seng ge dkar mo 'dra ba'i gzhon nu ma/mtho gangs dkar mthongs la 'gran pa la/dpa' stag gzig 'dra ba'i 'khor zhig yod/sgo mo gser sgo gru bzhi'i g.yas g.yon na/skye pho gzhon mo gzhon byis pa tsho/lam lugs dang mthun pa'i 'khrungs rin 'di zhes las/bkra shis don grub sgo mo shar te phye/'o lags so/shar dar bkra shis legs pa'i dar dkar 'di na yod/'dzogs med kyi rdo dang 'dzad med kyi sa las grub pa'i khang bzang dkar po 'dir/phyi mi 'gyur rdo yi rtsig rmang bting /nang mi 'gyur brtan pa'i ka ba btsugs/steng du bstan pa dar ba'i dar cog btsugs/pho lha gnas pa'i bzhugs gnas yin/sgye dkar rab gsal nam mkha'i skar tshogs 'dra/mi lus rin chen thob dbang bzhugs gnas yin/'og na sgo ra gru bzhi yod pa 'di/sgo phyugs che chung 'dogs pa'i sdod gnas yin/159

sgo mo dngul dkar me long 'dra/phyis zhing phyis zhing dwangs du 'gro/sgo mo phyi sgo nang sgo bar sgo gsum/yas them ser po'i gser la bcol/mas them sngon mo g.yu la gcol/ru gnyis baiḍūrya la bcol/g.yogs shing steng rgyag 'og rgyag dkar po dung la bcol/gser dngul zangs lcags la sogs pa'i/sne lcags mu'u rgyud la bcol/sgo lcags phyi lcags re dang nang lcags re/phyi dgra rkun bsrungs nas brag las btsan/shar dar bkra shis legs pa 'di de ring lha nyin dkar po la/gser sgo gru bzhi'i rgyan la sgron pa la zhu/khang bshad/'o lags so/sgo mo phyi sgo gru bzhi 'dzul ba'i nang /rta ra gru bzhi rta yi khengs/gyi ling rta po 'tsher skad lhang lhang red/mdzo ra gru bzhi mdzo yi khengs/mdzo khyung dkar rwa rtse bzang bzang red/160

bong ra gru bzhi bong bus khengs/gcong rong bung bu sga tshags shig shig red/lug ra gru bzhi lug gis khengs/lug g.ya nga dkar 'ba' skad shang shang red/ra tshang gru bzhi ra yis khengs/ra tshe tshe 'tsher skad lam lam red/ba ra gru bzhi ba yis khengs/dkar 'o ma chu mig rdol rdol red/sgo rgyab khyi nor sgor 'dzoms dpag med de/dgra la ngar ba'i stag gzig 'dra ba dang /seng ge 'dra ba'i rngam gzigs che ba yod/nor 'phel dar dkar g.yang 'khyil 'di khyi la btags/'o lags so/sgo mo bar sgo gru bzhi 'dzul ba'i nang /skas pa steng skas gcig dang 'og skas gnyis/skas pa byang chub bde lam sku khams bzang /skas ru dpag bsam ljon shing la/skas zan tsan dan dmar po'i shing /sbar 'ju lha shing shug pa sngon mor bcol/rin chen zangs lcags la sogs pa'i shan sbyar ba'i/mi 'gyur brtan pa'i gzer mar btab/161

dung dkar po'i skas pa g.yas la yod/'go 'dren dpon po'i phebs skas yin/pad ser po'i skas pa g.yon na yod/rtsa ba'i bla ma gcig gi phebs skas yin/g.yu sngon mo'i skas pa dgung na yod/lha sras mdzes ma'i phebs skas yin/de ring lha nyin dkar po la/bcu gsum skas pa 'di la dar 'di sgron pa la zhu/'o lags so/skas pa yar la 'dzegs pa'i steng phyogs na/g.yab chen nyi 'od 'khyil 'dra la/g.yu sngon mo'i rdo gcal sgrig si sgrigadung dkar po'i ldebs ris lam ze lam/de yi phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad na/sgo mo brgyad la bkra shis rtags brgyad tshang /de yang chos kyi rgyal mtshan yod pa de/mchod khang phan bde'i 'byung gnas yin/gser gyi 'khor lo yod pa de/tshoms chen las kyi 'khor lo bskor ba yin/rin chen gdugs kyi rgyan pa de/gzim chung skyid phug bde ldan yin/162

gser nya kha sbyor yod pa de/khrung tshang bdud rtsi'i 'byung gnas yin/gter chen bum pa yod pa de/gnyer tshang nor gyi bang mdzod yin/dung dkar g.yas 'khyil yod pa de/thab tshang 'dod rgu 'khyil ba yin/rin chen dpal be'u yod pa de/skyid pa'i rab gsal 'phyong rgyan yin/pad dkar 'dab brgyad yod pa de/gsang spyod bde ba'i 'khor lo yin/bzhugs gral gyi bshad pa/'o lags so/tshoms chen las kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i nang du/skyid pa'i bzhugs gral gdan gang gru bzhi la/mchod khri padma'i yangs steng na/byin rlabs che ba'i sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs/gser khri'i steng du lha sras yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs/g.yu khri'i steng du khri lcam yid mdzes lha mo bzhugs/za 'og khri stegs phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i lha dpon gangs la nyi shar bzhugs/ka gdong mdzes pa'i rgyan du sgra dbyangs bsgyur ba'i ba rgyan gyi 163

dpa' bo bdagagayas stag gdan gyi steng la pho rtsal 'dzoms pa'i stag shar gyi gzhon pa/g.yon gzig gdan gyi steng la glu gar snyan pa'i dman shar gyi bu mo/g.yas gral nyi ma shar 'dra la/g.yon gral zla ba tshes bkra dang /dgung gral dgu tshigs rkyong 'dra dang /gzhung gral skar tshogs bkrag 'dra sogs/mdor na gral stod pa rnams seng ge gangs la 'gyings pa 'dra/gral sked pa rnams mu tig dar la bkod pa 'dra/gral smad pa rnams rma bya bzas la 'tsho ba 'dra/sgo rgyab gru mo 'gugs su bzhugs pa rnams/skyid pa'i ngang pa mtsho la tshog4pa lta bu'i dbus 'dir/lha klu btsan gsum 'dir tshogs spyan gyis gzigs/bdag blo'i bsam don grub pa'i bkra shis shogabakra shis zhal dro yun nas yun du gnas par gyur cigan mo ki ki bswo bswo lha rgyal lo/bgam thog phebs kyi bshad pa/oṃ suste/bkra shis bde legs su 'phel gyur cig1yo

ki ki bgo bswo lha rnams bswo/lha mchod cing bstod la gong ma lha/sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan pa'i/rtsa rgyud dpal ldan bla ma mchod/don gnyis mthar phyin rdzogs sangs rgyas/lung rtogs chos dang dge 'dun mchod/'gro la brtse chen rigs gsum mgon po mchod/lha rgyal tshangs pa gdong bzhi mchod/klu rgyal dga' bo 'jog po mchod/ dam can chos skyong srung ma mchod/phyogs skyong 'byung bzhi'i lha mo mchod/dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sde tshogs mchod/dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha klu rnams/'bral med spyi bo'i gtsug tu mchod/tshogs mchod me tog gdug spos dang /phye mar zhal zas mar me dang /bsangs dang yon chab ja chang 'o phud dang /dkar mo lag g.yas mda' dar bcas/dag pa'i mchod pa 'di dag bzhes su gsol/thugs rje zer gyis bdag cag 'gro kun la/skad cig g.yel med spyan gyis gzigs su gsol/mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rtsal du gsol/165

gsol 'debs byin rlabs myur du thugs rje zungs/'gro don chos skor bstan pa skor du gsol/mgon snang ba mtha' yas tshe dpag med/'chi med tshe yi tshe 'dzin mdzad du gsol/skyabs gnas bslu med dkon mchog gsum/chos dang bkra shis 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/bu gzhis mkhar ba tshugs par shogam gzhis 'bras bu smin par shogapha gzhis dbyar mtsho rgyas par shogaphun tshogs bde legs 'byung gnas lhun gyis grub/lho rong smyug bzang nyams rtse tshang la/rin chen dar tshon sna lnga rgyan pa 'di/mkhar chen 'di yi dbus su 'dzugs/nor 'dzin klu sras mdzes ma 'di/mdzes skyong spel ba'i grogs dang 'phrin las mdzod gyur cigan mo ki ki bswo bswo lha rgyal lo/'dzugasakyi bshad pa/oṃ swasti/bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs/bkra shis bde legs su 'phel gyur cigade ring gnam la bltas pa'i skar ma bzang /166

sa la bltas pa'i nyi ma dro/bar du gza' tshes 'byung 'phrod bzang /bzang gsum lha nyin dkar po la/yul lung pa gzhis rtse'i bu lha sras sras po dang /yul lung pa lha sa'i sras mo klu sras kyi sras mo gnyis/phan tshun las dbang mthun pa'i mdza' grogs gnyen sgrig gi skabs 'dir/nga zhang po rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi rten 'brel zhu ba'i 'dzugs/'dzugs mi zhu 'dzugs zhu/mi nor rtsa ba 'dzugs pa'i 'dzugs/bde skyid phun sum 'dzugs pa'i 'dzugs/gnas khang longs spyod 'dzugs pa'i 'dzugs zhu/'o lags so/rtswa chu gang bzang nas thon pa'i g.yang dkar gyi lugalug mi zhu lhug zhu/dbyar bal lhug pa'i lhugaston sha tshil lhug pa'i lhuganam zhag rgyun du ril ma lhug pa'i lhug zhu/rkang pa mi zhu khengs pa zhu/bang mdzod nor gyis khengs pa'i khengs pa zhu/mtshang ra mi zhu tshang ba zhu/167

mi nor kun yang tshang ba'i tshang ba zhu/long mi zhu longs spyod zhu/gnas khang longs spyod 'phel ba'i long zhu/rtsib ma mi zhu rtsig pa zhu/gnas khang rgya ja rtsig pa'i rtsig pa zhu/brang khog mi zhu drangs zhu/mi rgyud mda' la drangs pa'i drangs zhu/lag pa mi zhu legs pa zhu/bya ba thams cad legs pa'i legs pa zhu/mjing pa mi zhu 'gyings pa zhu/phyi dgra bo'i phyogs la 'gyings pa zhu/ltag rgyab mi zhu rtag pa zhu/gnas khang rtag du 'phel ba'i rtag pa zhu/de ring lha nyin dkar po la/bzhugs gral sgor mo'i rgyan du sgron pa la zhu/gro gso phye mar gyi bshad pa/'o lags so/gsol lo mchod do mchod do gsol/steng phyogs lha yi yul la mchod/lha chen tshangs pa dkar po mchod/'og phyogs klu yi yul la mchod/168

klu rgyal gtsug na rin chen mchod/yul 'di la gnas pa'i lha klu gzhis bdag thams cad mchod/byin rlabs char 'bebs rtsa ba'i bla ma mchod/dngos grub mchog stsol yi dam lha tshogs mchod/bar chad gsil mdzad mkha' 'gro chos skyong mchod/mthun rkyen 'grub mdzad nor lha gzhis bdag mchod/phye mar 'bru gro'i mchod pa dam pa 'di/bzhes nas bzhugs gral gdan gang gru bzhi la/byin rlabs dngos grub chen pos char 'bebs shigs gzhi theg pa chen po'i steng /mchod khri pad ma'i rkang bzhi btsugs/bde ba thob pa'i gser sder dngul sder nang /longs spyod ldan pa'i tshwa 'bru gro pad bkang /rin chen phye mar srid pa'i gangs ri 'dra/phyogs bzhi'i dkar rgyan nyi zla shar ba 'dra/snyan grags dgung la grags pa'i bstan du phul/de steng phye mar yod pa de/zhal phye ba'i phye mar red/de steng gro sder yod pa 'di/zhal dro ba'i zhal dro red/de steng 'bru sder yod pa de/'bru sna dar ba'i 'bru sder red/169

de steng tshwa sder yod pa de/stobs 'byor longasastod byang gi tshwa dang mnyam/de steng pad sder yod pa de/mi rgyud spel ba'i pad sder red/de steng brgyad bag yod pa de brgyad bag mi zhu rgyas pa zhu/steng du ltargyal dbu 'phang rgyas/'og tu klu rgyal dbu 'phang rgyas/bar du mi nor dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyas pa zhu/'o lags so/rgya gar gyi shing tsan dan sdong po la/bi sha kurmas bzo bkod pa'i/khal ru dkar po dung la bcol/khal ru'i dung las dkar ba med/'bo shan sngon mo g.yu la bcol/rin chen g.yu las dmar ba med/'bo lung dar tshon sna lngar bcol/'bru sna sne lnga tshang ba'i rten 'brel yin/phyi la zur bzhi yod pa 'di/phyogs bzhi'i dgra bo 'dul ba'i rtags/nang la 'gugs bzhi yod pa de/nang phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i 'gugs bzhi yin/170

de na 'bo rgyug yod pa 'di/zhal gcod pa'i khrims pa yin/khal ru mi zhu bstan ru zhu/brgya phar la btang nas stong tshur la bkug pa'i bstan ru zhu/de ring lha nyin dkar po la/bstan gtso gangs ri spung 'dra la/bstan pa dar ba'i dar zhig sgron pa la zhu/ka bshad/'o lags so/shar skyid tshal klu sdings nas gdan drangs pa'i/shug dkar gyi ka ba 'di la ka rab bcu gsum e tshang / (nang mis/ lags/ tshang yod/)tshang zer na yar kha tshang ba lnga ldan zhig sgron pa la zhu/'o lags so/ka rab bcu gsum los kyang tshang /dang po ka gdan nor bu'i rdo dang gcigaka ba ma 'gyur brtan du bzhugs/gzhu dang gzhu thung gzhu khebs gnyis/gdung dang gdung gdan gdung khebs gsum/pad ma chos brtsegs khyi sna bcas/171

ka rab bcu gsum 'di ru tshang /ka ba mi 'gyur gser la chags/gdung ma mi 'gyur dngul la chags/ka gzhu byu ru'i mchod rten la mi 'gyur rdo rje'i mtshan snyan bkod/lcam shing gral ma rgyu nor phun sum 'dzoms/sngar yang 'dzoms la da yang 'dzoms/da dung 'dzoms pa'i ngang la bzhugs/dar bshad/'o lags so/shar rgya yul bkra shis khri skor nas/gdan drangs pa'i rgya mo bsod nams can gyi phyag bzo pas 'khrungs pa'i/dar dri med a ru she ru 'khrungs/dar 'di la a shel dkar po zer/mtha' la g.yung drung lag 'brel 'di la tshang /bar la bkra shis rtags brgyad 'di la tshang /nang la nor bu dga' 'khyil 'di la tshang /dar snar dge legs tshig gi phreng ba bcas/de 'dra'i dar dkar bzang po 'di/mtho nam mkha' yar la yug tsam byas/gnam la skar gral sgrig pa dang /172

nam mkha' khengs pa'i gtam zhig byung /dma' sa gzhi ma la dbyug tsam byas/sa gzhi 'bru sna 'dzoms pa dang /sa gzhi khengs pa'i nor zhig byung /bar bzhugs gral sgor mor yug tsam byas/bzhugs gral skyid 'khor 'dzoms pa dang /bzhug4gral pa rnams dgongs pa mnyes/de ring ltanyin dkar po la/gzim chung kabazhi gdung brgyadakyi ka ba'i rgyan du sgron pa la zhu/mtho nam mkha'i dbyings nas phul te/bar skyid ka ba la skor ba g.yas skor lan gsum brgyab/da dung yang sa gzhi theg pa chen po'i steng /lug thong pa nyal ba tsam skya 'khyil le 'dug pa'o/khrung zhu'i bshad pa/'o lags so/yul stag lung bde ldan yul nas gdan drangs pa'i/'khyil zhu o rgyan gyi 'bud ma la/phyi 'di nas bltas na ri bo 'dra/ri bo bzhin du 'gyur ba med/nang 'di nas bltas na rgya mtsho 'dra/rgya mtsho bzhin du 'dzad pa med/173

phyi rta rnga tsam zhig gas pa med/nang nyung dkar tsam zhig brul ba med/sku rlung dar ba'i dar cog btsugs/yar ga tshang ba'i lnga ldan brgyab/phyi star mar gyi lha shod la/nang star rgyal ba rigs lnga mtshon/rtsa ba klu yi yul na yod/klu dga' bo 'jog po'i yul na yod/sked pa btsan gyi yul na yod/lha tshangs pa brgya byin yul na yod/gting na lo chang gar ma 'khyil/bar la 'bras chang bsil ma 'khyil/kha la a rag bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'khyil/rgya mtsho hub la 'dren mkhan mi nga re tsam/de ring lha nyin dkar po la/bstan pa dar ba'i dar zhig sgron pa la zhu/khrungargyug gi bshad pa/'o lags so/yul lho rong yul nas gdan drangs pa'i/khrung rgyug tshug ma tshigs gsum 'di/rtsa ba stag shar gzhon pa'i zhal gling nyan/174

gsung snyan pa dri za'i pi wang 'dra/rtse mo sku rlung dar ma'i dar shing nyan/sku bsod dbang thang dar ba de nas byung /sked pa a ma chang ma'i khrung rgyug nyan/khrung yang yang skyon pa'i rten 'brel yod/rgyal khrims gser gyi gnya' shing gzhir bzhag pas/chos khrims dar gyi mdud pa 'di dgos shing /rtsa ba bzhugs gral sgor mo 'dir/bka' ba'i khrims dpon chen po 'di la bcol/phebs zer na gyen log zhu sa med/de ring lha nyin dkar po la/bstan pa dar ba'i dar zhig sgron pa la zhu/rdza'o yi bshad pa/'o lags so/mi 'gyur rgya cog rkang bzhi'i steng /rin chen gser dngul zangs kyi rigs/bzo bo mkhas pas legs grub pa'i/rdza'o legs mo bod du 'bod/bzo legs pa bum pa bzang po'i dbyibs/zhal rgyan rgyal ba rigs lnga 'dra/nang dngul chu dkar po'i mdangs dang ldan/175

mdun mchu to yar la gtad pa de/chang rgyun chu las ring ba'i rtags/lung la long sgor mo bskor ba 'di/pha jus lung nas bton bton la/bu jus a long 'dom pa 'dra/rdza'o nyid dang ma pham g.yu mtsho 'dra/mdzes shing yid 'ong lto ldir ba'i nang /rgya gar yul gyi a rag dang /rgya nag yul gyi 'bras chang dang /stod la dwags yul gyi rgun 'brum chang /gangs can bod kyi dkar mo nas chang sogs/kun gyi bcud ldan 'dzad med bdud rtsi'i gter/de steng khrung skyogs spun gsum 'di/gser skyogs dngul skyogs rag skyogs gsum/bzhugs gral sgor mo'i rgyan du mdzes/yar ga tshang ba'i lnga ldan 'di/mnga' thang dgung la gnas par gyur cigade ring lha nyin dkar po la/bstan pa dar ba'i dar zhig sgron pa la zhu/bu'ibashad pa/'o lags so/176

pha rgyud tsan dan gyi sdong po la/bu rgyud lha shing shug pa 'dra/dbyar sngo yang mi sngo lha shing gi shug pa/dgun skya yang mi skya lha shing gi shug pa/dus dbyar ston dgun dpyid gang la yang /shug pa sngo mo g.yo med rtag tu gnas/pha bzang rgyud kyi bu bzang khyed/blo dang rig pa shes rab ldan/bsam don dbang thang ri dang mnyam/bzhin legs stobs ldan mtshan nyid tshang ba'i bu/pho rtsal dgu dang pho rtse dgu 'dzoms pa'i/yid bzhin nor las lhag pa'i dpa' yon can/stag shar bzang pos gnang dar 'di/dkar po'i dar la yug cig yin/de ring bkra shis nyi ma la/lha sras khyed kyi mgul la sgron/bstan pa dar ba'i rten 'brel zhu/ pho rab kyi dar de g.yas nas sgron te g.yon la 'khyil/'o lags so/bu gnyis pa gangs stod seng ge 'dra/dbu la g.yu rwa skyes nas yod/177

lus la rtsal drug tshang nas yod/sder chags gzig gis non lugs yin/phyi dgra la phyar na dpa' dam yin/nang gnyen la ngoms na rgya dar yin/bod dar dkar po mgul ring 'di/de ring bkra shis nyi ma la/lha sras khyed kyi mgul du sgron/bstan pa dar ba'i rten 'brel la zhu/bag bshad/'o lags so/rten 'brel phying dkar gru bzhi'i steng /rgyu rin chen 'bru rigs sna lnga yi/gdan g.yung drung pad ma bris pa'i steng /sman yid 'ong yid 'phrog lha mo ltar/me tog pad ma'i snum mdangs can/spyan mig skar chen shar ba 'dra/skra lo pho rog zar 'thung 'dra/mgul ba dngul gyi bum pa 'dra/gsung snyan g.yu bya khu byug 'dra/tshems dkar dung 'phreng star pa 'dra/mkhur tshos mtshal gyi mdangs dang 'dra/178

'dra ba brgyad kyi gzugs dang ldan/mdun gar bltas so dkar 'dzum legs yin/rgyab gar bltas spa lo'i dpung rgyan yin/zur gar bltas man shel spungs pa 'dra/bzhugs zer na smyug seng ldem ldem 'dra/bzhugs zer na gur dkar phub pa 'dra/gnas 'di yi khyim bdag mngal gsol nas/khyed phebs sam mi sems 'dzin pa mkhas/zas lag bcud ldan zhing 'khor g.yog skyong /dpal bu nor 'dzoms pa'i ngang la bzhugs/klu rgyal btsun mos gnang dar 'di/phywa g.yang 'khugs pa'i rten 'brel yod/de ring bkra shis nyi ma la/klu sras khyed kyi mgul la sgron/bstan pa dar ba'i rten 'brel zhu/mo rab kyi dar 'di g.yon nas sgron te g.yas la 'khyil/yab chen gyi bshad pa/'o lags so/sku ri rgyal bzhin du lhing ba dang /gsung lho sprin bzhin du 'tshub pa dang /thugs nyi zla bzhin du gsal ba dang /179

ngag rgya dar bzhin du 'jam pa dang /yab chen nyid dang ri rgyal lhun po 'dra/ri rgyal lhun po g.yo med rtag tu gnas/dpon po bzang pos gnang dar 'di/rgya dar dkar po dri med yin/de ring bkra shis nyi ma la/yab chen khyed kyi mgul la sgron/bstan pa dar ba'i rten 'brel zhu/yum chen gyi bshad pa/'o lags so/sku rgya mtsho bzhin du 'khyil ba dang /gsung khu byug bzhin du snyan pa dang /thugs gangs ri bzhin du gsal ba dang /ngag chu mo bzhin du ring ba dang /yum chen nyid dang kha gshis gshong ldan 'dra/kha gshis gshong ldan 'gyur ba med pa'i ngang la bzhugs/ma sru bzang pos gnang dar 'di/bod dar dkar po g.yang 'khyil yin/de ring bkra shis nyi ma la/yum chen khyed kyi mgul du sgron/bstan pa dar ba'i bkra shis shog180

ane la bshad pa/'o lags so/a ne lags dang byi ru'i mchod rten 'dra/phyi nas bltas na byi ru'i mchod rten 'dra/nang nas bltas na dam chos rtsig pa 'dra/byi ru'i mchod rten ma 'gyur brtan par bzhugs/kha btags dri med dkar gtsang 'di/a ne lags kyi mgul du phul ba la dang zhu/lha dpon la bshad pa/'o lags so/lha dpon yid bzhin nor bu khyed/dbu 'phang gangs la nyi shar 'dra/gsung chos bar snang 'brug ltar grags/lha mi mthun sbyor bka' gsung gnang /rkyen ngan bar chad ldog pa dang /dkar nag rtsis kyi lung bstan mdzad/phywa g.yang 'gugs dang gsol 'debs 'bul/byin rlabs dngos grub char ltar phab/lha dkon mchog dbu 'phang dgung la bstod/skye 'gro bde ba'i 'phrin las sgrub/181

bla ma bzang pos gnang dar 'di/chos sgo phye ba'i rten 'brel yod/de ring bkra shis nyi ma la/lha dpon khyed kyi mgul la sgron/bstan pa dar ba'i rten 'brel zhu/bar mi la bshad pa/'o lags so/chu phan tshun gnyis kyi zam pa dang /rgya bod gnyis kyi lo tsā ba/chu dang nya mo mthun sdeb la/sbrang char zil mas skul ma byung /spang dang shā ba mdzes sdeb la/rtsi thog sngo mos bsu ma byung /gangs dang seng ge mtho sdeb la/bu yug kha bas yas sgron byung /bu dang bu mo mthun sbyor la/sgrig 'dum pa shes can khyed kyis gnang /sku 'o brgyal che ba bka' drin che/dkar zhing gtsang ba'i lhun grub dar dkar 'di/rgyu ni rgya la spun ni bod/rgya bod zung sbyor dri med dar dkar 'di/182

de ring lha nyin dkar po la/spyi dpon khyed kyi mgul la sgron/bstan pa dar ba'i rten 'brel la dang zhu/gnyer ba la bshad pa/'o lags so/gnyer chen lags dang lha gnam thos dzam lha'i/mtshon nang bang mdzod dga' rab kha phye nas/nor 'dod rgu longs spyod btang ba'i rten du phul ba la dang zhu/khrung dpon la bshad pa/'o lags so/khrung dpon bde can yid shes la/bdud rtsi rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i rten du phul/ma byan la bshad pa/'o lags so/ma chen mo mar khu'i rgya mtsho 'dra/zas dus thog gtong mkhan ma byan red/ye shes me la 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/rtag tu skyid pas mchod pa'i sprin khrod nas/183

rogs kyi zas bcud 'phel ba'i rten du phul ba la dang zhu/khrung zhum la bshad pa/khrung zhu mag pa rgya gar rma bya 'dra/sgro mdongs rgyas pa'i brten du phul/khrung zhu ma kha pa lho rong ne tso 'dra/gsung dbyang4sgrog pa'i rten du phul ba la zhu/phyugasarje la bshad pa/'o lags so/phyugs rdzi dzam lha'i sprul pa la/mtho ri rgyal lhun po grogs su bkugathang chen po rtswa kha bzang si bzang /ri lung dbye med rtswa rgyud chu rgyud lon/phyugs grangs med 'phel rgyur bkra shis brtan re 'phel/grong yar rgyas mi yong smon ci dgos/bkra shis gong 'phel kha btags dkar po 'di/g.yang dpon bsod nams can gyi mgul du phul pa la zhu/mjug sgrig bkra shis smon lam/oṃ suste/bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs/184

de ring lha nyin dkar po nas bzung /slad nam phugs bar la gnas khang 'di/rgyab ri bo bzhin du spungs pa dang /mdun rgya mtsho bzhin du 'khyil ba dang /phyi mi 'gyur bkra shis rtags brgyad ris/nang mi 'gyur rgyal srid sna bdun ris/bar mi 'gyur dgos 'dod kun byung ris/sku mi 'gyur ri rgyal lhun por brtan/gsung mi 'gyur tshangs pa'i gsung dbyangs brtan/thugs mi 'gyur khyim bdag chen po brtan/gnas khang mi 'gyur longs spyod khang gsar 'di/mi nub ji srid bar du brtan par shogazong 'dod rgu 'dzom4pa'i khyim gzhis 'dir/phywa zla ba bzhin du sgor ro ro/g.yang nyi ma bzhin du 'khyil li li/ bu rigs rgyud tsha bo grangs med 'phel/stobs mnga' thang btsan phyug mkhan gsum rgyas/gtam snyan pa'i dar chen dgung la mchor/dpal grags pa'i dung dkar phyogs su bus/ dpal tshangs pa sde bzhir longs spyod pa'i/don bsam pa chos bzhin 'grub par shogashar gyi dar g.yang khug pa'i bkra shis shog185

lho yi nang g.yang khug pa'i bkra shis shoganub kyi nor g.yang khug pa'i bkra shis shogabyang gi phyugs g.yang khug pa'i bkra shis shogaphyogs kyi phywa g.yang khug pa'i bkra shis shogabade skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis shogami nor dar zhing rgyas pa'i bkra shis shogaskyon ngan bar chad med pa'i bkra shis shogami nad phyugs nad med pa'i bkra shis shogachar chu dus subabs pa'i bkra shis shogalo legs skya rgyas yong ba'i bkra shis shogadus rtag tu bkra shis bde legs shoganyin mo bde legs mtshan mo bde legs/nyin mtshan kun tu bde legs pa'i/skyabs gnas bslu med dkon mchog gsum gyi/deng 'dir bkra shis bde legs shogamanga' thang lha ltar mnyam pa'i bkra shis shogalongasaspyod klu dang mnyam pa'i bkra shis shogabasam don yid bzhin grub pa'i bkra shis shoga'agro don bstan pa rgyas pa'i bkra shis shoga'aphrin las lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis shogabakra shis nam mkha' gang ba dang /smon lam sa gzhir khyab par 'gyur cig1cha

na mo ki ki bswo bswo lha rgyal lo/lha rgyal lo/ lha rgyal lo/gnyen bshad/oṃ swasti/gnyen yig nang gi thog ma'i shis tshig la/gnas skabs mthar thug phan bde'i rin chen tshogs/yid bzhin mdzod du 'dren pa'i shing rta che/gang la brten na bsdu ba'i skabs bral ma/rin chen rnam gsum spyi bo'i rgyan du mchod/'jig rten srid pa'i thabs shes nor bu 'grogs/las bzang mdza' gcugs gnyen du mthun sdeb pa/mdzangs pa'i bya gzhag gtan la legs phab pa'i/gnyen yig nor bu'i do shal 'di ru spel/gdung gi mchod rten ldebs la/ri mo stag gzig khyung 'brugarlung chen lo gsum brgyab kyang /ri mo zub sa ma red/char chen lo gsum btang kyang /ri mo 'dag sa ma red/gal srid ri mo zub na/dman chung bu mos 'bri chog187

gal srid ri mo 'dag na/stag shar gzhon pas 'bri chogagatsug g.yu'i bshad pa/oṃ susti/bde legs su gyur cigarig stobs dpal 'byor mnga' thang lang tsho tshogs/g.yang gi rtsi zhag kun chags bro dkar g.yu/de ring mdzes ma'i gtsug tu phul ba 'di/bkra shis dge mtshan gong nas gong du 'phel shogamada' dar gyi bshad pa/'o lags so zhes zhus pas/lho rong gting nas gdan drangs pa'i mda' mo 'di/lho rong skug ma mda' dang gcigarin chen lcags kyi mde'u dang gnyis/thang dkar rgod po'i sgro dang gsum/rtsa che dngul dkar me long 'di dang bzhi/dar tshon sna lnga'i rgyan dang lnga/mda' 'di la tshong pa lnga ldan zhu/bu nga la 'dzoms pa rnam gsum zhu/g.yas su pha nor 'dzoms ni 'dzoms pa yin/188

g.yon du bu nor 'dzoms ni 'dzoms pa yin/gong du shes bya 'dzoms ni 'dzoms pa yin/'dzoms pa rnam gsum de la zhu/kha btagasaspyi bshad pa la/lag tu 'dzin pa'i dar dkar 'di/steng lha mo gsum gyis bkal le yin/bar gnyan mo gsum gyis bsgrim le yin/'og klu mo gsum gyis btags le yin/dar 'gor bkra shis rtags brgyad yod/dar dkyil rgyal srid sna bdun yod/dar 'dabs mu tig 'dzar lo yod/byung ba nag po rgya nag byung /dar ba 'jig rten khams la dar/bu mo gdananas 'drenaskabasakyi bshad pa/pha bzang gi bu mo yar bzhengs shogam bzang gi bu mo yar bzhengs shigalha yul skyid pa'i zhing stod bde khang du/pha yab chen gangs dkar ti se 'dra/de la dgongs te bu mo yar bzhengs shigayum chen a ma ma pham g.yu mtsho 'dra/189

de la dgongs te bu mo yar bzhengs shigatshe gang gtan grogs gangs la nyi shar 'dra/de la dgongs te bu mo yar bzhengs shigaphu na g.yag lug rta gsum bsam mi khyab/de la dgongs te bu mo yar bzhengs shigamada' na sa khang 'bru yi bang mdzod yod/de la dgongs te bu mo yar bzhengs shigabumo'i gzhonarta la bshadapa/rta 'di rta ngo ma shes na/gyi ling gnam rta dkar po yin/a ce rgya bza'i chibs chen yin/steng lha nas gnang ba'i lha rta ngang pa yin/la la 'gro ba'i la rta 'di la zhu/'og klu nas gnang ba'i klu rta sngon mo yin/chu la 'gro ba'i chu rta 'di la zhu/bar btsan nas gnang ba'i btsan rta rkyang po yin/thang la 'gro ba'i thang rta 'di la zhu/sngon dus lha gcig kong jos chibs/kha gro g.yang chags kyi rta zhig yin/da lta rigs bzang gi bu mos chibs/kha gro g.yang chags kyi bag rta 'di la zhu/190

mtho po dkar po'i bshad pa/mtho po dkar po steng phyogs lha yi mtho/lha tshangs pa dkar po'i mtho rten yin/pho lha dang dgra lha yi/bde skyid kyi rtsa ba 'dzugs pa'i mtho/dus de ring phun sum tshogs pa'i nyin/bkra shis kyi dar dkar 'di la 'bul/g.yas phyogs dkar ba'i lha mtho dkar po 'di/yul sde dkar ba'i dkar rdo yin/nang mi dkar ba'i dkar rdo yin/bza' tshang dkar ba'i dkar rdo yin/khyim mtshes dkar ba'i dkar rdo yin/dus de ring rten 'brel dge 'dzoms nyin/bkra shis kyi mgul dar 'di la 'bul/mtho ponag po'i bshad pa/mtho 'di nag po bdud kyi mtho/mi kun la gnod byed dgra bo'i mtho/dus de ring rten 'brel dge 'dzoms nyin/ngan khyod ni 'jog pa'i thabs med pas/mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu song zhig191

g.yon phyogs nag pa'i 'dre mtho nag po 'di/yul sde dkrug pa'i dkrug rdo yin/khyim mtshes dkrug pa'i dkrug rdo yin/nang mi dkrug pa'i dkrug rdo yin/bza' tshang dkrug pa'i dkrug rdo yin/dkrug rdo 'di ru ma sdod byang snye ma mi skyes sar rgyugs ang /sgo skas dnganang gi sgrig chasakyi bshad pa/bkra shis nyams su dga' ba'i lha tshogs kyi/'jig rten khams kun bde legs kyi/snang ba bzang posakhyab pa des/mi nor yongs kyi bsam pa grub/de ring sa gzhi la nyi ma dro/gnam la skar ma bzang /bar du dus tshes kyi gza' skar phun sum tshogs pa'i nyin 'dir/mkhar dkar po'i mdun sa gru bzhi nas 'khyer yong ba'i/sgo mo phyi sgo gcig dang nang sgo gcigabar sgo tsan dan smug po'i sgo/them pa sngon mo'i g.yu la bcol/ru bzhi spug po'i zong la bcol/sgo 'bor dngul dkar me long yin/192

skas 'dzeg tsan dan dkar dmar byas pa 'di/'dzeg bzhin lhod pas/steng du 'ja' 'od kyi gur phub/'og na gcan gzan gyi pags pa'i gdan bting /bar du rin chen lnga lasib pa'i snod bzang po'i nang /mchod chang yorag bdud rtsi mtsho ltar 'khyil/de snga yang 'khyil da yang 'khyil/rgyab mdzes pa'i dar gos kyi yol ba/mdun dkar po'i gser cog dngul cogarna bar snyan pa'i glu gar pi wang /gling bu sogs thos pa tsam gyis/yid dbang 'phrog pa'i gnas bzang po/rnam thos sras kyi bang mdzod/lha mi'i longasaspyod 'dod dgu'i/dpal dang ldan pa g.yang chags kyi/khang bzang 'di lta bur slebs pa shin tu skal ba re bzang /bzhugs gral gyi bshad pa/oṃ bde legs su gyur cigabakra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs/a ma bag gro sku khams bzang /gtan du bde ba thob par shog193

g.yu chung gru dkar bstan pa dar/'o lags so zhes zhus pas/g.yas stag gral la 'khod pa'i dpa' bo'i bzhugs gral dang /g.yon gzig gral la 'khod pa'i dpa' mo'i bzhugs gral/zur zur gru mo gug tu bzhugs pa dang /ka gdong seng ge'i gral du bzhugs pa dang /sgo rgyab a long gug tu bzhugs pa rnams/snyan gyi dbang po gsan par zhu/sa yul skyid pa'i bkra shis dge 'khod 'di/chos grwa chen po dpal ldan sa skya'i shar/gdan sa mtho ba bkra shis lhun po'i lho/'bru sna 'dzoms pa shel dkar rgyal rtse'i nub/zas sna 'dzoms pa tshong 'dus pha ri'i byang /phu ru spang chags 'brog sde brgya phrag gnas/g.yag ra lug gsum gzhan la smon dgos med/rkang bzhis kun khyab longs spyod mar la bcol/sha mar longs spyod 'dzoms pa'i ngang la bzhugs/bar du rten chags ka bzhi gdung brgyad gnas/gser g.yu mu tig nor bu'i bang mdzod yod/rgan dar gzhon gsum bkra shi4bde legs yod/mda' ru rten chags sa zhing brgya phrag gnas/194

'bru sna 'dzoms shing longs spyod chang la bcol/a rag bdud rtsi 'di 'dra'i ngang la btang /nas sran gro sogs gang dga' gang 'dod yod/'o lags so zhes zhus pas/chos sku'i ston pa kun tu bzang po mchod/longs sku'i ston pa spyan ras gzigs dbang mchod/sprul sku'i ston pa padma 'byung gnas mchod/sku 'bum bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/'dzam gling lte ba rgya gar rdo rje gdan/bod kyi lte ba dbus kyi po ta la/lha sa bod kyi yar ba yin/bod kyi bstan pa gang du dar/bla ma bka' skyong dam chos kun tu khyab/dpon po'i bka' skyong khams gsum dbang du 'dus/smra ba ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam dpal dbyangs/dbyangs can lha mo gtsug lag 'dod 'jo'i dpal/dpal ldan tshangs pa de bzhin legs par 'dzin/'dzin pa'i man ngag mi rnams kyis shes par mdzod/drin can pha mas dka' bas yar bzhengs pa'i/bkra shis g.yang du 'khyil ba'i pho brang nang /gnas khang bzang po'i bu rgyud khyad 'phags gsum/rgan pa gser gyi nyi ma'i gzhogs ya la/195

bar pa dung gi zla ba 'dra zhig yod/gzhon pa dngul gyi skar chen 'dra zhig yod/pho de gsum bsod nams che ba dang /sngon las smon lam gzhan las cher mchog pas/drin can bu la brtse ba'i yab yum gyi/sha khrag lus las grub pa'i sras su 'khrungs/rgan 'og gzhon tshul gzhan la smon dgos med/pha mas bu byams bu yis pha mar bkur/gnas khang longs spyod yar ngo'i zla bas 'gran/khyed bzang khyed yag gus pa'i bsngags brjod mang /nga dga' nga skyid bkra shis gtam bzang mang /da yang 'jig rten kun gyi 'gro lugs ltar/ngo mtshar sras kyi 'jig rten mdun thabs su /don grub yar 'phel bkra shis ('gro ming )gi/sras mo rgan pa (mna' ma'i ming )gdan drangs pa'i skabs 'dir/gnam mi 'gyur 'khor chen brgyad kyi 'ogs mi 'gyur padma 'dab brgyad de/bar mi 'gyur pho brang 'di yi nang /phu nas 'brog pa'i mar thud char ltar babs/mda' ru 'bru sna btab tshad dus su smin/char chu bzang po lo phyugs rtag tu legs/196

tshe ring nad med lus ngag yid gsum bde/rdzogs ldan dga' ston slebs par byin gyis rlobs/na mo ki ki bswo bswo lha rgyal lo/sgo mo'i bshad pa/oṃ swaste/bde legs su gyur cigasgo mo bkra shis rgyan chags 'di/yar them ser po gser gyis byas/mar them sngon mo g.yu yis byas/ru bzhi beeḍūrya yis byas/me long tsan dan dmar pos byas/dung gi dbye shing lu gu rgyud/sgo 'bor sgo shan gser gyis byas/sgo mo gser sgo g.yu sgo'i nang /rnam sras nor gyi bang mdzod yod/phun sum g.yang chags 'dod rgu 'dzoms/sgo dar bang dri med 'di/de ring skal bzang nyi ma la/sgo mar phye bar byas nas bzung /bkra shis sgo brgya rtag tu phye bar gyur cig197

skas 'dzeg gi bshad pa/steng 'og phye ba'i skas 'dzeg de/mtho chen bcu gsum mthon po'i skas/ru gnyis beeḍūrya yis byas/'chang bzung rdo rje pha lam yin/skas gdang rin chen bdun brtsegs kyi/bkra shis skas 'dzeg rim 'dzegs la/skas dar rgyal srid sna bdun yod/ka bar dar 'bul ba'i bshadapa/steng dga' ldan lha yi pho brang dang /sgo kun nas mtshungs pa'i khang bzang 'dir/rgyu tsan dan sbrul snying las grub pa'i/ka rabs bshad pa 'tshal ba la/phyi gru bzhi lha yi gzhal yas khang /nang srung skyob pho lha'i rten mkhar yin/'og mi 'gyur ka stegs nor bu'i rdo/rgyu sra bar rang grub sgor mo yod/bre phreng dang nor bus brgyan pa gsum/gzhu ring dang gzhu thung gzhu khebs mdzes/gdung dang gdung gdan gdung khebs bkra/198

pad ma chos brtsegs nyi zla bcas/ka rabs bcu gsum tshang ba 'di/gzhi mi 'gyur brtan pa'i ka ba yin/sngon srid pa chags pa'i dus skabs nas/dus da lta bar du'ang gnas khang 'dir/dpal phun sum tshogs pa'i ka ba byas/gzhi mi 'gyur brtan pa'i ka ba yin/gzhi lhun grub 'dod rgu g.yang du 'khyil/dus de ring phun sum tshogs pa'i nyin/dar dkar 'di ka ba'i rgyan du 'bul/tshe dang longs spyod gong 'phel shoga'o lags so zhes zhus pas/shar skyes rtsal klu gting nas gdan drangs pa'i shel dkar gyi ka ba 'di la/bstod pa 'bul ba la/ka rabs kyi bcu gsum tshang yang yod/(gzhan gyis lags yod do/)ka rabs bcu gsum gyi bstod pa la/ka stegs dang po rin chen sa la bcol/ka stegs gnyis pa nor bu'i rdo la bcol/ka ba bre dang phreng ba gsum/gzhu ring gzhu thung gzhu khebs gsum/199

gdung dang gdung gdan gdung khebs gsum/pad ma chos brtsegs nyi zla'i rgyan/lcam shing drel ma bu nor 'dzoms/sngar yang 'dzoms la da yang 'dzoms/gtan yun ring 'dzoms pa'i ngang la zhugs/pho rabs gser gyi ka ba 'dra/ka ba ma 'gyur ngang du zhugs/mo rabs g.yu yi gdung ma 'dra/god chag med pa'i ngang la zhugs/'o lags so/rgya zhing chen bco brgyad nas gdan drangs pa'i/dar dkar po'i dri med rnam thag 'di/mtho ba nam mkha' yar la 'phyar zer na/gangs stod kyi mdangs kyang gcog pa yod/dma' ba gtsang gzhung mar la bsnar zer na/gtsang chab sngon mo'i chu sna las ring /ri mo yag pa la byas na bkra shis rtags brgyad tshang /lha tshangs pa mjal ba'i mjal dar yin/dma' gong ma mjal ba'i mjal dar yin/de ring gnas khang gi ka ba'i rgyan du sgron/g.yas nas btags pas g.yon la 'khyil le bzhugs/g.yon nas btags pas g.yas su 'khyil le bzhugs/200

ka ba'i rtse nas btang bas ka gsham ma ru nyil le bzhugs/ka gsham ma ru lug po skya chen gyi bal spung pa ltar skya phung 'di spung yod/khrung zhu dman chung bu mo tshos/zhabs mdo 'khon gyi dogs gnang a/ha ha/rtenasa'i bshad pa/oṃ susti/gang zhig dran pa yis kyang 'phral yun phan bde'i 'bras bu kun stsol thub pa dang dpag bsam ljon pa che/gang gsung bdud rtsi'i thigs phran thos 'dzin bu gar sem pas kyang ni srid zhi'i gdung sel dam pa'i chos/gang dag theg pa gsum gyi lam bar zhugs pa slob pa 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gser ri'i phreng ba bcas/gangs 'dir skyabs gsum dam pas rigs myug dpal 'byor tshe —bsod mnga' thang la sogs kun tshogs ngangos kun stsol/phye mar dngarten khri'i bshad pa/oṃ susti/la stod phyogs nas gdan drangs pa'i rgya cog gru bzhi 'di/phyi la zur bzhi yod pa 'di/201

phyi dgra bo'i phyogs la zur ba yin/nang la gug bzhi yod pa 'di/nang phywa g.yang 'gug pa'i gug bzhi yin/de'i steng du yod pa'i phye mar gyi gangs ri 'od 'phro 'di/zhal tsho gangs las dkar ba'i rten 'brel yin/de'i steng du yod pa'i 'bri mar ser po'i dkar rgyan 'di/gnas khang 'di mar 'brog las sgril ba'i rten 'brel yin/de'i g.yon du yod pa'i rgya gro dkar mo 'di/zhal dro ba'i gro gcig yin/de'i steng du yod pa'i byang tshwa dkar po 'di/bya ba tshabs su 'gro ba'i tshwa gcig zer/o rgyan ba so dkar po las grub pa'i/gzugs bkod legs pa'i rten 'brel mchod gshom 'di/bltas pa tsam gyis 'gro rnams dbang du 'dus/sdig pa tsam gyis sde brgyad bran du bkol/bsam pa tsam gyis dgos 'dod char ltar 'bebs/o rgyan rin po che la mgul dar legs pa gcig 'bul lo/khrung ban gyi bshad pa/oṃ susti/rgyu rin chen sna lnga las grub pa'i/'khyil bzhugs rin chen bum bzang 'di/202

nang lha yi bdud rtsis yongs bkang nas/mar dkar ser gyi yar ga rgyan gyis mdzes/lho rma bya'i yul gyi snyug ma yis/g.yas skor dang g.yon skor lan gsum brgyab/bdud rtsi lha yi rgya mtsho 'khyil ba 'dra/'dir bzhugs kyi zhugs gral sgor mo rnams/a la la bdud rtsi yid tshim par mdzod/shing byang chub ljon shing rtsa ba nas/yal 'dab sogs me tog gi ge sar 'khrungs/dar tshon sna lnga yi cod pan sgron/rlung mda' sogs dar zhing rgyas pa'i dar gcig 'bul/khrung phor gyi bshad pa/oṃ susti/bde legs su 'phel gyur cigargya nag gting nas gdan drangs pa'i/'khyil zhugs o rgyan padma la/yal se tshang ba'i lnga ldan sgron/phyi na rta rnga tsam zhig gas pa med/nang ni sgong khog tsam zhig zhom pa med/na ning btsos pa'i lo chang kham pa yod/da lo btsos pa'i 'bras chang bsil ma yod/203

'khyil zhugs o rgyan pad ma 'di/phyi nas bltas na ri bo 'dra/nang nas bltas na rgya mtsho 'dra/rgya mtsho'i nang na shing zhig 'dugagatsug na rin chen klu yi sras/bar gnam khams na dar zhig 'dugatshangs pa rgyal chen lha yi sras/lha sras dang klu sras 'debs 'dug pa'i/'khyil zhugs o rgyan 'bum mtsho la/bkra shis kyi mgul dar zhig 'bul/ khrung rgya'i bshad pa/oṃ susti/bde legs su 'phel gyur cigalho rong gting nas gdan drangs pa'i/khrung rgya smyug ma tshig gsum 'di/rtsa ba stag shar gzhon pa'i zhal gling nyan pa yod/sked pa a ma chang ma'i khrung rgya nyan pa yod/rtse mo sku rlung dar ba'i dar cog nyan pa yod/rtsa ba tshig gi dang po ni/'og klu 'khor dbang du 'dus pa'i rten 'brel yin/sked pa tshig gi gnyis pa ni/204
bar btsan 'khor dbang du 'dus pa'i rten 'brel yin/rtse mo tshig gi gsum pa ni/steng lha 'khor dbang du 'dus pa'i rten 'brel yin/ki ki bswo bswo lha rgyal lo/205

khrungaja'i bshad pa/oṃ susti/bde legs su 'phel gyur cigal stod bkram dkyil tshal nas gdan drangs pa'i/khrung rdzas ma pham g.yu mtsho 'di/phyi ni rin chen gser dang zangs la gsham/nang ni dbang 'dus g.yu mtsho 'khyil/g.yas su a long btags pa 'di/stag gral non pa'i a long yin/g.yon du a long btags pa 'di/gzig gral non pa'i a long yin/zhal mchu dbyings la bstan pa 'di/zhugs gral yongs la bstan pa yin/khrung rdza ma pham g.yu mtsho la/bkra shis mgul dar legs pa gcig 'bul lo/oṃ swasti/bde legs su 'phel gyur cigastod shel dkar yul nas gdan drangs pa'i/khrung rdza ma pham g.yu mtsho 'di/phyi ser bya lta bu'i gdang gshog ldan/nang dngul dkar lta bu'i 'od mdangs che/206

g.yas su a long btags pa 'di/stag gral g.yas su 'khyil ba yin/g.yon du a long btags pa 'di/gzig gral g.yon du 'khyil ba yin/zhal mchu dbyings la bstan pa 'di/bzhugs gral yongs la bstan pa yin/khrung rdza ma pham g.yu mtsho la/bkra shis pa'i mgul dar legs pa zhig 'bul lo/chang gi bshad pa/lo la btsos pa'i lo chang yod/lo chang lo yag kham pa yod/zla la btsos pa'i zla chang yod/zla chang zil mngar ldan pa yod/zhag la btsos pa'i zhag chang yod/zhag chang zhag po me 'bar yod/nyin la btsos pa'i nyin chang yod/nyin chang bdud rtsi lo yag yod/chang thengs gsum bzhes dang dbu 'phang mtho/rtags dang rten 'brel 'grig le yod/207

ja yi bshad pa/dngul rgyan nang la ja 'dren yod/ja 'di yi 'byung khungs bshad pa na/shar rgya nag bkra shis ri bo nas/tshong dpon nor bu bzang po gcigalag do skar ma bkra shis gnyis/rgya drel mi nyag mtshal mo gsum/rgya nag po'i ja g.yang 'bebs pa'i dus/ nyin re'i gseb kyi shog dkar ja/srib ri'i gseb kyi shog nag ja/nyin srib bar gyi shog dmar ja/ja rab ja mi bla med 'di/rgya lcang me tog g.yang 'dzin gcigatil 'bru ja yi dpon po gnyis/can shel ja yi dpa' bo gsum/'bru thang ja yi ma chen bzhi/lha ja lha yi g.yog mo lnga/ko tshe ja yi g.yog mo drugardza chu sil ma de dang bdun/'bri mar ser po de dang brgyad/byang tshwa dkar mo de dang dgu/dgu ser ja yi dgu dkrugs brgyab/208
