lug sha 'dzugs khog gi bshad pa/dbyar rtswa sna gang 'dzoms su zhugs pa'i g.yang dkar lugaston chu sna gang 'dzoms su zhugs pa'i g.yang dkar lugadagun zhugs yul gang dro ru zhugs pa'i g.yang dkar lus phyi bal lug pa'i lug pa zer/lug khyed dang skal bzang zla ba 'dra/khram khyod dang smal po smin drug 'dra/lug gcig ma yin lug pa zer/phyi bal lug pa'i lug pa zer/nang sha tshil lug pa'i lug pa zer/nam rgyun lug shig lug pa'i lug pa zer/gzugs mi zer nor rtsa 'dzugs pa'i 'dzugs/de ring bzhugs gral sgor mo'i rgyan du 'dzugs pa'i 'dzubs/rkang pa mi zer bkang ba zer/bang mdzod nor gyis bkang ba'i bkang ba zer/mtshang ra mi zer tshang ba zer/rtsib ma mi zer rtsig pa zer/rtsi bcud brgya zas brtsigs pa'i rtsig pa zer/stod po mi zer mthon po zer/dbu 'phang dgung las mtho ba'i mthon po zer/brang khog mi zer grangs med zer/209

'khor 'bangs grangs med yong ba'i grangs med zer/lag pa mi zer legs pa zer/bya ba ci byas legs pa'i legs pa zer/mjing pa mi zer 'gyings pa zer/sdang dgra bo'i phyogs la 'gyings pa zer/sha bal tshil gyis brgyan pa'i g.yang dkar khyod/de ring bzhugs gral sgor mo'i rgyan du byon par bkra shis mgul dar zhig 'bul lo/ oṃ susti/bde legs su gyur cigabyang thang lhas ra gru bzhi nas gdan drangs pa'i/lug pho bal sha gnyis ldan 'di/nam rgyun lung pa bzang po'i rtswa chu gang bzang la bzhugs kyang /de ring bzhugs gral sgor mo'i 'dzugs la gdan drangs pa yin/lug mi zer lug pa zer/phyi bal lug pa'i lug pa zer/nang sha tshil lug pa'i lug pa zer/nam rgyun lug shig lug pa'i lug pa zer/rnga ma mi zer mnga' thang zer/bu nor mnga' thang rgyas pa zer/rkang pa mi zer khang pa zer/210

bang mdzod nor gyi khang pa zer/long mi zer longs spyod zer/gnas khang longs spyod che ba zer/rtsib ma mi zer rtsig pa zer/dkar mo 'bru yis brtsigs pa zer/lag pa mi zer legs pa zer/bya ba kun la legs pa zer/sog pa mi zer gsog pa zer/nor gsog pa'i gsog pa zer/brang mi zer pho brang zer/sems nyid brang ba'i pho brang zer/mjing pa mi zer 'gyings pa zer/phyi dgra bo'i phyogs la 'gyings pa zer/lhag pa mi zer bstan pa zer/sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba zer/rma lug dung dkar la bkra shis mgul dar zhig 'bul lo/daracag gi bshad pa/dar shing smyug bzang ldem ldem 'di/yul ljongs lho rong gting nas gdan drangs pa'i/rtsa ba gcig la rtse mo lnga/rtsa ba a ma chang ma'i khrung rkyan nyan pa yod/211

rtse mo sku rlung dar ba'i dar shing nyan pa yod/gangs la nyi shar dar mtshon sna lnga'i mkhar/rgyal dar dkar po lha ras 'bug 'di sgron/mkhar chen 'di yi pho lha'i dbus su btsugs/btsugs dang ma btsugs dgra lha'i dbu 'phang mtho la gzigs dang /ki ki bswo bswo lha rgyal lo/khyo bo'i bshadapa/'dzam gling sa gzhi kun la dbang bsgyur ba/sngon bsags bsod nams stobs las legs bskrun pa'i/gzugs sku nyi ma lta bu'i gzi bajid can/lha sras gzhon nu'i mdzes sdug dpal gyis ni/gangs ri'i mdangs 'phrog rab dkar seng ge 'dra/seng ge gangs ri 'grim ltar brtan par shogakhri brtan mi 'gyur 'dzam gling gser las grub/g.yas g.yon seng ges stegs pa'i khri yi steng / za 'og rgyan bzhi dmar ser sngon ljang dkar/bzhugs 'bol lnga tshan rim par brtsegs pa'i steng /'dzam gling bod yul khri skor bcu gsum gyi/'bru mchog 'dod rgu longs spyod 'khyil ba'i dbus/ja chang dpal yon 'dzoms pa'i bde skyid kyis/212

rtag tu rtse gar rol ba'i nyams ldan ni/steng phyogs lha 4yul na'ang med do zhes/'dir tshogs bzhugs gral rnams kyis yang yang gleng /de ring phun sum tshogs pa'i dus kyi char/mi nor zas gos thams cad dbang du 'dus/rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun dpal gyis brgyan/bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi mtshan dar dkar 'di/lha srang dbang 'duyokhyed kyi rgyan du 'bul/oṃ swasti/bde legs su gyur cigapha la bu skyes ge sar dpa' bo'i rgyud/dgra mgo 'dul bzhin dpa' bo'i rgyud/gnyen mgo skyong bzhin dpa' bo'i rgyud/a ma'i dgra 'dul gnyen skyong la mgul dar zhig 'bul/pho rab la bltas na 'go khrid yod/ri bo 'dra ma'i tshugs gcig yod/rgya mtsho 'dra ma'i klad gcig yod/gtsang chab 'dra ma'i gzhung gcig yod/nyi zla 'dra ma'i bkrag gcig yod/bu ge sar rgyal po dang /dbyer med la bkra shis kyi mgul dar 'bul/213

spyang grung 'dzoms la khra yi bu/chung la mtshar ba padma'i me tog 'dra/bu chung lha bu dar po dang dbyer med la mgul dar 'di 'bul lo/mna' ma'i bshadapa/oṃ susti/bde legs su gyur cigade ring gza' skar mchog tu dga' ba'i nyin/phun sum tshogs pa'i lha rdzas za 'og 'bol/bkra shis g.yung drung 'khyil ba'i gdan steng na/mthong na mi mthun med pa'i lang tsho ni/steng phyogs lha mo'i gzugs su shar ba ltar/gzugs mdzes lta na sdug cing tshul bzang ma/legs pa'i mdog dang 'jam pa'i dri mchog ldan/yid 'ong 'dod rgu reg bya sogs tshang ba'i/btsun mo rin chen lha bu gang nyid la/sngon du bkra shis gro so phye mar 'bul/bde legs rtags mtshan g.yang ṭi zhal dkar nang /'dzam gling rtsi tog snying po'i bdud rtsi dang /steng phyogs brgya byin lha yi bdud rtsi'i bcud/rgya gar bal bod bza' cha'i 'thung ba sogs/phun sum tshogs pas byur bus bkang ste 'bul/214

bkra shis rtags brgyad ri mos brgyan pa yi/rgyal dar dkar mo nang mdzod dri med 'di/mgul du 'bul bas dge legs gong 'phel shoga.oṃ swasti/bde legs su 'phel gyur cigayar bltas lha yi sras mo 'dra/mar bltas klu yi sras mo 'dra/bzhengs zer na thang zhang bkram pa 'dra/bzhugs zer na gur khang phub pa 'dra/rgyab gang bltas skra lo'i bsil ljang ma/mdun gang bltas so dkar 'dzum legs ma/phar 'gro khra chung mig gis skyel shes ma/tshur 'ong so dkar 'dzum gyis bsu shes ma/a ce lha gcig rgya bza' dang dbyer med la/bkra shis kyi mgul dar zhig 'bul lo/bu'ilab kyi bshad pa/gtsang g.yas ru phun sum tshogs pa'i sar/dpa' rtsal drug 'dzoms shing ngang rgyud ring /mi gzhan gyis mthong ba'i mod nyid la/pho skyes pa kun gyi dgra lha 'dra/dman bu mo sems yid 'phrog pa yi/215

yab rgyal po 'di ni ngo mtshar che/brtan mi 'gyur gser khri chen po'i steng /rgya gos bkra shis 'bol gdan bting /g.yang chags pa 'gro yi g.yung drung 'khyil/yab rgyal po mi 'gyur brtan par bzhugs/yab rgyal po sku gzugs gangs ri 'dra/gangs ri la nyi zer phog pa bzhin/dkar dmar gyi mdangs ldan zla ba 'dra/zhwa lham sogs na bzas brgyan tsa na/bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad bum pa la/dar mtshon sna lnga yis brgyan pa 'dra/snyan rgyan dang mgul rgyan rin chen sogs/seng ge la sogs g.yu ral rgyas pa 'dra/yab rgyal po'i dbu zhwa 'bog ser 'di/shar gser ri'i rtse la nyi shar 'dra/bkra shis 'dod rgu 'dzoms pa'i dus de ring / bkra shis rtags brgyad kyis mtshan pa'i lha gos 'di/ bkra shis yab rgyal mgul du phul ba yin/bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs par shoga.oṃ susti/bde legs su 'phel gyur cig216

yab chen khyed dang ri rgyal lhun po 'dra/de las dga' na dga' ste med/gangs dkar mtho la nyi ma shar/de las skyid na skyid de med/ pho brang nang du bu nor 'dzoms/yab chen kun bzang bde chen dang dbyer med la bkra shis kyi mgul dar 'di 'bul lo/bu'i yum la dar 'bul ba'ibashad pa/skyel spus/ste/bde legs su 'phel gyur cigaphun sum tshogs pa'i rin chen g.yu khri'i steng /bkra shis gos bzang las grub 'bol gdan la/yum chen a ma mi 'gyur brtan par bzhugs/'bras chang bsil ma bdud rtsi'i 'thung snod 'di/shar phyogs rgyal khab chen po'i bang mdzod nas/thon pa'i bkra shis dkar sangs yu ring yin/'di'i nang byur bur bkang ba'i bdud rtsi'i bcud/bde legs btungs pa'i phyogs 'di dgyes bzhes nas/ rtag tu bde skyid glu len bkra shis shog rab dkar bkra shis rtags mdzes dar dkar 'di/yum chen a ma'i bde legs rgyan du 'bul/217

oṃ susti/bde legs su 'phel gyur cigayum chen nyid dang ma pham g.yu mtsho 'dra/ca co'i sgrog brdabs med pa mer re bzhugs/rgyan gos bzhes pa bkrag dang ldan/yum chen lha gcig kun bzang dang dbyer med la bkra shis kyi mgul dar legs pa zhig 'bul lo/bag g.yog ma'i bshad pa/oṃ swasti/bde legs su gyur cigagus zhabs che zhing kha la nyan/zhabs tog sgrub cing rnam 'gyur yagagayog mo 'dzoms pa skyid pa dang dbyer med la/bkra shis kyi mgul dar 'di 'bul lo/mna'am skyelamakhan gyi bshad pa/rgya gar bal bod skad bsgyur lo tsā ba/sgos mkhas mkhas dbang thon mi sam bho ṭa/sam bho ṭa yis lus ngag dka' spyad kyis/rgya gar dang li yi gnas mchog nas/218

chos zab rgyas mdo rgyud mang po zhigabyang kha ba'i yul 'dir spyan drangs ltar/gtsang dbus gyur sge chen zhing gnyis la/dpal bkra shis lhun po'i nye 'dabs kyi/yid bzhin nor bus gang ba'i khang gsar nang /nor bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po ni/gdan 'dren pa lo tsā blon po la/nor bsam 'phel deng 'dis spyan drangs pa'i/legs gsol gyi bkra shis dar dkar 'bul/oṃ suste/bde legs su 'phel gyur cigs gtsang mkhas shing sa bcu 'bel/mig gi yul du zhugs tshor dkar ba 'dugarna ba'i yul du gsung bshad snyan pa 'dugabram ze zla ba bzang po dang dbyer med la/bkra shis kyi mgul dar zhig 'bul lo/bag mi'am snying dga' ba'i bshad pa/oṃ sunyi/bde legs su 'phel gyur cigabade bar gshegs pa'i ring lugs bla na med/219

zhu chen 'gyur med gcig pur gnas 'dug pas/skad gnyis smra ba bee ro ka cog sogs lo tsā ba chen po rnam sa dang dbyer med la mgul dar zhig 'bul lo/oṃ suste/bde legs su 'phel gyur cigargya bod gnyis kyi rtsa ba/kha lag bar gyi thur ma bzhin/chu phan tshun bar gyi zam pa yin/phyi sgo gsar pa'i g.ya' shing yin/rgya skad bod la bsgyur mkhan yin/bod skad rgya la bsgyur mkhan yin/rgya dar dri med a she de/sems bzang snying dga'i rgyan du 'bul/ga'u am phrag tu bcug pa'i rtsi hrug hrug med par/g.yu 'brug sngon mo ldir ba bzhin/zhugs gral 'di ru zhal shob kyi lo ma 'ur chem chem ldir ha ta / mtho po dkar po'am dkar rdo'imachod 'bul bshadapa/g.yas phyogs dkar ba'i lha rdo dkar po mchod/byin rlabs 'byung ba'i rtsa rgyud bla ma mchod/dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam lha tshogs mchod/220

bar chad sel ba'i mkha' 'gro chos skyong mchod/lha rgyal dbang po brgya byin mchod/lha 'khor su ma brgya drug cu mchod/klu rgyal dga' bo phyug po mchod/klu 'khor sum brgya drug cu ma chod/yul 'di ru gnas pa'i yul lha mchod/yul lha sum brgya drug cu mchod/na mo ki ki bsro bswo lha rgyal lo/nag rdo'am mtho po nag po'i bshad pa/g.yon phyogs nag pa'i 'dre nag 'byung po'i tshogs/lho phyogs 'dzam gling zhing 'dir ma sdod cigang ni phyag na rdo rje'i bu/phyag na rdo rje thugs khros nas/'dre nag yod pa'i tshogs rnams 'dul/dkar mo 'bru yi skyes sa'i skyes khungasaspyi bshad pa/pha de g.ya sa gzhogs gtsang po yin/ma de pad ma 'dab brgyad yin/a khu lho sprin smug po yin/a ne sbrang char zil ma yin/rol gyi g.yas la dkar mo btab/221
rol gyi g.yon la smug po btab/rol gyi dkyil la sbal sran khra chung btab/'bru yi rtsa ba 'di ru tshang /
